en.t: German king Otto III chooses his cousin Bruno of Carinthia as pope following the death of Pope John XV. Bruno becomes pope under the name Gregory V
en.s: Pope Gregory V (Latin: Gregorius V; c. 972 – 18 February 999), born Bruno of Carinthia, was the bishop of Rome and ruler of the Papal States from 3 May 996 to his death. A member of the Salian dynasty, he was made pope by his cousin, Emperor Otto III.

zh.t: 奥托三世选定堂弟布鲁诺为教宗，布鲁诺以格列高利五世之名即位
zh.s: 教宗格列高利五世（拉丁语：Gregorius V；约972年—999年2月18日），本名卡林西亚的布鲁诺，自996年5月3日起担任罗马主教和教宗国统治者，直至去世。他是萨利安王朝成员，由其堂兄、皇帝奥托三世任命为教宗。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The naval Battle of Giglio, also known as the Battle of Montecristo, was fought on 3 May 1241 between a combined Imperial, Sicilian and Pisan fleet and a Genoese squadron carrying high-ranking ecclesiastical delegates to a council summoned at Rome by Pope Gregory IX. The engagement took place in the Tyrrhenian Sea between Montecristo and Giglio and ended in a decisive victory for the forces of Emperor Frederick II.

zh.s: 1241年5月3日，吉廖岛海战（又称蒙特克里斯托海战）在第勒尼安海的蒙特克里斯托岛和吉廖岛之间爆发。交战双方是由帝国、西西里和比萨舰队组成的联合舰队，以及一支热那亚舰队。后者正载着高级教会代表前往罗马，参加教宗额我略九世召集的会议。腓特烈二世皇帝的军队取得决定性胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Beverhoutsveld took place on 3 May 1382, on a field situated between the towns of Beernem, Oostkamp and Assebroek. It marked an important phase in the rebellion of Ghent (led by Philip van Artevelde) against Louis II, Count of Flanders.

zh.s: 贝弗豪茨费尔德战役于1382年5月3日发生，战场位于贝尔讷姆、奥斯特坎普和阿瑟布鲁克三镇之间。这场战役是根特起义的重要阶段之一。起义由菲利普·范·阿特费尔德领导，反抗对象是佛兰德伯爵路易二世。

en.s: The 1481 Rhodes earthquake occurred at 3:00 in the morning on 3 May. It triggered a small tsunami, which caused local flooding. There were an estimated 30,000 fatalities. It was the largest of a series of earthquakes that affected Rhodes, starting on 15 March 1481, continuing until January 1482.
en.n: This entry records the local date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1481年5月3日凌晨3点，罗得岛发生地震，并引发小型海啸，导致当地发生洪灾。估计有3万人遇难。这是自1481年3月15日至1482年1月间一系列罗得岛地震中规模最大的一次。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框标注的当地日期。

en.s: The Battle of Okitanawate (沖田畷の戦い), also known as the Battle of Shimabara, was fought on May 3 of 1584, the Arima–Shimazu alliance defeated the Ryūzōji with Portuguese military support, including firearms, mortars, and a Portuguese fusta commanded by Captain Ambrósio Fernandes. The intervention was organised locally through the Jesuit mission and Portuguese merchants. Ryūzōji Takanobu was attacking a number of independent clans close to his territories.

zh.s: 冲田畷之战（日语：沖田畷の戦い），又称岛原之战，于1584年5月3日爆发。有马—岛津联盟在葡萄牙军事力量支持下击败龙造寺军，其中包括枪械、迫击炮和由安布罗西奥·费尔南德斯船长指挥的一艘葡萄牙轻帆船。相关干预由耶稣会传教团和葡萄牙商人在当地组织。龙造寺隆信当时正进攻其领地附近的多个独立氏族。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Treaty of Loudun was signed on May 3, 1616, in Loudun, France, and ended the war that originally began as a power struggle between queen mother Marie de Medici's favorite Concino Concini (recently made Marquis d'Ancre) and Henry II de Condé, the next in line for Louis XIII's throne. The war gained religious undertones when rebellious Huguenot princes joined Condé's revolt.

zh.s: 《卢丹和约》于1616年5月3日在法国卢丹签署，结束了最初由王太后玛丽·德·美第奇的宠臣康奇诺·孔奇尼（不久前受封昂克尔侯爵）与王位继承顺位仅次于路易十三的亨利二世·德·孔代之间的权力斗争。胡格诺派亲王加入孔代的叛乱后，这场冲突也带上了宗教色彩。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Battle of Tangier in 1662 was the first major engagement between Moroccan forces, led by Khadir Ghaïlan, and the English garrison, led by Nathaniel Fiennes. The Moroccans routed the English force.

zh.s: 1662年，摩洛哥军队与英军驻军首次发生大规模交战。摩洛哥军队由哈迪尔·盖兰率领，英军由纳撒尼尔·芬尼斯率领。摩洛哥军击溃了英军。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The siege of Nitra in 1664 lasted from 17 April to 3 May. The castle was defended by the Ottomans against Austrian and Hungarian troops led by Jean-Louis Raduit de Souches.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1664年尼特拉围城战从4月17日持续到5月3日。奥斯曼军队守卫城堡，抵御让-路易·拉杜伊·德·苏什率领的奥地利和匈牙利军队。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of Mamora was a military operation launched in 1681 by Sultan Moulay Ismail with the aim of taking the place of Mamora, which had been occupied by the Spanish since 1614. The Moroccan forces eventually captured the Spanish fortress.

zh.s: 1681年，苏丹穆莱·伊斯梅尔发起军事行动，围攻马莫拉，试图夺回这座自1614年以来被西班牙占领的地方。摩洛哥军队最终攻占了西班牙堡垒。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The action of 2 May 1707, also known as Beachy Head, was a naval battle of the War of the Spanish Succession in which a French squadron under Claude de Forbin intercepted a large British convoy escorted by three ships of the line, under Commodore Baron Wylde. The action began when three French ships, the Grifon, Blackoal and Dauphine, grappled HMS Hampton Court, killing her captain, George Clements, and taking her.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1707年5月2日海战又称比奇角海战，是西班牙王位继承战争期间的一场海战。克洛德·德·福尔班率领的法国分舰队拦截了一支大型英国船队，该船队由怀尔德准将率领的3艘战列舰护航。3艘法国舰船“格里丰”号、“布莱克科尔”号和“多芬”号与英国“汉普顿法院”号接舷交战，杀死其舰长乔治·克莱门茨并俘获了该舰。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: A total solar eclipse occurred on 3 May 1715. It was known as Halley's Eclipse, after Edmond Halley (1656–1742) who predicted this eclipse within 4 minutes accuracy.

zh.s: 1715年5月3日发生了一次日全食。埃德蒙·哈雷（1656—1742）曾预测这次日食，误差在4分钟以内，因此这次日食也称为“哈雷日食”。

en.s: King George's War (1744–1748) encompassed the military operations in North America that formed part of the War of the Austrian Succession (1740–1748). It was the third of the four French and Indian Wars. It took place primarily in the British provinces of New York, Massachusetts Bay (which included Maine as well as Massachusetts at the time), New Hampshire (which included Vermont at the time), and Nova Scotia.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 乔治王之战（1744—1748年）包括北美地区的一系列军事行动，是奥地利王位继承战争（1740—1748年）的一部分，也是四次法印战争中的第三次。战事主要发生在英国的北美殖民省份，包括纽约、马萨诸塞湾（当时包括缅因州和马萨诸塞州）、新罕布什尔（当时包括佛蒙特州）和新斯科舍。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框所列的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Capture of Agra Fort ended a month-long siege by Jat ruler Maharaja Suraj Mal on 12 June 1761, marking the annexation of Agra into Bharatpur. After a one-month siege of Agra, the Mughal army, led by Mirza Fazilka Khan, surrendered to the Jat army. The Jats seized the old capital of the Mughal Empire. It remained in possession of Bharatpur rulers until 1774.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1761年6月12日，贾特统治者苏拉杰·马尔结束了对阿格拉堡长达一个月的围城，并将阿格拉并入婆罗多布尔。围城一个月后，由米尔扎·法齐尔卡汗率领的莫卧儿军队向贾特军队投降。贾特人夺取了莫卧儿帝国的旧都。该城一直由婆罗多布尔统治者控制到1774年。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框所列的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Constitution of 3 May 1791, titled the Government Act, was a written constitution for the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth that was adopted by the Great Sejm that met between 1788 and 1792. The Commonwealth was a dual monarchy comprising the Crown of the Kingdom of Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania; the new constitution was intended to address political questions following a period of political agitation and gradual reform that began with the Convocation Sejm of 1764 and the election that year of the Commonwealth's last monarch, Stanisław August Poniatowski.

zh.s: 1791年5月3日宪法又称《政府法》，是波兰立陶宛联邦的一部成文宪法，由1788至1792年间召开的四年议会通过。波兰立陶宛联邦是由波兰王国王冠领地和立陶宛大公国组成的二元君主国。新宪法旨在处理政治问题；此前，联邦经历了一段政治动荡和渐进改革时期，始于1764年召开的召集议会以及当年对联邦末代君主斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特·波尼亚托夫斯基的选举。

en.s: The Battles of Stockach and Engen were fought on 3 May 1800 between the army of the First French Republic under Jean Victor Marie Moreau and the army of the Habsburg monarchy led by Paul Kray. The fighting near Engen resulted in a stalemate. However, while the two main armies were engaged at Engen, Claude Lecourbe captured Stockach from its Austrian defenders (the latter commanded by Joseph Louis, Prince of Lorraine-Vaudémont).

zh.s: 施托卡赫和恩根战役于1800年5月3日发生，由让-维克托·马里·莫罗率领的法兰西第一共和国军队与保罗·克雷率领的哈布斯堡君主国军队交战。恩根附近的战斗以僵持告终。两军在恩根交战时，克洛德·勒库尔布从奥地利守军手中夺取了施托卡赫；守军由洛林-沃德蒙亲王约瑟夫·路易指挥。

en.t: Washington, D.C. is incorporated as a city after Congress abolishes the Board of Commissioners, the District's founding government. The "City of Washington" is given a mayor-council form of government
en.s: Washington, D.C., officially the District of Columbia and commonly known as Washington, is the federal capital city of the United States, and its only federal district. The city stands on the north-east bank of the Potomac River, across from the state of Virginia, surrounded by Maryland to its north, east, and south. The district was named for Columbia, the female personification of the American nation, through which human form and attributes are applied to the United States.

zh.t: 华盛顿哥伦比亚特区获准建市，国会废除作为特区创始政府的专员委员会，并赋予“华盛顿市”市长—议会制
zh.s: 华盛顿哥伦比亚特区正式名称为哥伦比亚特区，通常简称华盛顿，是美国首都，也是美国唯一的联邦特区。城市位于波托马克河北岸，与弗吉尼亚州隔河相望，北、东、南三面被马里兰州环绕。特区以哥伦比亚命名；哥伦比亚是美国的女性化身，这一名称借由拟人方式为美国赋予了人格与属性。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The Battle of Ebelsberg, known in French accounts as the Battle of Ebersberg, was fought on 3 May 1809 during the War of the Fifth Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars. The Austrian left wing under the command of Johann von Hiller took up positions at Ebersberg on the Traun river. The French under André Masséna attacked, crossing a heavily defended 550-meter-long bridge and subsequently conquering the local castle, thus forcing Hiller to withdraw. Ebelsberg is now a southern suburb of Linz, situated on the south bank of the Traun, a short distance above the place where that stream flows into the Danube River.

zh.s: 埃贝尔斯贝格战役在法国史料中也称埃伯斯贝格战役，发生于1809年5月3日，是拿破仑战争中第五次反法同盟战争的一场战役。奥地利军左翼在约翰·冯·希勒指挥下，于特劳恩河畔的埃伯斯贝格布防。安德烈·马塞纳率领法军进攻，穿过一座防守严密、长550米的桥，随后攻占当地城堡，迫使希勒撤退。埃贝尔斯贝格如今是林茨南部的一个城区，位于特劳恩河南岸，距特劳恩河注入多瑙河处不远。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The action of 3 May 1810 was a naval engagement in the Bay of Naples between a Royal Navy frigate captained by Jahleel Brenton and a French squadron of eleven warships. The British captured the French brig Sparviere during the battle.

zh.s: 1810年5月3日，英国皇家海军一艘由贾利尔·布伦顿担任舰长的护卫舰与一支由11艘军舰组成的法国舰队在那不勒斯湾交战。英军在战斗中俘获了法国双桅船“斯帕维耶雷”号。

en.s: The Battle of Fuentes de Oñoro was a military engagement that took place from 3–5 May 1811 during the Peninsular War. An Anglo-Portuguese Army under Wellington checked an attempt by the French Army of Portugal under Marshal André Masséna to relieve the besieged city of Almeida.

zh.t: 丰特斯德奥尼奥罗战役
zh.s: 丰特斯德奥尼奥罗战役于1811年5月3日至5日发生，是半岛战争期间的一场军事交战。威灵顿率领的英葡联军阻止了葡萄牙法军司令安德烈·马塞纳元帅率部解围被围困的阿尔梅达城。

en.s: The Raid on Havre de Grace was a seaborne raid that took place on 3 May 1813 during the broader War of 1812. A squadron of the British Royal Navy under Rear Admiral George Cockburn attacked the town of Havre de Grace, Maryland, at the mouth of the Susquehanna River. Cockburn's forces routed the town's defenders and sacked and burnt several buildings before withdrawing.

zh.s: 1813年5月3日，英国皇家海军一支分舰队在乔治·科伯恩海军少将率领下，袭击了马里兰州萨斯奎哈纳河口的哈弗尔德格雷斯镇。这是1812年战争期间的一次海上突袭。英军击溃守军，洗劫并焚烧了数栋建筑后撤离。

en.s: The Battle of Tolentino was fought from 2–3 May 1815 near Tolentino, Kingdom of Naples in what is now Marche, Italy: it was the decisive battle in the Neapolitan War, fought by the Napoleonic King of Naples Joachim Murat to keep the throne after the Congress of Vienna.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 托伦蒂诺战役于1815年5月2日至3日在那不勒斯王国托伦蒂诺附近（今意大利马尔凯大区）进行，是那不勒斯战争中的决定性战役。拿破仑麾下的那不勒斯国王若阿尚·缪拉为保住维也纳会议后获得的王位而战。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.t: The Canterbury and Whitstable Railway is opened; it is the first steam-hauled passenger railway to issue season tickets and include a tunnel
en.s: The Canterbury and Whitstable Railway, sometimes referred to colloquially as the "Crab and Winkle Line", was an early British railway that opened in 1830 between Canterbury and Whitstable in the county of Kent, England.

zh.t: 坎特伯雷—惠特斯特布尔铁路开通
zh.s: 坎特伯雷—惠特斯特布尔铁路是英国早期铁路，1830年在英格兰肯特郡坎特伯雷和惠特斯特布尔之间开通。它是第一条发行季票并设有隧道的蒸汽客运铁路。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.t: The University of Athens is founded in Athens, Greece
en.s: Athens is the capital and largest city of Greece. A significant coastal urban area in the Mediterranean, Athens is also the capital of the Attica region and is the southernmost capital on the European mainland. With its urban area's population numbering over 3.6 million, it is the eighth-largest urban area in the European Union (EU).

zh.t: 雅典大学在希腊雅典成立
zh.s: 雅典是希腊首都和最大城市，也是地中海沿岸的重要城市中心及阿提卡大区首府，位于欧洲大陆最南端。雅典市区人口超过 360 万，是欧盟第八大城市区域。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.t: Establishment of National and Kapodistrian University of Athens
en.s: The National and Kapodistrian University of Athens (NKUA; Greek: Εθνικό και Καποδιστριακό Πανεπιστήμιο Αθηνών, Ethnikó kai Kapodistriakó Panepistímio Athinón), simply referred to as the University of Athens (UoA), is a public university in Athens, Greece, with various campuses along the Athens agglomeration. It has been in continuous operation since its establishment in 1837 and is the oldest higher education institution of the modern Greek state and the first contemporary university in both the Balkan Peninsula and the Eastern Mediterranean.

zh.s: 雅典国立卡波季斯特里亚斯大学（NKUA，希腊语：Εθνικό και Καποδιστριακό Πανεπιστήμιο Αθηνών），简称雅典大学（UoA），是一所位于希腊雅典、在雅典都会区设有多个校区的公立大学。学校自1837年成立以来持续办学，是现代希腊最古老的高等教育机构，也是巴尔干半岛和东地中海地区第一所现代大学。

en.s: The Battle of Acajete was fought at Acajete, Veracruz on 3 May 1839 between insurgents under the joint command of José de Urrea and José Antonio Mexía, and 1,600 Centerists under the command of General Gabriel Valencia. The insurgents lost, Mexía was captured and executed, Urrea fled to Tampico.

zh.s: 阿卡赫特之战于1839年5月3日在墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯州阿卡赫特发生。叛军由何塞·德·乌雷亚和何塞·安东尼奥·梅希亚共同指挥，对阵由加夫列尔·巴伦西亚将军率领的1,600名中央集权派军队。叛军战败，梅希亚被俘并处决，乌雷亚逃往坦皮科。

en.t: The boar-crested Anglo-Saxon Benty Grange helmet is discovered in a barrow on the Benty Grange farm in Derbyshire
en.s: Benty Grange is a Site of Special Scientific Interest in the parish of Monyash in Derbyshire, England. 21.1 ha (52 acres) in size and with at least four grass species and ten other plant species, it is considered of national importance as one of the largest areas of unimproved species-rich neutral lowland grassland in the Peak District National Park.

zh.t: 顶饰为野猪的盎格鲁-撒克逊本廷格兰奇头盔在德比郡本廷格兰奇农场的一座古坟中被发现
zh.s: 本廷格兰奇是英格兰德比郡莫尼亚什堂区的一处特殊科学价值地点。该地面积为 21.1 公顷（52 英亩），至少有四种禾草和十种其他植物，被视为具有国家重要性的地点，也是峰区国家公园内面积最大的未改良、物种丰富的中性低地草原之一。

en.s: The May Uprising took place in Dresden, Kingdom of Saxony in 1849; it was one of the last of the series of events known as the Revolutions of 1848.
en.n: The May Uprising in Dresden begins: The last of the German revolutions of 1848–49.

zh.s: 德累斯顿五月起义于1849年发生，是1848年革命系列事件中的最后几场起义之一。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框所列的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Second Battle of Fredericksburg, also known as the Second Battle of Marye's Heights, took place on May 3, 1863, in Fredericksburg, Virginia, as part of the Chancellorsville Campaign of the American Civil War.

zh.t: 第二次弗雷德里克斯堡战役
zh.s: 第二次弗雷德里克斯堡战役又称第二次玛丽高地战役，于1863年5月3日在美国弗吉尼亚州弗雷德里克斯堡发生，是南北战争钱瑟勒斯维尔战役的一部分。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Warrenton Junction Raid (May 3, 1863) was a surprise attack by Confederate guerrilla warriors on a Union cavalry detachment during the American Civil War. The raid took place near a railroad junction in Virginia's Fauquier County, less than 10 miles (16 km) from the town of Warrenton. Confederate Major (eventually Colonel) John S. Mosby led the attack against about 100 men from the Union's 1st (West) Virginia Cavalry.

zh.s: 沃伦顿枢纽突袭发生于1863年5月3日，是美国内战期间南方邦联游击队对北方联邦骑兵分队发动的一次突袭。战斗发生在弗吉尼亚州福基尔县的一处铁路枢纽附近，距沃伦顿镇不到10英里（16公里）。南方邦联少校（后晋升为上校）约翰·S·莫斯比率领部队袭击了约100名北方联邦第1西弗吉尼亚骑兵团士兵。

en.s: Streight's Raid (19 April – 3 May 1863) took place in northern Alabama during the American Civil War (1861-1865). It was led by Union Army Col. Abel D. Streight (1828-1892) and opposed by the Confederate States Army of Brig. Gen. Nathan Bedford Forrest (1820-1877), Streight's goal was to destroy parts of the Western and Atlantic Railroad, which was supplying the Confederate Army of Tennessee to the north.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 斯特雷特突袭于1863年4月19日至5月3日发生在美国内战期间，地点在阿拉巴马州北部。北方联邦军队的阿贝尔·D·斯特雷特上校（1828—1892）率部行动，遭到南方邦联军队内森·贝德福德·福雷斯特准将（1821—1877）率部抵抗。斯特雷特的目标是破坏西部和大西洋铁路的部分路段，该铁路为北方的田纳西邦联军供给物资。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Salem Church, took place on May 4 respectively, 1863, in Spotsylvania County, Virginia, as part of the Chancellorsville Campaign of the American Civil War.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 塞勒姆教堂战役于1863年5月4日在弗吉尼亚州斯波特瑟尔韦尼亚县发生，是美国内战钱斯勒斯维尔战役的一部分。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框所列的事件开始日期。

loc: 美国新墨西哥州伊达尔戈县

en.s: The Skirmish in Doubtful Canyon took place on May 3, 1864 between a company of infantry from the California Column and a band of about 100 Apaches. The fighting occurred near Steins Peak in Doubtful Canyon, Arizona Territory. Doubtful Canyon, along with Apache Pass in Arizona and Cookes Canyon, in New Mexico was a favored location for an ambush by the Apache along the Butterfield Overland Mail route. The Californians were on the march from Fort Cummings to Fort Bowie in the military District of Arizona, when they were attacked in the canyon.

zh.s: 疑云峡小规模冲突发生于 1864 年 5 月 3 日，交战双方是加利福尼亚纵队的一支步兵连和约 100 名阿帕奇人。战斗发生在亚利桑那领地疑云峡的斯坦斯峰附近。疑云峡、亚利桑那领地的阿帕奇山口以及新墨西哥的库克斯峡谷，都是阿帕奇人在巴特菲尔德陆路邮路沿线常用的伏击地点。当时，加利福尼亚士兵正从卡明斯堡行军前往鲍伊堡，隶属亚利桑那军事区，途中在峡谷遭到袭击。

en.s: A general election was held in Spain on 20 April 1879 (for the Congress of Deputies), and on 3 May 1879 (for the Senate), to elect the members of the 1st Cortes under the Spanish Constitution of 1876, during the Restoration period. All 431 seats in the Congress of Deputies were up for election, as well as 180 of 360 seats in the Senate.
en.n: This entry records the senate, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 西班牙于1879年4月20日举行众议院选举，并于1879年5月3日举行参议院选举，选出1876年《西班牙宪法》实施后的第一届议会成员。当时正值复辟时期。众议院431席全部改选，参议院360席中有180席改选。
zh.n: 此条记录仅指源信息框标注的参议院选举日期。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 3 May 1892. Supporters of Charilaos Trikoupis emerged as the largest bloc in Parliament, with 160 of the 207 seats. Trikoupis became Prime Minister for the sixth time on 22 June.

zh.s: 希腊于1892年5月3日举行议会选举。查里劳斯·特里库皮斯的支持者成为议会最大阵营，在207席中赢得160席。特里库皮斯于6月22日第六次出任首相。

en.t: 1894 Bilbao students v British workers football match
en.s: The 1894 Bilbao students v British workers was a football match that took place at the Hippodrome of Lamiako, Leioa, on 3 May 1894. The match was contested by a group of Bilbainos who challenged the British residents in Bilbao to a football match, which at the time was a relatively unknown sport in Spain.

zh.t: 1894年毕尔巴鄂学生队对英国工人队足球赛
zh.s: 1894年毕尔巴鄂学生队对英国工人队足球赛于1894年5月3日在莱奥阿的拉米亚科赛马场举行。毕尔巴鄂当地居民组成的球队向当地英国居民发起足球挑战；当时这项运动在西班牙还鲜为人知。

en.s: The siege of Jeonju Fortress was a conflict in May 1894 that concluded the first revolt of the Donghak Peasant Revolution. The Donghak Peasant Army that won the Battle of Hwangryong River immediately aimed to capture Jeonju. In the early morning of April 27, the peasant army formed a line at Yongduchi overlooking Jeonju Fortress and prepared to advance.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 全州城堡围城战发生于1894年5月，是东学农民革命首次起义的结束阶段。黄龙江战役获胜后，东学农民军立即准备夺取全州。4月27日清晨，农民军在俯瞰全州城堡的龙头峙列队，准备进攻。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Retreat to Montalban occurred during the Philippine Revolution after the 1897 Battle of Naic southwest of Cavite when Philippine General Emilio Aguinaldo's and his forces retreated to Puray, Montalban on June 14. The Spanish pursued the Katipunero forces retreating towards central Luzon, killing many of the revolutionaries.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 蒙塔尔班撤退发生于 1897 年菲律宾革命期间，起因是内伊克战役。菲律宾将军埃米利奥·阿吉纳尔多及其部队于 6 月 14 日撤至普赖山（蒙塔尔班）。西班牙军队追击撤向吕宋岛中部的卡蒂普南革命军，造成许多革命者死亡。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: 1900 Edinburgh and St Andrews Universities by-election
en.s: The 1900 Edinburgh and St Andrews Universities by-election was a parliamentary by-election held in Scotland on 3 May 1900 for the UK House of Commons constituency of Edinburgh and St Andrews Universities. As a university constituency, the constituency had no geographical basis. Instead, its electorate consisted of the graduates of Edinburgh University and St Andrews University.

zh.t: 1900年爱丁堡和圣安德鲁斯大学选区补选
zh.s: 1900年爱丁堡和圣安德鲁斯大学选区补选于1900年5月3日在苏格兰举行，改选英国下议院爱丁堡和圣安德鲁斯大学选区的议员。作为大学选区，该选区没有具体的地理范围，选民由爱丁堡大学和圣安德鲁斯大学的毕业生组成。

en.s: The Great Fire of 1901 was a conflagration that occurred in Jacksonville, Florida, on May 3, 1901. It was one of the worst disasters in Florida history and the third largest urban fire in the US, next to the Great Chicago Fire, and the 1906 San Francisco fire.

zh.s: 1901年大火于1901年5月3日在佛罗里达州杰克逊维尔发生，是一场大规模火灾。这是佛罗里达州历史上最严重的灾难之一，也是美国规模第三大的城市火灾，仅次于芝加哥大火和1906年旧金山大火。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1902 South Australian state election was held on 3 May 1902 following the dissolution of both houses. All 42 seats in the South Australian House of Assembly were up for election, and all 18 seats in the Legislative Council. The House had a reduction of 12 seats compared to the previous election.

zh.s: 1902年南澳大利亚州选举于5月3日举行，之前两院均已解散。南澳大利亚州众议院全部42席和立法会全部18席均改选。众议院席位比上次选举减少12席。

en.s: The Moro Rebellion (1902–1913) was an armed conflict between the Moro people and the United States military during the Philippine–American War. The rebellion occurred after the conclusion of the conflict between the United States and the First Philippine Republic, and saw the US move to impose its authority over the Muslim states in Mindanao, Jolo, and the neighboring Sulu Archipelago.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 摩洛叛乱（1902—1913年）是摩洛人和美国军队在美菲战争期间的武装冲突。叛乱发生在美国与菲律宾第一共和国之间的冲突结束后。美国试图在棉兰老岛、苏禄岛和附近苏禄群岛的穆斯林政权中确立统治。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框所列的事件开始日期。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in the Grand Duchy of Finland on 1 and 3 May 1909.

zh.s: 芬兰大公国于1909年5月1日和3日举行议会选举。

en.t: Raja Harishchandra, the first Indian feature-length film, was released
en.s: Raja Harishchandra (transl. King Harishchandra) is a 1913 Indian silent film directed and produced by Dadasaheb Phalke. It is often considered the first full-length Indian feature film. Raja Harishchandra features Dattatraya Damodar Dabke, Anna Salunke, Bhalchandra Phalke and Gajanan Vasudev Sane. It is based on the legend of Harishchandra, with Dabke portraying the title character. The film, being silent, had English, Marathi, and Hindi-language intertitles.

zh.t: 《王哈利什钱德拉》上映，成为印度首部故事长片
zh.s: 《王哈利什钱德拉》（Raja Harishchandra）是一部1913年印度无声电影，由达达萨赫布·帕尔克执导并制片。它常被视为印度第一部长篇故事片。主演包括达塔特雷亚·达莫达尔·达布克、安娜·萨伦克、巴尔钱德拉·帕尔克和加贾南·瓦苏德夫·萨内。影片取材于哈利什钱德拉的传说，由达布克饰演主角。影片是无声片，使用英语、马拉地语和印地语字幕卡。

en.s: The battle for Baby 700 (2/3 May 1915), was an engagement fought during the Gallipoli Campaign of the First World War, between the forces of the British Empire and the Ottoman Empire. On 25 April 1915, the Australian and New Zealand Army Corps (ANZAC), conducted an amphibious landing on the Gallipoli Peninsula.

zh.s: Baby 700战役发生于1915年5月2日至3日，是第一次世界大战加里波利战役期间的一场交战，交战双方是大英帝国和奥斯曼帝国的军队。1915年4月25日，澳大利亚和新西兰军团（ANZAC）在加里波利半岛实施两栖登陆。

en.s: Patrick Henry Pearse (also known as Pádraig or Pádraic Pearse; Irish: Pádraig Anraí Mac Piarais; 10 November 1879 – 3 May 1916) was an Irish teacher, barrister, poet, writer, nationalist, republican political activist and revolutionary who was one of the leaders of the Easter Rising in 1916. Following his execution along with 15 others, Pearse came to be seen by many as the embodiment of the rebellion.

zh.t: 帕特里克·皮尔斯被处决
zh.s: 帕特里克·亨利·皮尔斯（也称帕德里格或帕德雷格·皮尔斯；爱尔兰语：Pádraig Anraí Mac Piarais；1879年11月10日—1916年5月3日）是爱尔兰教师、律师、诗人、作家、民族主义者、共和派政治活动家和革命者，也是1916年复活节起义的领导人之一。他与另外15人一同被处决后，许多人将他视为这场起义的象征。

en.s: The action of 3 May 1920 was a short single-ship action fought off Ochakov during the Russian Civil War between a French Navy aviso and a Bolshevik floating battery.

zh.s: 1920年5月3日，一艘法国海军通报舰与一艘布尔什维克浮动炮台在奥恰基夫附近发生短暂交战。这是一次单舰交战，发生于俄国内战期间。

en.s: The Georgian coup in May 1920 was an unsuccessful attempt to take power by the Bolsheviks in the Democratic Republic of Georgia. Relying on the 11th Red Army of Soviet Russia operating in neighboring Azerbaijan, the Bolsheviks attempted to take control of a military school and government offices in the Georgian capital of Tiflis on May 3.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1920年5月，布尔什维克试图在格鲁吉亚民主共和国夺权。苏俄第11红军当时驻扎在邻国阿塞拜疆，布尔什维克企图控制格鲁吉亚首都第比利斯的军事学校和政府办公机构。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Tourmakeady ambush or Battle of Tourmakeady occurred on 3 May 1921 during the Irish War of Independence. The South Mayo Brigade of the Irish Republican Army (IRA), commanded by Commandant Tom Maguire ambushed an RIC/Black and Tan re-supply patrol in the village of Tourmakeady, County Mayo in the west of Ireland in order to destroy the patrol and to cause the closure of Derrypark RIC Barracks, seven miles to the south.

zh.s: 图尔马克迪伏击战又称图尔马克迪之战，于1921年5月3日在爱尔兰独立战争期间发生。爱尔兰共和军南梅奥旅由指挥官汤姆·马奎尔率领，在爱尔兰西部梅奥郡图尔马克迪村伏击皇家爱尔兰警察队和“黑棕部队”的补给巡逻队，意图歼灭巡逻队并迫使南面7英里处的德里帕克警察营房关闭。

en.t: Ireland is partitioned under British law by the Government of Ireland Act 1920, creating Northern Ireland and Southern Ireland
en.s: The Government of Ireland Act 1920 (10 & 11 Geo. 5. c. 67) was an act of the Parliament of the United Kingdom. The Act's long title was "An Act to provide for the better government of Ireland"; it is also known as the Fourth Home Rule Bill or (inaccurately) as the Fourth Home Rule Act and informally known as the Partition Act.

zh.t: 英国法律将爱尔兰一分为二，成立北爱尔兰和南爱尔兰
zh.s: 《1920年爱尔兰政府法》（10 & 11 Geo. 5，第67章）是英国议会通过的一项法案。法案长标题为“改善爱尔兰治理的法案”；该法也称“第四自治法案草案”，有时被称为“第四自治法案”（这一说法并不准确），俗称“分治法案”。

en.s: The 1923 Newfoundland general election was held on 3 May 1923 to elect members of the 25th General Assembly of Newfoundland in the Dominion of Newfoundland. The Liberal Reform Party, an alliance between the Liberals led by Richard Squires and the Fishermen's Protective Union of William Coaker, were re-elected. The Liberal-Labour-Progressive party, led by John R. Bennett, formed the opposition.

zh.s: 1923年纽芬兰大选于5月3日举行，选出纽芬兰自治领第25届议会的议员。自由改革党由理查德·斯奎尔斯领导的自由党与威廉·科克领导的渔民保护联盟组成，成功连任。由约翰·R·贝内特领导的自由党—工党—进步党组成反对派。

en.s: The 1927 Wellington mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that same year. In 1927, elections were held for the Mayor of Wellington plus other local government positions including fifteen councillors. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method.

zh.s: 1927年惠灵顿市长选举是新西兰当年的地方选举之一。除惠灵顿市长外，选举还改选其他地方政府职位，包括15名市议员。投票采用常规的得票最多者当选制。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: General elections were held in Liberia in 1927. In the presidential election the result was a victory for Charles D. B. King of the True Whig Party, who was re-elected for a third term after defeating Thomas J. R. Faulkner of the People's Party. Faulkner had previously served as the mayor of Monrovia, and ran a campaign based on reform of labor laws.

zh.s: 利比里亚于1927年举行大选。总统选举中，真实辉格党候选人查尔斯·D·B·金击败人民党候选人托马斯·J·R·福克纳，再次当选，开始第三个任期。福克纳曾任蒙罗维亚市长，竞选主张改革劳动法。

en.s: The 1927 Baltimore mayoral election saw the return of William Frederick Broening to the mayoralty for a second nonconsecutive term.

zh.s: 1927年巴尔的摩市长选举中，威廉·弗雷德里克·布罗宁再度当选市长，开启第二个非连续任期。

en.t: The Jinan incident begins with the deaths of twelve Japanese civilians by Chinese forces in Jinan, China, which leads to Japanese retaliation and the deaths of over 2,000 Chinese civilians in the following days
en.s: The Jinan incident (traditional Chinese: 濟南慘案; simplified Chinese: 济南惨案; Japanese: 済南事件; formerly romanised Tsinan) or 3 May Tragedy (traditional Chinese: 五三慘案; simplified Chinese: 五三惨案; pinyin: Wǔsān Cǎn'àn) began as a 3 May 1928 dispute between Chiang Kai-shek's National Revolutionary Army (NRA) and Japanese soldiers and civilians in Jinan, the capital of Shandong province in China, which then escalated into an armed conflict between the NRA and the Imperial Japanese Army.

zh.s: 济南惨案又称“五三惨案”，于1928年5月3日开始。当时，在中国山东省省会济南，蒋介石领导的国民革命军与日本士兵及平民发生冲突，随后升级为国民革命军与日本帝国陆军之间的武装冲突。

en.s: The 1931 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade Olympique Yves-du-Manoir, Colombes on May 3, 1931, that saw Club Français defeat SO Montpellier 3–0 thanks to a goal by Miklos Boros, Arthur Parkes and Robert MercierMercier.

zh.s: 1931年法国杯决赛于1931年5月3日在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦尔奥林匹克体育场举行。法国人俱乐部以3比0击败蒙彼利埃体育奥林匹克队，米克洛什·博罗斯、阿瑟·帕克斯和罗贝尔·梅西耶各进一球。

en.s: The 1933 Christchurch mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that same year. In 1933, election were held for the Mayor of Christchurch plus 16 councillors and other local government positions.

zh.s: 1933年基督城市长选举是新西兰当年的地方选举之一。除基督城市长外，选举还改选16名市议员和其他地方政府职位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1933 Lower Hutt mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that same year. The elections were held for the role of Mayor of Lower Hutt plus other local government positions including the nine borough councillors, also elected biennially. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method.

zh.s: 1933年下哈特市长选举是新西兰当年的地方选举之一。除下哈特市长外，选举还改选其他地方政府职位，包括9名每两年改选一次的自治市议员。投票采用常规的得票最多者当选制。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1933 Invercargill mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that same year. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method. This was the final mayoral election for a biennial term, future terms would be triennial. Incumbent mayor John Miller defeated former mayor John D. Campbell again for his second consecutive term, the third in total.

zh.s: 1933年因弗卡吉尔市长选举是新西兰当年的地方选举之一，投票采用常规的得票最多者当选制。这是最后一次举行两年一届的市长选举，此后任期改为三年。现任市长约翰·米勒击败前市长约翰·D·坎贝尔，再次当选，连续第二次、总计第三次担任市长。

en.s: French legislative elections to elect the 16th legislature of the French Third Republic were held on 26 April and 3 May 1936. This was the last legislature of the Third Republic and the last election before World War II. The number of candidates set a record, with 4,807 people vying for 618 seats in the Chamber of Deputies. In the Seine Department alone, there were 1,402 candidates.

zh.s: 法国于1936年4月26日和5月3日举行立法选举，选出法兰西第三共和国第16届议会。这是第三共和国最后一届议会，也是第二次世界大战前最后一次选举。候选人人数创下纪录，4,807人竞选众议院618个席位。仅塞纳省就有1,402名候选人。

en.s: The 1936 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade Olympique Yves-du-Manoir, Colombes on 3 May 1936, that saw RC Paris defeat FCO Charleville 1–0 thanks to a goal by Roger Couard.

zh.s: 1936年法国杯决赛于1936年5月3日在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦尔奥林匹克体育场举行。巴黎竞赛俱乐部以1比0击败沙勒维尔足球俱乐部，罗歇·夸尔打入全场唯一进球。

en.t: The All India Forward Bloc is formed by Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose
en.s: The All India Forward Bloc (AIFB) is a left-wing nationalist political party in India. It emerged as a faction within the Indian National Congress in 1939, led by Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose, and was strongest in West Bengal. The party re-established as an independent political party after the independence of India. During the 1951–1952 and 1957 Indian general election, the party was known as Forward Bloc.

zh.t: 苏巴斯·钱德拉·鲍斯成立全印度前进同盟
zh.s: 全印度前进同盟（AIFB）是印度的一个左翼民族主义政党。该党于1939年由内塔吉·苏巴斯·钱德拉·鲍斯领导，在印度国民大会党内作为一个派系出现，在西孟加拉邦势力最强。印度独立后，该党重建为独立政党。在1951—1952年和1957年印度大选期间，该党称为“前进同盟”。

en.s: The invasion of Tulagi, on 3–4 May 1942, was part of Operation Mo, the Empire of Japan's strategy in the South Pacific and South West Pacific Area in 1942. The plan called for Imperial Japanese Navy troops to capture Tulagi and nearby islands in the British Solomon Islands Protectorate. The occupation of Tulagi by the Japanese was intended to cover the flank of and provide reconnaissance support for Japanese forces that were advancing on Port Moresby in New Guinea, provide greater defensive depth for the major Japanese base at Rabaul, and serve as a base for Japanese forces to threaten and interdict the supply and communication routes between the United States and Australia and New Zealand.

zh.s: 图拉吉岛入侵发生于1942年5月3日至4日，是日本帝国在1942年西南太平洋战略“MO作战”的一部分。计划要求日本海军部队占领英国所辖所罗门群岛保护地内的图拉吉岛及附近岛屿。日本占领图拉吉岛，是为了掩护侧翼并为向新几内亚莫尔兹比港推进的日军提供侦察支援，加强拉包尔日军主要基地的防御纵深，并以此为基地威胁和切断美国与澳大利亚、新西兰之间的补给和通信线路。

en.s: Ramrod 16 was an attempt by the Royal Air Force (RAF) to bomb the Koninklijke Hoogovens (Royal Blast Furnaces) steelworks at IJmuiden in the Netherlands during the Second World War. After several recent abortive attacks a more elaborate plan was made for six Douglas Boston IIIA light bombers of 107 Squadron to attack again, with a Ramrod as a diversion. (Ramrod was the RAF term for bomber operations intended to induce Luftwaffe fighters into action for British fighter escorts to attack.) Ramrod 16 was to be flown by twelve Lockheed Ventura Mk II bombers of No. 487 Squadron RNZAF against the Hemweg power station in Amsterdam, not far upriver from IJmuiden. Thirteen Spitfire squadrons from 11 Group, Fighter Command, were to fly Rodeo 212 to Vlissingen (Flushing), 78 mi (126 km) to the south-west of Amsterdam, as another diversion. The Venturas were to be escorted by three squadrons of Spitfires from 12 Group, Fighter Command. Two squadrons of high-flying Spitfire Mk IXs were to wait off the Dutch coast, available for contingencies and eight Mustang fighters were to protect the Bostons on their return from IJmuiden, three more Spitfire squadrons covering the return of the Venturas. The raid began in the late afternoon of 3 May 1943 but Rodeo 212 arrived early and at height, alerting the Germans.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，英国皇家空军（RAF）曾试图轰炸荷兰艾默伊登的Koninklijke Hoogovens（皇家高炉）钢铁厂。此前几次空袭都未成功，英军于是制定了更周密的计划：第107中队出动6架道格拉斯Boston IIIA轻型轰炸机再次发动攻击，并以一次Ramrod行动作为佯攻。Ramrod是皇家空军对轰炸行动的称呼，目的是引诱德国空军战斗机出动，再由护航的英国战斗机攻击。Ramrod 16计划由新西兰皇家空军第487中队的12架洛克希德Ventura Mk II轰炸机执行，目标是阿姆斯特丹的Hemweg发电站，那里距艾默伊登沿河上游不远。战斗机司令部第11大队的13个喷火战斗机中队将飞往弗利辛恩（弗利辛根），执行Rodeo 212佯攻；该地位于阿姆斯特丹西南78英里（126公里）处。Ventura轰炸机由战斗机司令部第12大队的3个喷火战斗机中队护航。另有两个装备高空型Spitfire Mk IX的中队在荷兰海岸外待命，以应对突发情况；8架Mustang战斗机负责保护从艾默伊登返航的Boston轰炸机，另有3个喷火战斗机中队掩护Ventura轰炸机返航。空袭于1943年5月3日下午较晚时分开始，但Rodeo 212提前抵达且飞行高度较高，惊动了德军。

en.s: The Capture of Hamburg was one of the last battles of the Western Front of the Second World War, where the remaining troops of the German 1st Parachute Army fought the British XII Corps in Lower Saxony for the control of Hamburg, Germany, between 18 April and 3 May 1945. British troops were met with fierce resistance when they advanced toward the city as Hamburg was the last remaining pocket of resistance in the north.

zh.s: 汉堡陷落是第二次世界大战西线最后几场战役之一。1945年4月18日至5月3日，德国第一伞兵军残部在下萨克森与英国第十二军团作战，争夺德国汉堡。英国部队向市区推进时遭到激烈抵抗，因为汉堡是德国北部最后一处仍在抵抗的据点。

en.t: World War II: Sinking of the prison ships Cap Arcona, Thielbek and Deutschland by the Royal Air Force in Lübeck Bay, resulting in more than 7,000 deaths
en.s: SS Cap Arcona, named after Cape Arkona on the island of Rügen, was a large German ocean liner, later a requisitioned auxiliary ship of the Kriegsmarine (Nazi German War Navy), and finally a prison ship in the later months of World War II (1939–1945).

zh.t: 第二次世界大战：英国皇家空军在吕贝克湾击沉“卡普阿尔科纳”号、“蒂尔贝克”号和“德国”号囚船，造成 7,000 多人死亡
zh.s: “卡普阿尔科纳”号以吕根岛的阿科纳角命名，是一艘大型德国远洋客轮，后来被德国海军征用为辅助船只，最终在第二次世界大战后期成为囚船。

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 3 May 1947 to elect the 62 members of the state's Legislative Assembly. The election was the first that the Labor government had contested under Premier Ned Hanlon, who had been in office for 14 months by the time of the poll. The election resulted in Labor receiving a sixth term in office.

zh.s: 澳大利亚昆士兰州于1947年5月3日举行选举，选出州立法议会的62名议员。这是内德·汉隆出任州长后，工党政府首次参加选举；投票时他已任职14个月。选举后，工党开始第六个执政任期。

en.s: The 1947 New South Wales state election was held on 3 May 1947. It was conducted in single member constituencies with compulsory preferential voting and was held on boundaries created at a 1940 redistribution. The election was for all of the 90 seats in the Legislative Assembly.

zh.s: 1947年新南威尔士州选举于5月3日举行。选举采用单席位选区和强制优先投票制，选区边界沿用1940年重新划分后的方案。州立法议会全部90个席位改选。

en.s: The Constitution of Japan is the supreme law of Japan. Written primarily by American civilian officials during the occupation of Japan after World War II, it was adopted on 3 November 1946 and came into effect on 3 May 1947, succeeding the Meiji Constitution of 1889. The constitution consists of a preamble and 103 articles grouped into 11 chapters.
en.n: This entry records the entry into force, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 日本国宪法是日本的最高法律，主要由日本被占领期间的美国文职官员起草。宪法于1946年11月3日通过，并于1947年5月3日生效，取代1889年的《明治宪法》。宪法由序言和11章103条组成。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框标注的生效日期。

en.s: Operation Yevusi (Hebrew: מבצע יבוסי; Eng. "Jebusite"), also known as the Second Battle of Nebi Samwil, was a Palmach military operation carried out during the 1948 Arab–Israeli War to assert Jewish control over Jerusalem. The operation, commanded by Yitzhak Sadeh, lasted two weeks, from 22 April 1948 to 3 May 1948. Not all objectives were achieved before the British enforced a ceasefire.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 耶布西行动（希伯来语：מבצע יבוסי；英文：Jebusite），又称内比萨穆维尔第二次战役，是1948年阿以战争期间帕尔马赫部队为确立犹太人对耶路撒冷的控制而实施的一次军事行动。行动由伊扎克·萨德指挥，持续两周，从1948年4月22日到5月3日。英国实施停火前，行动目标并未全部实现。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: Shelley v. Kraemer, 334 U.S. 1 (1948), is a landmark United States Supreme Court case that held that racially restrictive housing covenants (deed restrictions) cannot legally be enforced. The case arose after an African-American family purchased a house in St. Louis that was subject to a restrictive covenant preventing "people of the Negro or Mongolian Race" from occupying the property.
en.n: This entry records the decision, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 雪莱诉克雷默案，334 U.S. 1（1948），是美国最高法院的一宗里程碑式案件。法院裁定，带有种族限制条款的住房契约（房契限制）不能依法强制执行。此案源于一个非裔美国家庭在圣路易斯购买了一处房屋；该房契禁止“黑人或蒙古人种”居住。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框标注的判决日期。

en.s: An election to the Aberdeen Corporation was held on 3 May 1949, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. 12 of the corporation's 37 seats were up for election. The election saw Labour retain their control over the corporation, although tenuously. Leading up to the election, Labour councillor Robert S. Lennox had the whip withdrawn, and was sitting as an independent.

zh.s: 阿伯丁公司选举于1949年5月3日举行，与苏格兰各地市政选举同期进行。公司37个席位中有12席改选。工党保住了对公司的控制，但优势不大。选举前，工党议员罗伯特·S·伦诺克斯被撤销党鞭，之后以独立议员身份任职。

en.s: The Royal Festival Hall is a 2,700-seat concert, dance and talks venue within Southbank Centre in London, England. It is situated on the South Bank of the River Thames, not far from Hungerford Bridge, in the London Borough of Lambeth. It is a Grade I listed building, the first post-war building to become so protected (in 1981). The London Philharmonic Orchestra, the Philharmonia Orchestra, the Orchestra of the Age of Enlightenment, the London Sinfonietta, Chineke! and Aurora are resident orchestras at Southbank Centre. The hall was built as part of the Festival of Britain for London County Council, and was officially opened on 3 May 1951.

zh.s: 皇家节日音乐厅位于英国伦敦南岸中心内，可容纳2,700人，用于举办音乐会、舞蹈演出和讲座。音乐厅位于泰晤士河南岸、兰贝斯伦敦自治市内，距亨格福德桥不远。它是一级登录建筑，也是战后第一座获此保护级别的建筑（1981年列入）。南岸中心的常驻乐团包括伦敦爱乐乐团、爱乐乐团、启蒙时代管弦乐团、伦敦小交响乐团、奇内克乐团和极光乐团。音乐厅由伦敦郡议会为不列颠节兴建，并于1951年5月3日正式开放。

en.s: The 1952 FA Cup final was the final match of the 1951–52 staging of the Football Association Challenge Cup (better known as the FA Cup), English football's main cup competition. The match was contested by Newcastle United and Arsenal at Wembley Stadium in London on 3 May 1952. Newcastle, who were the defending champions, won the match 1–0.

zh.s: 1952年英格兰足总杯决赛是1951—52赛季英格兰足总杯的决赛，也是英格兰主要的足球杯赛决赛。纽卡斯尔联队和阿森纳队于1952年5月3日在伦敦温布利球场争夺冠军。卫冕冠军纽卡斯尔联队以1比0获胜。

en.s: The Kentucky Derby () is an American Grade I stakes race run at Churchill Downs in Louisville, Kentucky. The race is run by three-year-old Thoroughbreds at a distance of 1+1⁄4 miles (10 furlongs; 2,012 metres). Colts and geldings carry 126 pounds (57 kilograms) and fillies 121 pounds (55 kilograms).
en.n: On May 3, 1952, the first national television coverage of the Kentucky Derby took place, aired from then-CBS affiliate WHAS-TV.

zh.s: 肯塔基赛马会是美国一级赛马赛事，在肯塔基州路易维尔丘吉尔园赛马场举行。参赛马匹是三岁纯血马，赛程为1又1/4英里（10弗隆；2,012米）。雄马和阉马负重126磅（57公斤），雌马负重121磅（55公斤）。
zh.n: 1952年5月3日，肯塔基赛马会首次通过全国电视播出，由当时的哥伦比亚广播公司附属电视台WHAS-TV转播。

en.s: The Battle of Hill 187 was a battle between Canadian and Chinese forces during the Korean War which took place north of the city of Gapyeong. The Battle of Hill 187 was one of the last battles of the Korean War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 187高地战役是朝鲜战争期间加拿大军队与中国军队在加平市以北进行的一场战斗。这是朝鲜战争接近尾声时发生的战役之一。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: An election to the Aberdeen Corporation was held on 3 May 1955, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. 12 of the corporation's 37 seats were up for election, although only 8 were contested. This election maintained the status quo of the last few years, with no seats changing hands and a further decrease in turnout resulting in another record low.

zh.s: 阿伯丁公司选举于1955年5月3日举行，与苏格兰各地市政选举同期进行。公司37个席位中有12席改选，但只有8席有候选人竞争。选举维持了前几年的席位格局，没有席位易手；投票率进一步下降，再次创下历史新低。

en.s: General elections were held in Liberia in May 1955. For the first time since 1931 there was more than one candidate in the presidential election. However, William Tubman of the True Whig Party was easily re-elected, winning over 99.5% of the vote. After the election, Edwin Barclay claimed ballot stuffing due to the purported number of votes cast being higher than the number of registered voters.

zh.s: 利比里亚于1955年5月举行大选。这是1931年以来总统选举首次有多名候选人参选。真实辉格党候选人威廉·塔布曼轻松连任，得票率超过99.5%。选举后，埃德温·巴克利声称选举存在填票行为，理由是据称投票人数超过登记选民人数。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1955 Baltimore mayoral election saw reelection of Thomas D'Alesandro Jr. to a third consecutive term as mayor.

zh.s: 1955年巴尔的摩市长选举中，托马斯·达莱桑德罗二世再次当选，开始连续第三个市长任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1958 FA Cup final was contested on 3 May 1958 by Bolton Wanderers and Manchester United at Wembley Stadium, London, in front of a crowd of almost 100,000. The referee was J. Sherlock. Bolton won 2–0, with a double by Nat Lofthouse, who scored the goals in the 3rd and 55th minutes.

zh.s: 1958年英格兰足总杯决赛于1958年5月3日在伦敦温布利球场举行，博尔顿流浪者队对阵曼彻斯特联队，现场观众近10万人。裁判是J·舍洛克。博尔顿以2比0获胜，纳特·洛夫特豪斯在第3分钟和第55分钟梅开二度。

en.s: The 1960 Alabama Democratic presidential elector primary was held on May 3, 1960, with a runoff on May 31, 1960, to choose the eleven nominees for presidential electors to be listed on the general election ballot under the Democratic party label in the 1960 United States presidential election in Alabama. This election is not to be confused with the 1960 Alabama Democratic presidential primary, which chose delegates to the Democratic National Convention.

zh.t: 1960年阿拉巴马州民主党总统选举人初选
zh.s: 1960年阿拉巴马州民主党总统选举人初选于1960年5月3日举行，决选于5月31日举行，选出11名总统选举人候选人，列入1960年美国总统选举阿拉巴马州选票的民主党名下。本次选举不要与1960年阿拉巴马州民主党总统初选混淆；后者选出参加民主党全国代表大会的代表。

en.s: A presidential primary was held in the U.S. state of Alabama on May 3, 1960, with runoff elections on May 31, to elect delegates representing Alabama to the 1960 Democratic National Convention. Fifty-six delegates were to be elected, four from each of the state's nine congressional districts, with twenty at-large delegates to be elected.

zh.t: 1960年阿拉巴马州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 美国阿拉巴马州于1960年5月3日举行总统初选，决选于5月31日举行，选出代表阿拉巴马州参加1960年民主党全国代表大会的代表。共选出56名代表：该州9个国会选区各选出4名，另选出20名全州代表。

en.s: Elections to Edinburgh Corporation were held on 3 May 1960, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. Of the councils 69 seats, 24 were up for election, including two seats in Murrayfield-Cramond ward. However only 15 wards in 14 seats were contested, as councillors were returned unopposed in nine wards. No seats changed hands, and Edinburgh Corporation remained composed of 39 Progressives, 28 Labour councillors, 1 Liberal, and 1 Protestant Action.

zh.s: 爱丁堡公司选举于1960年5月3日举行，与苏格兰各地市政选举同期进行。公司69个席位中有24席改选，包括莫里菲尔德—克拉蒙德选区的两个席位。但只有15个选区中的14席有候选人竞争，另有9个选区的议员因无人竞争而自动当选。没有席位易手，爱丁堡公司的席位分布仍为进步党39席、工党28席、自由党1席和新教行动党1席。

en.s: The 14th Cannes Film Festival was held on 3-18 May 1961. The Palme d'Or went to the Une aussi longue absence, directed by Henri Colpi and Viridiana, directed by Luis Buñuel. The festival opened with Che gioia vivere, directed by René Clément. The festival also screened Shirley Clarke's debut film The Connection due to the efforts of the French Syndicate of Cinema Critics.

zh.s: 第14届戛纳电影节于1961年5月3日至18日举行。亨利·科尔皮执导的《漫长的缺席》（Une aussi longue absence）和路易斯·布努埃尔执导的《维莉迪安娜》获金棕榈奖。电影节以勒内·克莱芒执导的《Che gioia vivere》开幕。在法国电影评论家工会推动下，电影节还放映了雪莉·克拉克的导演处女作《The Connection》。

en.s: The 18th Cannes Film Festival was held on May 3-16, 1965. Olivia de Havilland became the first women president of the jury. The Grand Prix du Festival International du Film went to The Knack …and How to Get It by Richard Lester. The festival opened with The Collector, directed by William Wyler and closed with Tōkyō Orinpikku, directed by Kon Ichikawa.

zh.s: 第18届戛纳电影节于1965年5月3日至16日举行。奥利维娅·德哈维兰成为首位担任评审团主席的女性。理查德·莱斯特执导的《The Knack …and How to Get It》获国际电影节大奖。电影节以威廉·惠勒执导的《The Collector》开幕，并以今村昌平执导的《东京奥林匹克》闭幕。

en.s: An election to the Edinburgh Corporation was held on 3 May 1966, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. Of the councils 69 seats, 23 were up for election. After the election, Edinburgh Corporation was composed of 36 Progressives, 33 Labour councillors, and 1 Liberal. The Progressives increased their majority to three seats.

zh.s: 爱丁堡公司选举于1966年5月3日举行，与苏格兰各地市政选举同期进行。公司69个席位中有23席改选。选举后，席位分布为进步党36席、工党33席、自由党1席。进步党的多数优势扩大至3席。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in South Korea on 3 May 1967. The result was a victory for Park Chung-hee, who won 51.4% of the vote. Voter turnout was 83.6%.

zh.s: 韩国于1967年5月3日举行总统选举。朴正熙获胜，得票率为51.4%。投票率为83.6%。

en.s: Braniff International Airways Flight 352 was a scheduled domestic flight from William P. Hobby Airport in Houston, Texas, United States, to Dallas Love Field in Dallas. On May 3, 1968, a Lockheed L-188A Electra flying on the route, registration N9707C, disintegrated in midair and crashed near Dawson, Texas, after flying into a severe thunderstorm. It was carrying five crew and 80 passengers, all of whom were killed, including Texas state representative Joseph Lockridge.

zh.t: 布兰尼夫国际航空352号班机空难
zh.s: 布兰尼夫国际航空352号班机是一趟定期国内航班，从美国得克萨斯州休斯敦的威廉·P·霍比机场飞往达拉斯的达拉斯爱田机场。1968年5月3日，注册号N9707C的洛克希德L-188A“伊莱克特拉”客机在该航线上飞行时遇到强烈雷暴，在空中解体并坠毁于得克萨斯州道森附近。机上5名机组人员和80名乘客全部遇难，其中包括得克萨斯州众议员约瑟夫·洛克里奇。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 3 May 1972. One seat in each of the forty wards was up for election, plus one by-election seat each in Vauxhall and Woolton wards. This was the last year when the council comprised 120 councillors and 40 Aldermen, totalling 160, which was the largest council membership .

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于1972年5月3日举行。40个选区各有1席改选，沃克斯豪尔和伍尔顿选区还各举行1场补选。这是利物浦市议会最后一次由120名议员和40名市参事组成，共有160名成员，为该议会人数最多的一次。

en.s: The 1975 Scottish Cup Final was played on 3 May 1975 at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the 90th final of the Scottish Cup. Celtic and Airdrieonians contested the match: Celtic won the match 3–1 with goals from Paul Wilson (two) and a Pat McCluskey penalty; Kevin McCann scoring Airdrieonians’ goal. The game was Celtic's seventh successive appearance in the final, it was also Celtic's 25th Scottish Cup.

zh.s: 1975年苏格兰杯决赛于1975年5月3日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，是第90届苏格兰杯决赛。凯尔特人队对阵艾尔德里奥尼安斯队，以3比1获胜。保罗·威尔逊打入两球，帕特·麦克拉斯基罚入一粒点球；凯文·麦坎为艾尔德里奥尼安斯攻入一球。这是凯尔特人连续第七次闯入决赛，也是该队第25次夺得苏格兰杯。

en.s: The 1975 FA Cup final was the 94th final of the FA Cup. It took place on 3 May 1975 at Wembley Stadium and was contested by London clubs West Ham United and Fulham. The Fulham team contained two former England captains in former West Ham United captain Bobby Moore, making his last appearance at Wembley, and Alan Mullery.

zh.s: 1975年英格兰足总杯决赛是第94届足总杯决赛，于1975年5月3日在温布利球场举行。伦敦球队西汉姆联队和富勒姆队争夺冠军。富勒姆队有两名前英格兰队长：前西汉姆联队长博比·摩尔最后一次在温布利出场，另一位是艾伦·马尔里。

en.t: City of Edinburgh District Council election, 1977
en.s: Elections for the City of Edinburgh District Council took place on 3 May 1977, alongside elections to the councils of Scotland's various other districts. These was the second election to the City of Edinburgh District Council, and saw the Conservatives winning 34 of the Councils 64 seats; allowing them to emerge with a majority administration.

en.t: 1977 City of Glasgow District Council election
en.s: Elections for the City of Glasgow District Council took place on 3 May 1977, alongside elections to the councils of Scotland's various other districts. These were the second elections to the City of Glasgow District Council, and saw Labour losing their control of the council, losing nearly half of their councillors. Among the losing councillors was Dick Dynes, the Labour group leader.

zh.s: 格拉斯哥市区议会选举于1977年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地区的议会选举同期进行。这是格拉斯哥市区议会的第二次选举。工党失去对议会的控制，议员人数减少近一半。失利者包括工党团体领袖迪克·戴恩斯。

en.t: 1977 Kilmarnock and Loudoun District Council election
en.s: Elections to Kilmarnock and Loudoun District Council were held on 3 May 1977, on the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. This was the second election to the district council following the local government reforms in 1974. The election used the original 16 wards created by the Formation Electoral Arrangements in 1974. Each ward elected one councillor using first-past-the-post voting.

zh.t: 1977年基尔马诺克和劳登区议会选举

en.t: 1977 Kincardine and Deeside District Council election
en.s: Elections to the Kincardine and Deeside District Council took place on 3 May 1977, alongside elections to the councils of Scotland's various other districts. There were 12 single member wards, each electing a single member using the first-past-the-post voting system.

en.s: Elections for the Scottish district councils were held in 1977. These were the second elections held to the 53 district councils established by the Local Government (Scotland) Act 1973. The previous elections had been held in 1974 with the authorities acting as "shadow" councils until May 1975. The elections took place when the Labour government of James Callaghan was extremely unpopular, with a subsequent collapse in the party's vote.

zh.s: 1977年苏格兰区议会选举是根据《1973年苏格兰地方政府法》设立的53个区议会举行的第二次选举。上一次选举于1974年举行，这些地方政府机构在1975年5月前作为“影子”议会运作。选举举行时，詹姆斯·卡拉汉领导的工党政府极不受欢迎，工党的得票率随后大幅下跌。

en.t: 1977 Annandale and Eskdale District Council election
en.s: The 1977 Annandale and Eskdale District Council election was part of the 1977 Scottish local elections. This was the second election held under the new double-tiered system of the Local Government (Scotland) Act 1973. Annandale and Eskdale is an area of Dumfries and Galloway and was covered by the Annandale and Eskdale District Council and the Dumfries and Galloway Regional Council.

en.s: The 1978 European Cup Winners' Cup Final was a football match contested between Anderlecht of Belgium and Austria Wien of Austria. It was the final match of the 1977–78 European Cup Winners' Cup and the 18th European Cup Winners' Cup final. The final was held at Parc des Princes in Paris, France, on 3 May 1978. The venue was selected in Bern by the UEFA Executive Committee on 20 September 1977.

zh.s: 1978年欧洲优胜者杯决赛由比利时安德莱赫特队对阵奥地利维也纳队，是1977—78赛季欧洲优胜者杯的决赛，也是该赛事第18届决赛。比赛于1978年5月3日在法国巴黎王子公园球场举行。欧足联执行委员会于1977年9月20日在伯尔尼选定该场地。

en.s: The United Kingdom general election of 1979 was held on 3 May 1979 to elect 635 members to the British House of Commons. The Conservative Party, led by Margaret Thatcher, ousted the incumbent Labour government of James Callaghan with a parliamentary majority of 44 seats. The election was the first of four consecutive election victories for the Conservative Party, and Thatcher became the United Kingdom's and Europe's first elected female head of government. The previous parliamentary term had begun in October 1974, when Harold Wilson led Labour to a majority of three seats, but within 18 months he had resigned as prime minister to be succeeded by James Callaghan, and within a year the government's narrow parliamentary majority had gone.

zh.s: 1979年英国大选于5月3日举行，选出635名下议院议员。玛格丽特·撒切尔领导的保守党击败詹姆斯·卡拉汉领导的现任工党政府，并在议会取得44席多数。这是保守党连续四次赢得大选中的第一次，撒切尔也成为英国及欧洲首位经选举产生的女性政府首脑。上一届议会任期始于1974年10月，当时哈罗德·威尔逊领导工党取得3席多数；不到18个月后，他辞去首相职务，由卡拉汉接任。又过不到一年，工党原本微弱的议会多数也不复存在。

en.s: Elections to Manchester Council were held on Thursday, 3 May 1979, on the same day as the 1979 UK General Election. One third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a three-year term of office, expiring in 1982, due to the boundary changes and "all-out" elections due to take place that year. The Labour Party retained overall control of the council.

Labour retained control of the council.

zh.t: 1979年巴恩斯利都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 巴恩斯利都市自治市议会选举于1979年5月3日与英国大选同时举行。选区边界调整后，选区数量增加两个，达到22个，席位总数也增加6个，达到66席；议会全部席位均进行改选。工党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 1979 Bracknell District Council election took place on 3 May 1979, to elect all 40 members in 19 wards for Bracknell Forest Borough Council in England. The election was held on the same day as both the 1979 United Kingdom general election and other local elections as part of the 1979 United Kingdom local elections.

zh.s: 1979年布拉克内尔区议会选举于5月3日举行，改选英格兰布拉克内尔森林自治市议会19个选区的全部40个席位。选举与1979年英国大选及其他地方选举同日举行，属于1979年英国地方选举的一部分。

en.s: The 1979 Bath City Council election was held on Thursday 3 May 1979 to elect councillors to Bath City Council in England. It took place on the same day as the general election and other district council elections in the United Kingdom. One third of seats were up for election.

zh.s: 1979年巴斯市议会选举于1979年5月3日星期四举行，选出英格兰巴斯市议会议员。选举与英国大选及其他地区议会选举同日进行，议会三分之一席位改选。

en.s: The 1979 Stevenage Borough Council election took place on 3 May 1979. This was on the same day as other local elections. The entire council was up for election and the Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.t: 1979年史蒂夫尼奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1979年史蒂夫尼奇自治市议会选举于1979年5月3日举行，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会全部席位改选，工党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 1979 Reading Borough Council election was held on 3 May 1979, alongside local elections across England and Wales and the general election. All 49 seats on Reading Borough Council were contested. Prior to the election, the council had been under no overall control, with the Conservatives the largest party. Labour saw the biggest net increase in its seats, gaining three, but the council remained under no overall control with the Conservatives as the largest party.

zh.s: 1979年雷丁自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，与英格兰和威尔士各地的地方选举及英国大选同日进行。雷丁自治市议会49个席位全部改选。选举前，议会无人取得绝对多数，保守党是最大党。工党的席位净增幅最大，增加3席，但选后议会仍无人取得绝对多数，保守党仍是最大党。

en.s: The 1979 Chelmsford Borough Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of Chelmsford Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as the 1979 general election and other local elections.

zh.t: 1979年切姆斯福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1979年切姆斯福德自治市议会选举于1979年5月3日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡切姆斯福德自治市议会议员。选举与英国大选及其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1979 Bournemouth Borough Council election was held on 3 May 1979 to elect members to Bournemouth Borough Council in Dorset, England. This was on the same day as other local elections and the 1979 general election. The whole council was elected on new ward boundaries. The Conservatives won a majority of seats on the council.

zh.t: 1979年伯恩茅斯自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1979年伯恩茅斯自治市议会选举于1979年5月3日举行，选出英格兰多塞特郡伯恩茅斯自治市议会议员。选举与其他地方选举及英国大选同日进行。议会全部席位按照新的选区边界改选。保守党赢得议会多数席位。

en.s: The 1979 South Norfolk District Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of South Norfolk District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as the 1979 general election and other local elections. The council was contested on new ward boundaries, but the number of seats remained the same.

zh.s: 1979年南诺福克区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡南诺福克区议会议员。选举与1979年英国大选及其他地方选举同日举行。此次选举采用新的选区边界，但席位数量没有变化。

en.s: The 1979 Corby District Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of Corby District Council in Northamptonshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party regained overall control of the council which it had lost to the Conservative Party at the previous election in 1976. The council remained continuously under Labour control until the council was dissolved in 2021.

zh.s: 1979年科比区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰北安普敦郡科比区议会议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。工党重新取得议会控制权；它在1976年上次选举中输给保守党。此后工党一直控制议会，直至该议会于2021年解散。

en.s: The 1979 Basildon District Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of Basildon District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. It was the first election to be held on new ward boundaries. The council remained under no overall control.

zh.s: 1979年巴西尔登区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡巴西尔登区议会议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行，也是首次采用新的选区边界。选后议会仍无人取得绝对多数。

en.s: The 1979 Plymouth City Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of Plymouth City Council in Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. It was the first election to be held under new ward boundaries. The Conservative Party retained control of the council, which it had held since its creation in 1973.

zh.s: 1979年普利茅斯市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰德文郡普利茅斯市议会议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行，也是普利茅斯市议会首次采用新的选区边界。保守党继续控制议会；自1973年议会成立以来，保守党一直执政。

en.s: The 1979 Harlow District Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of Harlow District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.s: 1979年哈洛区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡哈洛区议会议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行，工党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 1979 Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1979年威勒尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1979年威勒尔都市自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰威勒尔都市自治市议会议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1979 North Norfolk District Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of North Norfolk District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as the 1979 general election and other local elections. The council was contested on new ward boundaries, decreasing the number of seats by 1 to 46.

zh.s: 1979年北诺福克区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡北诺福克区议会议员。选举与1979年英国大选及其他地方选举同日举行。此次选举采用新的选区边界，席位减少1个，降至46席。

en.t: 1979 United Kingdom general election in England
en.s: On Thursday 3 May 1979, the 1979 United Kingdom general election was held in England, to elect all 635 members of the House of Commons, with 516 constituencies being in England. The Conservative Party under Margaret Thatcher won the most votes and seats in England, and gained a parliamentary majority of 43 seats across the country. They received 12.26 million English votes, a record at the time.

zh.s: 1979年英国大选于5月3日星期四在英格兰举行，选出下议院全部635名议员，其中516个选区位于英格兰。玛格丽特·撒切尔领导的保守党在英格兰赢得最多选票和席位，并在全国取得43席的议会多数。保守党在英格兰获得1,226万张选票，创下当时的纪录。

en.s: The 1979 York City Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of York City Council in North Yorkshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1979年约克市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰北约克郡约克市议会议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1979 East Northamptonshire District Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of East Northamptonshire District Council in Northamptonshire, England. This was on the same day as the 1979 General Election and other local elections. This was the first election to be held under new ward boundaries. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council which it had held since the council's creation in 1973.

zh.t: 1979年东北安普敦郡区议会选举
zh.s: 1979年东北安普敦郡区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰北安普敦郡东北安普敦郡区议会议员。选举与1979年英国大选及其他地方选举同日举行，也是首次采用新的选区边界。保守党继续控制议会；自1973年议会成立以来一直如此。

en.s: The 1979 Tendring District Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of Tendring District Council in England. This was the same day as the 1979 general election and other local elections held across the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 1979年滕德灵区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰滕德灵区议会议员。选举与1979年英国大选及英国各地其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: Elections to Chichester District Council in West Sussex, United Kingdom were held on 3 May 1979, the same day as the general election. The whole council was up for election and resulted in a Conservative majority.

zh.s: 奇切斯特区议会选举于1979年5月3日在英国西萨塞克斯郡举行，与英国大选同日进行。议会全部席位改选，结果是保守党取得多数。

en.s: The 1979 Thurrock Borough Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of Thurrock Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England and the 1979 general election. The whole council was up for election on new ward boundaries. Labour lost control of the council to No overall control.

zh.s: 1979年瑟罗克自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡瑟罗克自治市议会议员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举及1979年英国大选同日举行。议会全部席位按新的选区边界改选。工党失去对议会的控制权，选后无人取得绝对多数。

en.s: The 1979 Rochford District Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of Rochford District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as the 1979 general election and other local elections.

zh.s: 1979年罗奇福德区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡罗奇福德区议会议员。选举与1979年英国大选及其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1979 Breckland District Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of Breckland District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The council was contested on new ward boundaries, increasing the number of seats by 2 to 53.

zh.s: 1979年布雷克兰区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡布雷克兰区议会议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。此次选举采用新的选区边界，席位增加2个，达到53席。

en.s: The 1979 Braintree District Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of Braintree District Council in England. This was on the same day as the 1979 UK general election and other local elections across the United Kingdom. At the election, the Conservatives lost control of the council to no overall control despite remaining the largest party.

zh.s: 1979年布伦特里区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰布伦特里区议会议员。选举与1979年英国大选及英国各地其他地方选举同日进行。选后，保守党失去议会控制权，议会无人取得绝对多数，但保守党仍是最大党。

en.t: 1979 United Kingdom general election in Wales
en.s: On Thursday 3 May 1979, the 1979 United Kingdom general election was held in Wales, to elect all 635 members of the House of Commons, with 36 constituencies being in Wales. The election saw the Labour Party win the most votes and seats in Wales. The Labour Party won the most votes in Wales, although the Conservatives won most votes UK-wide.

zh.s: 1979年英国大选于1979年5月3日星期四在威尔士举行，选出下议院全部635名议员，其中36个选区位于威尔士。工党在威尔士赢得最多选票和席位，但保守党在全英国获得的选票最多。

en.s: The 1979 Uttlesford District Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of Uttlesford District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1979年厄特尔斯福德区议会选举
zh.s: 1979年厄特尔斯福德区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰厄特尔斯福德区议会议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: Elections to Erewash Borough Council were held on 3 May 1979 as part of nationwide local elections.

zh.t: 1979年埃里沃什自治市议会选举
zh.s: 埃里沃什自治市议会选举于1979年5月3日举行，是全国地方选举的一部分。

en.s: The 1979 Derby City Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of Derby City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Voting took place across 18 wards, each electing 3 Councillors. The Labour Party gained control of the council from the Conservative Party.

zh.s: 1979年德比市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰德比市议会议员。选举与其他地方选举同日进行。投票在18个选区举行，每个选区选出3名议员。工党从保守党手中夺得议会控制权。

en.s: The 1979 West Norfolk District Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of West Norfolk District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as the 1979 general election and other local elections.

zh.s: 1979年西诺福克区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡西诺福克区议会议员。选举与1979年英国大选及其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: Local elections were held in the United Kingdom on 3 May 1979 (the same day as the general election). The results provided some source of comfort to the Labour Party, who recovered some lost ground from local election reversals in previous years, despite losing the general election to the Conservative Party on the same day. The Liberals also gained councillors and a council.

zh.s: 1979年5月3日，英国举行地方选举，与英国大选同日进行。尽管工党在同日举行的大选中败给保守党，但地方选举结果让工党有所安慰：此前几年在地方选举中失利后，工党挽回了一些局面。自由党也增加了议员人数，并取得一个议会的控制权。

en.s: The 1979 Epping Forest District Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of Epping Forest District Council in Essex, England. All 59 seats on the council were up for election following boundary changes, which created or altered several wards including Broadway, Buckhurst Hill East and West, Chigwell Row, Loughton St. Johns and Loughton St. Mary’s.

zh.s: 1979年埃平森林区议会选举于5月3日举行。由于选区边界调整，议会全部59个席位改选；此次调整新设或修改了数个选区，包括百老汇、巴克赫斯特山东西区、奇格韦尔罗、劳顿圣约翰区和劳顿圣玛丽区。

en.s: The 1979 Welwyn Hatfield District Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of Welwyn Hatfield District Council in England. This was on the same day as the 1979 general election and other local elections. Due to this, the turnout for the council elections was unusually high at over 80% of the local population. A third of the council's seats were up for election.

zh.t: 1979年韦林哈特菲尔德区议会选举
zh.s: 1979年韦林哈特菲尔德区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰韦林哈特菲尔德区议会议员。选举与1979年英国大选及其他地方选举同日举行。由于同日还有大选，地方人口中的投票率异常高，超过80%。议会三分之一席位改选。

en.s: The 1979 West Dorset District Council election was held on Thursday 3 May 1979 to elect councillors to West Dorset District Council in England. It took place on the same day as the general election and other district council elections in the United Kingdom. This was the third election to the district council, the election saw terms of councillors extended from three to four years.

zh.s: 1979年西多塞特区议会选举于1979年5月3日星期四举行，选出英格兰西多塞特区议会议员。选举与英国大选及英国其他地区议会选举同日进行。这是该区议会的第三次选举，议员任期从三年延长至四年。

en.s: Elections to the Adur District Council were held on 3 May 1979, alongside the general election. The entire council was up for election, following boundary changes that reduced the number of wards by one, but all together had added two seats. Overall turnout was recorded at 74.4%. The election resulted in the Conservatives gaining control of the council.

zh.s: 阿杜尔区议会选举于1979年5月3日与英国大选同时举行。由于选区边界调整，选区数量减少一个，但议席总数增加两个；议会全部席位均改选。投票率为74.4%。选后，保守党取得议会控制权。

en.s: The 1979 Cambridge City Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of Cambridge City Council in Cambridge, Cambridgeshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 1979年剑桥市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰剑桥郡剑桥市议会议员。选举与英格兰各地的其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1979 Southend-on-Sea Borough Council election took place on 3 May 1979 to elect members of Southend-on-Sea Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as the 1979 general election and other local elections.

zh.t: 1979年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1979年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡滨海绍森德自治市议会议员。选举与1979年英国大选及其他地方选举同日举行。

en.t: 1979 United Kingdom general election in Northern Ireland
en.s: On 3 May 1979, the 1979 United Kingdom general election was held in Northern Ireland, to elect all 635 members of the House of Commons, including the 12 Northern Ireland seats. The election was after Labour Party prime minister James Callaghan lost a vote of confidence by 311 votes to 310. The election was won by the Conservative Party led by Margaret Thatcher, and began a period of 18-year government by the party.

zh.s: 1979年英国大选于5月3日在北爱尔兰举行，选出下议院全部635名议员，其中包括北爱尔兰的12个席位。此前，工党首相詹姆斯·卡拉汉在一项不信任动议表决中以311票对310票落败。由玛格丽特·撒切尔领导的保守党赢得大选，并开始了长达18年的执政。

en.s: The 1979 North Hertfordshire District Council election was held on 3 May 1979, at the same time as other local elections across England and Wales and the 1979 United Kingdom general election. All 50 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council were up for election following ward boundary changes. The election saw the Conservatives increase their majority on the council.

zh.t: 1979年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 1979年北赫特福德郡区议会选举于5月3日举行，与英格兰和威尔士各地的其他地方选举及1979年英国大选同日进行。选区边界调整后，北赫特福德郡区议会的50个席位全部改选。保守党扩大了在议会中的多数。

en.s: The 1979 City of Lincoln Council election took place on 3 May 1979. This was on the same day as other local elections. This was the first election to be held under new ward boundaries. The entire council was up for election and the Conservative Party gained control of the council from the Democratic Labour Party.

zh.s: 1979年林肯市议会选举于5月3日举行，与其他地方选举同日进行。这是首次采用新的选区边界举行选举，议会全部席位改选。保守党从民主工党手中夺得议会控制权。

en.s: Elections to Mid Bedfordshire District Council were held on 3 May 1979, on the same day as the general election, so turnout was higher than usual in district council elections for Mid Bedfordshire. All 53 seats were up for election.

zh.t: 1979年中贝德福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 中贝德福德郡区议会选举于1979年5月3日举行，与英国大选同日进行，因此该区议会选举的投票率高于往常。53个席位全部改选。

en.s: The 1979 Ipswich Borough Council election was the first election to the Ipswich Borough Council under the new arrangements determined by the Local Government Boundary Commission as laid out in their Report 280. In accordance with the Local Government Act 1972 the Council had request a system of electing by thirds. Originally the Council had argued for 18 wards with 3 councillors each, making 54 in total.

zh.t: 1979年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1979年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举是伊普斯威奇自治市议会按地方政府边界委员会第280号报告确定的新安排举行的首次选举。根据《1972年地方政府法》，议会要求按三分之一席位轮流改选。议会最初提议划分18个选区，每个选区选出3名议员，共54名。

en.t: The Conservative Party wins the United Kingdom general election. The following day, Margaret Thatcher becomes the first female British Prime Minister
en.s: Margaret Hilda Thatcher, Baroness Thatcher (née Roberts; 13 October 1925 – 8 April 2013) was a British stateswoman who served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1979 to 1990 and Leader of the Conservative Party from 1975 to 1990. She was the longest-serving British prime minister of the 20th century and the first woman to hold the office.

zh.t: 保守党赢得英国大选，次日玛格丽特·撒切尔成为英国首位女首相
zh.s: 玛格丽特·希尔达·撒切尔（娘家姓罗伯茨；1925 年 10 月 13 日—2013 年 4 月 8 日）是英国政治家，1979 至 1990 年担任英国首相，1975 至 1990 年担任保守党领袖。她是 20 世纪任期最长的英国首相，也是首位担任这一职务的女性。

en.s: General elections were held in Saint Lucia on 3 May 1982. The result was a victory for the United Workers Party, which won fourteen of the seventeen seats. Voter turnout was 66.9%.

en.s: The 1983 San Diego mayoral special election was held on May 3, 1983, to elect the mayor for San Diego. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, though some candidates do receive funding and support from various political parties. The non-partisan primary was held March 15, 1983.

en.t: City of Edinburgh District Council election, 1984
en.s: Elections for the City of Edinburgh District Council took place on Thursday 3 May 1984, alongside elections to the councils of Scotland's various other districts. The election was the first time Labour had ever won a majority on the Edinburgh Council, with the party winning 34 of the City's 62 seats. The Conservatives came second, on 22 seats, whilst the SDP-Liberal Alliance won 4, and the SNP 2. Labour would retain its dominance for the next 23 years, until the 2007 election. Mark Lazarowicz and Nigel Griffiths played prominent roles in the election, and would later both become Edinburgh Members of Parliament for Labour.

zh.s: 爱丁堡市区议会选举于1984年5月3日（星期四）举行，与苏格兰其他地区议会选举同期进行。这是工党首次在爱丁堡议会取得多数，赢得全市62席中的34席。保守党以22席位居第二，社会民主党—自由党联盟赢得4席，苏格兰民族党赢得2席。此后工党继续主导议会，直到2007年。马克·拉扎罗维奇和奈杰尔·格里菲思在这次选举中发挥了重要作用，两人后来都成为爱丁堡地区的工党议员。

en.t: 1984 Banff and Buchan District Council election
en.s: Elections to Banff and Buchan District Council were held on 3 May 1984, on the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. This was the fourth election to the district council following the implementation of the Local Government (Scotland) Act 1973. The election used the 18 wards created by the Initial Statutory Reviews of Electoral Arrangements in 1980. Each ward elected one councillor using first-past-the-post voting.

en.s: Elections to Cunninghame District Council were held on 3 May 1984, on the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. en.s: Elections to the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly were held in May 1985, to elect members of the 200 constituencies in Rajasthan, India. After the passing of The Delimitation of Parliamentary and Assembly Constituencies Order, 1976, Rajasthan's Legislative Assembly was assigned 200 constituencies.

en.s: The 1986 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1985–86 DFB-Pokal, the 43rd season of Germany's premier knockout football cup competition. It was played on 3 May 1986 at the Olympiastadion in West Berlin. Bayern Munich won the match 5–2 against VfB Stuttgart to claim their eighth cup title.

zh.s: 1986年德国足协杯决赛决出了1985—86赛季冠军，是德国顶级淘汰制足球杯赛第43个赛季的决赛。比赛于1986年5月3日在西柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。拜仁慕尼黑以5比2击败斯图加特，夺得队史第八座德国杯冠军。

en.s: Air Lanka Flight 512 was an Air Lanka (now SriLankan Airlines) flight from London Gatwick Airport via Zurich and Dubai to Colombo (Bandaranaike International Airport) and Malé, Maldives (Malé International Airport, now Velana International Airport). On 3 May 1986, the Lockheed L-1011 Tristar serving the flight was on the ground in Colombo, about to fly on to Malé, when an explosion ripped the aircraft in two, destroying it.

zh.t: 斯里兰卡航空512号班机空难
zh.s: 斯里兰卡航空512号班机从伦敦盖特威克机场出发，经苏黎世和迪拜飞往科伦坡（班达拉奈克国际机场）和马尔代夫马累（马累国际机场，现名维拉纳国际机场）。1986年5月3日，执行该航班的洛克希德L-1011三星客机停在科伦坡机场，准备继续飞往马累时发生爆炸，机身断成两截并被摧毁。

en.s: China Airlines Flight 334 was a Boeing 747-2R7F/SCD freighter aircraft that was hijacked by pilot Wang Hsi-chueh (Chinese: 王錫爵), a former military U-2 pilot, on May 3, 1986, while en route from Don Mueang, Thailand to Hong Kong. Wang had left family members behind in China when he left for Taiwan in 1949 and had met some of them in Hong Kong in 1984.

zh.t: 中华航空334号班机劫机事件
zh.s: 中华航空334号班机是一架波音747-2R7F/SCD货机，由曼谷廊曼机场飞往香港。1986年5月3日，飞机在途中被前军用U-2飞行员、机师王锡爵劫持。他于1949年离开台湾前往中国时将家人留在中国，并于1984年在香港与部分家人见面。

en.s: The 1990 Bristol City Council election took place on 3 May 1990 to elect members of Bristol City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of seats were up for election. There were by-elections in Brislington East and Easton. As Easton also had an election in the usual schedule, 2 seats were elected in that ward. There was a significant swing against the Liberal Democrats, largely as a result of the post-merger chaos that the party suffered.

zh.s: 1990年布里斯托尔市议会选举于1990年5月3日举行，选出英格兰布里斯托尔市议会议员，与当天的其他地方选举同期举行。约三分之一的席位改选，布里斯灵顿东区和伊斯顿区另举行补选。由于伊斯顿区也按常规安排改选，因此该区共选出两名议员。自由民主党得票明显下滑，主要原因是两党合并后陷入混乱。

en.s: Local elections were held in the United Kingdom on 3 May 1990. They were the last local elections held before the resignation of Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher in November 1990. The main opposition Labour Party gained 284 seats, bringing their number of councillors to 8,920 - their highest since 1981. Their projected share of the vote was 44%, an increase of 2% from 1989. The governing Conservative Party lost 222 seats, leaving them with 9,020 councillors. Their share of the vote was projected to be 33%, a fall of 3% from the previous year.
