This was the fifth election to the regional council following the implementation of the Local Government (Scotland) Act 1973. The election used the 57 electoral divisions (wards) created by the Initial Statutory Reviews of Electoral Arrangements in 1978.

zh.s: 格兰扁区域议会选举于1990年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他区域议会选举同日进行。这是根据《1973年苏格兰地方政府法》实施后，该区域议会举行的第五次选举。选举采用1978年选举安排初步法定审查划定的57个选区。

en.s: The 1990 Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 3 May 1990 to elect members of Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1990年威勒尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1990年威勒尔都市自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰威勒尔都市自治市议会议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1990 Epping Forest District Council election took place on 3 May 1990 to elect members of Epping Forest District Council in Essex, England. 19 members of Epping Forest District Council in Essex were elected. The council remained under Conservative majority control.

zh.s: 1990年埃平森林区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡埃平森林区议会的19名议员。议会仍由保守党掌握多数。

en.s: The 1990 York City Council election took place on 3 May 1990 to elect members of York City Council in North Yorkshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1990年约克市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰北约克郡约克市议会议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1990 Orkney Islands Council election, the fifth election to Orkney Islands Council, was held on 3 May 1990 as part of the wider 1990 Scottish regional elections. The election saw the Independents take all save one of the seats on the council, securing them an overall majority.

zh.s: 奥克尼群岛议会第五次选举于1990年5月3日举行，是1990年苏格兰地区选举的一部分。独立议员赢得除一个席位以外的全部议席，从而在议会中取得绝对多数。

en.s: Local government elections took place in London, and some other parts of the United Kingdom on Thursday 3 May 1990. All London borough council seats were up for election. The previous Borough elections in London were in 1986. The elections saw a poor result for the recently formed Liberal Democrats, with the party losing 10% of its vote and 20 council seats.

zh.s: 1990年5月3日星期四，伦敦及英国其他一些地区举行地方选举。伦敦各自治市议会的全部席位改选。此前伦敦自治市议会选举于1986年举行。新成立的自由民主党表现不佳，得票率下降10%，失去20个议席。

en.s: The 1990 North Hertfordshire District Council election was held on 3 May 1990, at the same time as other local elections across England and Scotland. There were 16 out of 50 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council up for election, being the usual third of the council. Labour took most votes, gaining two extra seats. The Conservatives also gained a seat, increasing their majority on the council.

zh.t: 1990年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 1990年北赫特福德郡区议会选举于5月3日举行，与英格兰和苏格兰其他地方选举同日进行。北赫特福德郡区议会50个席位中的16席改选，通常为议会三分之一席位。工党得票最多，增加2席。保守党也增加1席，扩大了在议会中的多数。

en.t: 1990 Dumfries and Galloway Regional Council election
en.s: The 1990 Dumfries and Galloway Regional Council election, the fifth election to Dumfries and Galloway Regional Council, was held on 3 May 1990 as part of the wider 1990 Scottish regional elections. The election saw the Independents' majority cut to 1 councillor, but enough to keep control of the 35 seat council.

zh.t: 1990年邓弗里斯和加洛韦区域议会选举
zh.s: 1990年邓弗里斯和加洛韦区域议会第五次选举于5月3日举行，是1990年苏格兰区域选举的一部分。独立议员在35席议会中的多数缩小到1席，但仍足以继续控制议会。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 3 May 1990. One third of the council was up for election and the Labour Party kept overall control of the council.

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于1990年5月3日举行。议会三分之一席位改选，工党继续全面控制议会。

en.s: The 1990 City of Lincoln Council election took place on 3 May 1990. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election: the seats of which were last contested in 1986. The Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.s: 1990年林肯市议会选举于5月3日举行，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位改选，这些席位上次于1986年改选。工党继续控制议会。

en.s: Elections to Strathclyde Regional Council were held on Thursday 3 May 1990, on the same day as the eight other Scottish regional elections. This was the fifth election to the regional council following the local government reforms in the 1970s. The election was the last to use the 103 electoral divisions created by the Initial Reviews of Electoral Arrangements in 1978.

zh.t: 1990年斯特拉斯克莱德区域议会选举
zh.s: 斯特拉斯克莱德区域议会选举于1990年5月3日星期四举行，与苏格兰其他8个区域的选举同日进行。这是该区域议会自20世纪70年代地方政府改革后举行的第五次选举，也是最后一次采用1978年选区安排初步审查划定的103个选区。

en.s: The 1990 Ipswich Borough Council election was an election to the Ipswich Borough Council under the arrangement, whereby a third of the councillors were to stand for election, each time. It took place as part of the 1990 United Kingdom local elections. There were 16 wards each returning one councillor plus two bye-elections one each for Whitehouse and Whitton Wards. The Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.t: 1990年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1990年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举按议会三分之一席位轮流改选的安排举行，是1990年英国地方选举的一部分。16个选区各选出1名议员，白宫和惠顿两个选区还各举行1场补选。工党继续控制议会。

en.t: 1992 Yugoslav People's Army column incident in Sarajevo
en.s: The 1992 Yugoslav People's Army column incident in Sarajevo occurred on 3 May 1992 in Dobrovoljačka Street, Sarajevo, when members of the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina (ARBiH) attacked a convoy of Yugoslav People's Army (JNA) troops that were exiting the city of Sarajevo according to the withdrawal agreement.

zh.t: 1992年萨拉热窝南斯拉夫人民军纵队事件
zh.s: 1992年5月3日，南斯拉夫人民军纵队事件发生在萨拉热窝的多布罗沃利亚奇卡街。根据撤军协议，南斯拉夫人民军（JNA）部队正撤出萨拉热窝，波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那共和国军（ARBiH）成员袭击了这支车队。

en.s: The 1993 Newfoundland general election was held on May 3, 1993, to elect members of the 42nd General Assembly of Newfoundland. It was won by the Liberal party.

zh.s: 1993年纽芬兰大选于1993年5月3日举行，选出纽芬兰第42届议会的议员。自由党赢得选举。

en.s: The 1995 Coupe de la Ligue final was a football match held at Parc des Princes, Paris on 3 May 1995, that saw Paris Saint-Germain defeat SC Bastia 2-0 thanks to goals by Alain Roche and Raí.

zh.s: 1995年法国联赛杯决赛于1995年5月3日在巴黎王子公园球场举行。巴黎圣日耳曼以2比0击败巴斯蒂亚，阿兰·罗什和雷伊各进一球。

en.s: Operation Flash (Croatian: Operacija Bljesak) was a brief Croatian Army (HV) offensive conducted against the forces of the self-declared proto-state Republic of Serbian Krajina (RSK) from 1–3 May 1995. The offensive occurred in the later stages of the Croatian War of Independence and was the first major confrontation after ceasefire and economic cooperation agreements were signed between Croatia and the RSK in 1994.

zh.s: 闪电行动是克罗地亚军队于1995年5月1日至3日发动的短期攻势，目标是自称国家“塞尔维亚克拉伊纳共和国”（RSK）的武装力量。行动发生在克罗地亚独立战争后期，是1994年克罗地亚与RSK签署停火和经济合作协议后的首次重大交战。

en.s: Baotou is the second-largest city by urban population in Inner Mongolia, China. Governed as a prefecture-level city, its built-up (or metro) area within its five urban districts is home to 2,261,089 people while the total population is 2,709,378 as of the 2020 census. Baotou's southern border is delineated by the Yellow River. The city's namesake, literally translating to "place with deer", is Mongolian, bringing about the nickname of "Lucheng" (Chinese: 鹿城; pinyin: Lùchéng), meaning "City of Deer".

zh.s: 包头是中国内蒙古自治区按城市人口计算的第二大城市。包头作为地级市管理，其五个市辖区构成的建成区人口为 2,261,089 人；根据 2020 年人口普查，全市总人口为 2,709,378 人。包头南界由黄河划定。包头之名直译为“有鹿之地”，源自蒙古语，因此也有“鹿城”这一别称。

en.s: Elections are currently every three years to elect the mayor of Arlington, Texas. Prior to 2023, elections were for two year terms. Elections are officially non-partisan, and use a two-round system, where election runoffs are held if no candidate obtains the majority of the vote.

zh.s: 阿灵顿市目前每三年举行一次市长选举。2023 年以前，选举任期为两年。选举正式上不带党派标签，并采用两轮制；若无人获得过半数选票，则举行决选。

en.s: Wrestlepalooza (1998) was the third Wrestlepalooza professional wrestling event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW) and the only edition of Wrestlepalooza to be broadcast on pay-per-view (PPV). The event took place on May 3, 1998 in the Cobb County Civic Center in Marietta, Georgia. Joey Styles provided commentary for the event. The PPV was billed as ECW "invading enemy territory", since the state of Georgia was the home of World Championship Wrestling (WCW) in nearby Atlanta.

zh.s: 1998年Wrestlepalooza是极限冠军摔角（ECW）举办的第三届Wrestlepalooza职业摔角赛事，也是该系列唯一通过付费电视（PPV）播出的赛事。比赛于1998年5月3日在美国佐治亚州玛丽埃塔的科布县市民中心举行。乔伊·斯泰尔斯担任赛事解说。ECW将这场赛事宣传为“进军敌方地盘”，因为佐治亚州是世界摔角冠军赛（WCW）的主场，WCW总部位于附近的亚特兰大。

en.s: The 1999 Bridge Creek–Moore tornado was a large, long-lived, and exceptionally violent F5 tornado that produced the highest tornado wind speed ever recorded by doppler weather radar—321 miles per hour (517 km/h), measured by a Doppler on Wheels (DoW). One of the strongest tornadoes ever recorded to affect a metropolitan area, the tornado devastated southern portions of Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, as well as surrounding municipalities to the south and southwest of the city during the early evening of Monday, May 3, 1999.

zh.t: 1999年布里奇克里克—摩尔龙卷风
zh.s: 1999年布里奇克里克—摩尔龙卷风是一场强度极高、持续时间很长的F5级龙卷风。多普勒气象雷达记录到有史以来最高的龙卷风风速：每小时321英里（517公里），由“车载多普勒雷达”测得。这是有记录以来影响大都市地区的最强龙卷风之一。1999年5月3日星期一傍晚，该龙卷风重创俄克拉何马州俄克拉何马城南部以及该市以南和西南方向的周边市镇。

en.s: The 1999 FA Women's Cup Final was the 28th final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. It was the sixth final to be held under the direct control of the Football Association (FA). It was contested between Arsenal and Southampton Saints. The match was played at the Valley, the home stadium of Charlton Athletic.

zh.s: 1999年英格兰足总女子杯决赛是第28届决赛，也是英格兰女子足球的主要杯赛决赛。英格兰足球总会直接管理该赛事后，这是第6届决赛。阿森纳队对阵南安普敦圣徒队，比赛在查尔顿竞技队主场山谷球场举行。

en.s: The Kargil War, also known as the Kargil conflict, was fought between India and Pakistan from May to July 1999 in the Kargil district of Ladakh, then part of the Indian-administered state of Jammu and Kashmir and along the Line of Control (LoC). In India, the conflict is also referred to as Operation Vijay (lit. 'Victory'), which was the codename of the Indian military operation in the region.

en.s: The 2003 Fort Worth mayoral election took place on May 3, 2003, to elect the Mayor of Fort Worth, Texas. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections, and was officially nonpartisan. The election saw the election of Mike Moncrief. The mayoral term in Fort Worth is two years. If no candidate received a majority of the vote in the general election, a runoff would have been held.

zh.s: 2003年沃思堡市长选举于5月3日举行，选出得克萨斯州沃思堡市长。选举与其他地方选举同时举行，且依法不设党派。迈克·蒙克里夫当选市长。沃思堡市长任期为两年。如果没有候选人在普选中获得过半选票，原本将举行第二轮选举。

en.s: The 2003 Austin mayoral election was held on May 3, 2003, to elect the mayor of Austin, Texas, USA. Will Wynn was elected. Incumbent mayor Gustavo L. Garcia did not seek reelection.

zh.s: 2003年奥斯汀市长选举于2003年5月3日举行，选出美国得克萨斯州奥斯汀市市长。威尔·韦恩当选。现任市长古斯塔沃·L·加西亚没有寻求连任。

en.s: The 2003 El Paso mayoral election was held on May 3, 2003, to elect the mayor of El Paso, Texas. It saw the election of Joe Wardy, who unseated incumbent mayor Raymond Caballero. This was the first El Paso mayoral election held under new rules which saw a shift from the previous system under which a nonpartisan primary was followed by a general election of the top-two finishers to a new system in which a runoff is held only if no candidate receives a majority of the vote in the first round.

zh.s: 2003年埃尔帕索市长选举于2003年5月3日举行，选出得克萨斯州埃尔帕索市市长。乔·沃迪当选，击败时任市长雷蒙德·卡巴列罗。这是埃尔帕索市长选举首次采用新规则：此前先举行无党派初选，再由前两名候选人参加普选；新规则改为首轮投票中无人获得过半选票时才举行第二轮选举。

en.s: The 2003 Dallas mayoral election took place on May 3, 2003, to elect the mayor of Dallas, Texas. The race was officially nonpartisan. It saw the reelection of Laura Miller, who won the election by taking a majority in the initial round of voting, thereby negating the need for a runoff to be held.

zh.s: 2003年达拉斯市长选举于2003年5月3日举行，选出得克萨斯州达拉斯市市长。选举依法不设党派。劳拉·米勒赢得首轮投票过半数，再次当选，因此无需举行第二轮选举。

en.s: The 2003 United States House of Representatives special election in Texas's 19th congressional district was held on June 3, 2003 to select the successor to Larry Combest (R) who resigned to spend more time with his family. In accordance with Texas law, the special election was officially nonpartisan. This election took place during the highly controversial 2003 Texas Redistricting, during which the placement of the cities of Lubbock and Midland within the district were heavily debated.

zh.s: 2003 年得克萨斯州第 19 国会选区联邦众议员特别选举于 2003 年 6 月 3 日举行，选出接替拉里·康贝斯的议员；康贝斯辞职是为了有更多时间陪伴家人。根据得克萨斯州法律，这场特别选举不设党派。选举期间正值争议很大的 2003 年得克萨斯州重新划分选区，拉伯克和米德兰两座城市应划入哪个选区引发激烈争论。

en.s: The 2004 FA Women's Cup Final was the 34th final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. It was the 11th final to be held under the direct control of the Football Association (FA) and was known as the FA Women's Cup Final in partnership with Nationwide for sponsorship reasons. The final was contested between Arsenal and Charlton Athletic on 3 May 2004.

zh.s: 2004年英格兰足总女子杯决赛是第34届决赛，也是英格兰女子足球队的主要杯赛。英格兰足球总会（FA）直接管理该赛事后，这是第11届决赛；由于赞助原因，赛事名称为“英格兰足总女子杯决赛与Nationwide联合呈现”。阿森纳队和查尔顿竞技队于2004年5月3日争夺冠军。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Chad on 3 May 2006. A referendum in 2005 had led to changes to the constitution that made it possible for President Idriss Déby to run for a third term; having come to power in December 1990, he previously won elections in 1996 and 2001. Despite a serious rebellion based in the east of the country, the elections were held on schedule; Déby was re-elected with about 65% of the vote, according to official results. The main opposition parties boycotted the election.

zh.s: 乍得总统选举于2006年5月3日举行。2005年的公投修改了宪法，使总统伊德里斯·代比可以竞选第三个任期。代比于1990年12月上台，此前曾在1996年和2001年赢得选举。尽管东部发生严重叛乱，选举仍按计划举行；根据官方结果，代比以约65%的得票率连任。主要反对党抵制了选举。

en.s: Armavia Flight 967 was a scheduled international passenger flight operated by Armavia from Zvartnots International Airport, Zvartnots in Armenia to Sochi, a Black Sea coastal resort city in Russia. On 3 May 2006, the aircraft operating the route, an Airbus A320, crashed into the sea while attempting a go-around following its first approach to Sochi airport; all 113 aboard were killed.

zh.t: 亚美尼亚航空967号班机空难
zh.s: 亚美尼亚航空967号班机是一趟定期国际客运航班，由亚美尼亚兹瓦尔特诺茨国际机场飞往俄罗斯黑海沿岸度假城市索契。2006年5月3日，执行该航线的空中客车A320客机在索契机场首次进近后尝试复飞时坠海，机上113人全部遇难。

en.s: The 2007 Scottish Parliament election was held on Thursday 3 May 2007 to elect members to the Scottish Parliament. It was the third general election to the devolved Scottish Parliament since it was created in 1999. Local elections in Scotland fell on the same day. The Scottish National Party emerged as the largest party with 47 seats, closely followed by the incumbent Scottish Labour Party with 46 seats. The Scottish Conservatives won 17 seats, the Scottish Liberal Democrats 16 seats, the Scottish Green Party 2 seats and one Independent (Margo MacDonald) was also elected.

zh.s: 2007年苏格兰议会选举于5月3日（星期四）举行，选出苏格兰议会议员。这是1999年苏格兰权力下放议会成立以来的第三次大选。苏格兰地方选举也在同日举行。苏格兰民族党以47席成为第一大党，现任执政的苏格兰工党以46席紧随其后。苏格兰保守党赢得17席，苏格兰自由民主党赢得16席，苏格兰绿党赢得2席，独立候选人玛戈·麦克唐纳也当选。

en.s: The 2007 National Assembly election was held on Thursday 3 May 2007 to elect members to the National Assembly for Wales. It was the third general election. On the same day local elections in England and Scotland, and the Scottish Parliament election took place. This election was preceded by the previous Assembly election in 2003. en.s: The 2007 UK local government elections were held on 3 May 2007. These elections took place in most of England and all of Scotland. There were no local government elections in Wales though the Welsh Assembly had a general election on the same day. There were no local government elections in Northern Ireland. Just over half of English councils and almost all the Scottish councils began the counts on Friday, rather than Thursday night, because of more complex arrangements regarding postal votes. These elections were a landmark in the United Kingdom as it was the first time that 18- to 20-year-olds could stand as candidates for council seats.

Prior to the election the leader of the council was Mark Hawthorne, a Conservative, but he chose not to stand for re-election. Paul James was appointed leader after the election, continuing to lead a Conservative minority administration.

zh.s: 2007年格洛斯特市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰格洛斯特市议会议员。选后议会仍无人取得绝对多数。选举前，议会领袖、保守党人马克·霍桑决定不再参选。选后，保罗·詹姆斯出任议会领袖，并继续领导保守党少数派政府。

en.s: The 2007 New Forest District Council election took place on 3 May 2007 to elect members to the New Forest District Council, on the same day as other local elections. The election for Bramshaw, Copythorne North and Minstead was postponed due to the death of a candidate, and therefore a by-election was held on 14 June.

zh.s: 2007年新森林区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出新森林区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。由于一名候选人去世，布拉姆肖、科皮索恩北区和明斯特德的选举推迟，并于6月14日举行补选。

en.s: The 2007 City of Lincoln Council election took place on 3 May 2007 to elect members of City of Lincoln Council in Lincolnshire, England. This was held on the same day as other local elections. All 33 seats were up for election, with 3 councillors in each of the 11 wards being elected following a boundary review. The Conservative Party gained control of the council from the Labour Party.

zh.s: 2007年林肯市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰林肯郡林肯市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会33个席位全部改选。选区边界审查后，共有11个选区，每个选区选出3名议员。保守党从工党手中夺得议会控制权。

en.s: The 2007 Crawley Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2007 to elect members of Crawley Borough Council in West Sussex, England. One third (13 out of 37 seats) of the council was up for election. The Conservatives regained overall control of the council, which they had won at the last election only for it to later fall under no overall control.

zh.s: 2007年克劳利自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰西萨塞克斯郡克劳利自治市议会议员。议会37个席位中的三分之一（13席）改选。保守党重新取得议会绝对多数；上次选举中保守党赢得多数，但之后议会一度变为无人取得绝对多数。

en.s: The 2007 Bracknell Forest Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2007, to elect all 42 councillors in 18 wards for Bracknell Forest Borough Council in England. The election was held on the same day as other local elections in England as part of the 2007 United Kingdom local elections. The Conservative Party increased its majority at the expense of both the Labour Party and the Liberal Democrats, the latter losing its only seat.

zh.t: 2007年布拉克内尔森林自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2007年布拉克内尔森林自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，改选其18个选区的全部42名议员。选举是2007年英国地方选举的一部分，也与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。保守党扩大了多数席位，工党和自由民主党都失去席位；自由民主党失去了唯一的一席。

en.s: The 2007 Broadland District Council election took place on 3 May 2007 to elect members of Broadland District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2007年布罗德兰区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰布罗德兰区议会议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: Elections to Dover District Council in Kent, England were held on 3 May 2007, as were UK local elections across the country. The whole council was up for election and the Conservative Party gained overall control of the council.

zh.s: 肯特郡多佛区议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，与英国各地的地方选举同日进行。议会全部席位改选，保守党取得议会绝对多数。

en.s: The 2007 Borough Council of Wellingborough election took place on 3 May 2007 to elect members of Borough Council of Wellingborough in Northamptonshire, UK. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Conservatives won 30 seats with 12,190 votes, while Labour won 4 seats with 8,188 votes.

zh.t: 2007年韦灵伯勒自治市议会选举
zh.s: 韦灵伯勒自治市议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，选出英国北安普敦郡韦灵伯勒自治市议会议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。保守党赢得30席、12,190票；工党赢得4席、8,188票。

en.s: The 2007 Exeter City Council election took place on 3 May 2007, to elect members to 13 of the 40 seats of Exeter City Council in Devon, England. The election was held concurrently with other local elections in England. One third of the council was up for election and the council remained under no overall control.

zh.s: 2007年埃克塞特市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰德文郡埃克塞特市议会40个席位中的13席。选举与英格兰其他地方选举同时举行。议会三分之一席位改选，选后仍无人取得绝对多数。

en.s: The 2007 Fenland District Council election took place on 3 May 2007 to elect members of Fenland District Council in Cambridgeshire, England. All 40 seats of the council were up for election and the Conservative Party stayed in overall control of the council.

zh.s: 2007年芬兰德区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰剑桥郡芬兰德区议会议员。议会40个席位全部改选，保守党继续全面控制议会。

en.s: The 2007 Horsham District Council election took place on 3 May 2007 to elect members of Horsham District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. The Conservatives won a majority on the council, gaining from no overall control.

zh.s: 2007年霍舍姆区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰霍舍姆区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。保守党赢得议会多数，从此前无人取得绝对多数的局面中取得控制权。

en.s: The 2007 East Northamptonshire District Council election took place on 3 May 2007 to elect members of East Northamptonshire District Council in Northamptonshire, England. The polls place on the same day as other local elections across the UK. This was the first election to be held under new ward boundaries. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council, while the Labour Party was wiped out, with a single Independent councillor providing the sole opposition on the council.

zh.t: 2007年东北安普敦郡区议会选举
zh.s: 2007年东北安普敦郡区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰北安普敦郡东北安普敦郡区议会议员。投票与英国各地其他地方选举同日举行，也是首次采用新的选区边界。保守党继续全面控制议会。工党全军覆没，议会中只有一名独立议员作为反对派。

en.s: The 2007 West Dorset District Council election was held on Thursday 3 May 2007 to elect councillors to West Dorset District Council in England. It took place on the same day as other district council elections in the United Kingdom. The entire council was up for election. The 2007 election saw the Conservatives maintain their majority control of the District Council.

zh.s: 2007年西多塞特区议会选举于5月3日星期四举行，选出英格兰西多塞特区议会议员。选举与英国其他地区议会选举同日进行，议会全部席位改选。保守党继续在区议会中保持多数。

en.s: Elections to Trafford Council were held on 3 May 2007. One third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a four-year term of office, expiring in 2011. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.t: 2007年特拉福德都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 特拉福德议会选举于2007年5月3日举行。议会三分之一席位改选，当选者任期四年，于2011年届满。保守党继续全面控制议会。

en.s: The 2007 East Hampshire District Council election took place on 3 May 2007 to elect all 44 members of East Hampshire District Council in Hampshire England. The whole council was up for election and the Conservative Party stayed in overall control of the council.

zh.s: 2007年东汉普郡区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰汉普郡东汉普郡区议会全部44名成员。保守党继续全面控制议会。

en.s: Elections to South Hams District Council took place on 3 May 2007, the same day as other United Kingdom local elections. The whole council was up for election and the Conservative Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.s: 南哈姆斯区议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。议会全部席位改选，保守党继续全面控制议会。

en.s: The 2007 Stirling Council election was held on 3 May 2007, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections and the Scottish Parliament general election. The election was the first one using seven new wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004. Each ward elected three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation.

zh.s: 2007年斯特灵议会选举于5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举及苏格兰议会大选同日进行。这是首次按《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的7个新选区举行选举。每个选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制，实行比例代表制。

en.s: Elections to West Wiltshire District Council were held on 3 May 2007. The whole council was up for election and the Conservatives took control. Most wards had boundary changes or were new. One ward, Shearwater, was uncontested. Of the 44 new members, 21 were not members of the outgoing council.

zh.s: 西威尔特郡区议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，议会全部席位改选，保守党取得控制权。大多数选区调整了边界或重新设立。希尔沃特选区没有其他候选人竞争。44名新当选议员中，有21人不是上一届议会成员。

en.s: The 2007 West Dunbartonshire Council election was held on 3 May 2007, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections and the Scottish Parliament general election. The election was the first one using six new wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, each elected three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation.

zh.s: 2007年西邓巴顿郡议会选举于5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举及苏格兰议会大选同日进行。这是首次按《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的6个新选区举行选举，每个选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制，实行比例代表制。

en.s: Elections to Northampton Borough Council were held on 3 May 2007. The whole council was up for election and the Liberal Democrats gained overall control of the council from no overall control.

zh.t: 2007年北安普敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 北安普敦自治市议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，议会全部席位改选。自由民主党从此前无人取得绝对多数的议会中取得全面控制权。

en.s: The 2007 Test Valley Borough Council election took place on the 3 May 2007. All 48 seats were up for election. 25 seats were needed for a majority, with the Conservatives increasing their majority by three seats. Both independents lost their seats, one to the Conservatives and one to the Liberal Democrats, who in turn lost a seat to the Conservatives.

zh.t: 2007年泰斯特谷自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2007年泰斯特谷自治市议会选举于5月3日举行。议会48个席位全部改选，取得多数至少需要25席。保守党增加3席，扩大了多数。两名独立议员都失去席位，其中一席被保守党赢得，另一席被自由民主党赢得；自由民主党又失去1席给保守党。

en.s: Elections to Salisbury District Council were held on 3 May 2007. The whole council was up for election, and the Conservatives lost overall control, but were still the largest party winning twenty-two of the fifty-five seats available. This was the last election of district councillors to take place in Salisbury.

zh.s: 索尔兹伯里区议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，议会全部席位改选。保守党失去全面控制权，但仍是最大党，在55席中赢得22席。这是索尔兹伯里最后一次举行区议会选举。

en.s: Elections to Dumfries and Galloway Council were held on 3 May 2007 the same day as the other Scottish local government elections and the Scottish Parliament general election. The election was the first one using 13 new wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, each ward will elect three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation.

zh.t: 2007年邓弗里斯和加洛韦议会选举
zh.s: 邓弗里斯和加洛韦议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举及苏格兰议会大选同日进行。这是首次按《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的13个新选区举行选举，每个选区将选出3至4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制，实行比例代表制。

en.s: On 3 May 2007, an election was held to elect councillors to the North Warwickshire Borough Council in the English Midlands. It took place on the same day as other local elections in the UK. It resulted in the Conservative Party gaining control of the council. The previous election resulted in no overall control with the Labour Party having the highest number of seats at 16.

zh.t: 2007年北沃里克郡自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2007年5月3日，英格兰中部的北沃里克郡举行自治市议会选举，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。选后，保守党取得议会控制权。上一次选举后议会无人取得绝对多数，工党拥有最多席位，共16席。

en.s: Elections to Inverclyde Council were held on 3 May 2007 the same day as the Scottish Parliament general election. The election was the first one using six new wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004; each ward will elect three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system, a form of proportional representation.

zh.s: 因弗克莱德议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，与苏格兰议会大选同日进行。这是首次按《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的6个新选区举行选举，每个选区将选出3至4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制，实行比例代表制。

en.s: Elections to Hyndburn Borough Council were held on 3 May 2007. One third of the council was up for election and the Conservative party stayed in overall control of the council. Labour had held one by election (Spring Hill) and won another from the Conservatives (Rishton) in Autumn 2006.

zh.s: 亨德本自治市议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，议会三分之一席位改选，保守党继续全面控制议会。工党此前在2006年秋季举行的斯普林希尔选区补选中赢得1席，又从保守党手中赢得里什顿选区的另1席。

en.s: The 2007 North Hertfordshire District Council election was held on 3 May 2007, at the same time as other local elections across England and Scotland. All 49 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council were up for election following changes to ward boundaries. Labour and the Liberal Democrats both increased their number of seats, but the Conservatives retained their majority on the council. The Conservative leader, F.

zh.t: 2007 年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 2007 年北赫特福德郡区议会选举于 5 月 3 日举行，与英格兰和苏格兰其他地方选举同日进行。由于选区边界调整，区议会全部 49 个席位均需改选。工党和自由民主党均增加了席位，但保守党保住了议会多数。保守党领袖 F. 约翰·史密斯在选后继续担任议会领袖。

en.s: The 2007 South Ayrshire Council election took place on 3 May 2007 on the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections and elections to the Scottish Parliament. The election was the first to use the 8 new wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, each ward electing three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation.

zh.s: 南艾尔郡议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举及苏格兰议会选举同日进行。这是首次按《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的8个新选区举行选举，每个选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制，实行比例代表制。

en.s: Elections to North Ayrshire Council were held on 3 May 2007, the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections and the Scottish Parliament elections. The election was the first one using eight new wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, each ward will elect three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation.

zh.s: 北艾尔郡议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举及苏格兰议会选举同日进行。这是首次按《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的8个新选区举行选举，每个选区将选出3至4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制，实行比例代表制。

en.s: Elections to South Lanarkshire Council took place on 3 May 2007 on the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections. The election was the first to use the 20 new wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, each ward electing three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation.

zh.s: 南拉纳克郡议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日进行。这是首次按《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的20个新选区举行选举，每个选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制，实行比例代表制。

en.s: Elections to Shetland Islands Council were held on 3 May 2007 the same day as the other Scottish local government elections and the Scottish Parliament general election. The election was the first one using seven new wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004. Each ward elected three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system, a form of proportional representation.

zh.s: 设得兰群岛议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举及苏格兰议会大选同日进行。这是首次按《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的7个新选区举行选举。每个选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制，实行比例代表制。

en.s: Elections to East Renfrewshire Council were held on 3 May 2007 the same day as the other Scottish local government elections and the Scottish Parliament general election. The election was the first using six new wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004. Each ward elected three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system of proportional representation.

zh.s: 东伦弗鲁郡议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举及苏格兰议会大选同日进行。这是首次按《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的6个新选区举行选举。每个选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制，实行比例代表制。

en.s: Elections to Kennet District Council were held on 3 May 2007. The whole council was up for election, and the Conservatives comfortably retained control, winning thirty-three of the forty-three seats available. This was the last election of district councilors to take place in Kennet.

zh.s: 肯尼特区议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，议会全部席位改选。保守党以43席中的33席稳稳保住控制权。这是肯尼特最后一次举行区议会选举。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 3 May 2007. One third of the council was up for election and the Liberal Democrats kept overall control of the council.

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，议会三分之一席位改选，自由民主党继续全面控制议会。

en.t: 2007 Bath and North East Somerset Council election
en.s: Elections were held on 3 May 2007 to elect 65 local councillors for Bath and North East Somerset Council. The results are shown below. Following the elections, a Conservative minority administration was formed. Cllr Francine Haeberling became leader of the council. This replaced the previous Liberal Democrat and Conservative coalition.

zh.t: 2007年巴斯和东北萨默塞特议会选举
zh.s: 2007年5月3日举行选举，选出巴斯和东北萨默塞特议会的65名地方议员。选后成立了保守党少数派政府，弗朗辛·哈伯灵议员出任议会领袖，取代此前由自由民主党和保守党组成的联合政府。

en.s: Elections to East Ayrshire Council were held on 3 May 2007, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections and the Scottish Parliament general election. The election was the first one using nine new wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, each ward will elect three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation.

zh.s: 东艾尔郡议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举及苏格兰议会大选同日进行。这是首次按《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的9个新选区举行选举，每个选区将选出3至4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制，实行比例代表制。

en.s: The 2007 Perth and Kinross Council election was held on 3 May 2007, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections and the Scottish Parliament general election. The election was the first one using 12 new wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, each ward will elect three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation.

zh.s: 2007年珀斯和金罗斯议会选举于5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举及苏格兰议会大选同日进行。这是首次按《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的12个新选区举行选举，每个选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制，实行比例代表制。

en.s: Elections to North Wiltshire District Council were held on 3 May 2007. The whole council was up for election, and the Conservatives gained overall control, winning thirty-nine of the fifty-four seats available. This was the last election of district councillors to take place in North Wiltshire.

zh.s: 北威尔特郡区议会选举于2007年5月3日举行，议会全部席位改选。保守党赢得54席中的39席，取得全面控制权。这是北威尔特郡最后一次举行区议会选举。

en.t: 2007 Brighton and Hove City Council election
en.s: Elections to Brighton and Hove City Council on the south coast of England were held on 3 May 2007. The whole council (a unitary authority) was up for election and all 54 councillors were elected. The Conservative Party won 26 out of 54 seats on the council, replacing the Labour Party as the largest party and formed a minority administration.

zh.t: 2007年布莱顿和霍夫市议会选举
zh.s: 英格兰南海岸的布莱顿和霍夫市议会选举于2007年5月3日举行。作为单一层级地方政府，议会全部席位改选，共选出54名议员。保守党赢得54席中的26席，取代工党成为最大党，并组建少数派政府。

en.s: Elections to Birmingham City Council in England were held in May 2007. One third of the council was up for election and the council stayed under no overall control as it had been since 2003.

zh.s: 伯明翰市议会选举于2007年5月举行，议会三分之一席位改选。自2003年以来议会一直无人取得绝对多数，此次选举后仍是如此。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Elections to Mid Bedfordshire District Council were held in May 2007. These were the last elections to the council, with all 53 seats being up for election. Councillors elected would serve a two-year term, expiring in 2009, when Mid Bedfordshire District Council was replaced by Central Bedfordshire Council. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council, winning 37 of 53 seats on the council.

zh.t: 2007年中贝德福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 中贝德福德郡区议会选举于2007年5月举行，是该议会最后一次选举，53个席位全部改选。当选议员任期两年，于2009年届满；之后中贝德福德郡区议会由中贝德福德郡单一层级议会取代。保守党以53席中的37席继续全面控制议会。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The London Labour Party mayoral selection of 2007 was the process by which the Labour Party selected its candidate for Mayor of London, to stand in the 2008 mayoral election. Ken Livingstone, the incumbent Mayor of London, was selected to stand.

zh.t: 2007年伦敦工党市长候选人遴选
zh.s: 2007年伦敦工党市长候选人遴选是工党选出候选人的过程，该候选人将参加2008年市长选举。时任伦敦市长肯·利文斯通获选为该党候选人。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Voters in Louisiana's 1st congressional district voting in a special election on May 3, 2008, elected Steve Scalise as a new member of the United States House of Representatives, replacing Representative Bobby Jindal who resigned on January 14, 2008, to become Governor of Louisiana. This election and Louisiana's 6th congressional district special election were the first Louisiana congressional elections not based on Louisiana's jungle primary since the 1970s.

zh.t: 2008年路易斯安那州第一国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 路易斯安那州第一国会选区选民于2008年5月3日举行的特别选举中选出史蒂夫·斯卡利斯为美国众议院新议员，接替于2008年1月14日辞职、转任路易斯安那州州长的鲍比·金达尔。这次选举和路易斯安那州第六国会选区特别选举，是自20世纪70年代以来路易斯安那州首次不采用“丛林初选”方式举行的国会选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2008 Guam Democratic presidential caucus took place on May 3, 2008. Senator Barack Obama won by 7 votes, a margin of less than 0.2%. This resulted in each candidate getting 2 pledged delegates to the 2008 Democratic National Convention. Guam Democrats also sent five unpledged superdelegates to the convention.

zh.t: 2008年关岛民主党总统党团会议
zh.s: 2008年关岛民主党总统党团会议于5月3日举行。参议员巴拉克·奥巴马以7票优势获胜，领先幅度不到0.2%。因此，两名候选人各获得2名承诺代表，参加2008年民主党全国代表大会。关岛民主党人还派出5名不受承诺约束的超级代表参加大会。

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 3 May 2008. The two seats up for election were Huon, held by independent MLC Paul Harriss, and Rosevears, held by independent MLC Kerry Finch. These seats were last contested in 2002.

zh.t: 2008年塔斯马尼亚立法会定期选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法会定期选举于2008年5月3日举行。休恩和罗斯维尔两个选区的席位改选，现任议员分别是独立议员保罗·哈里斯和克里·芬奇。这两个席位上次于2002年改选。

en.s: Presidential and parliamentary elections were held in Panama on May 3, 2009.

zh.s: 巴拿马于2009年5月3日举行总统和议会选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: Cardiff Blues vs Leicester Tigers (2008–09 Heineken Cup)
en.s: The second semi-final of the 2008–09 Heineken Cup, the premier European club rugby union competition, saw Cardiff Blues take on Leicester Tigers at the Millennium Stadium in Cardiff on 3 May 2009. The scores were level after regular time and neither team was able to score during extra time, resulting in the first ever penalty shoot-out in a professional rugby union match.

zh.t: 加的夫蓝军对莱斯特老虎队（2008—09赛季喜力杯）
zh.s: 2008—09赛季喜力杯半决赛第二场中，欧洲顶级俱乐部橄榄球联盟赛事喜力杯球队加的夫蓝军于2009年5月3日在加的夫千禧球场迎战莱斯特老虎队。双方在常规时间战平，加时赛也未能得分，因此这成为职业橄榄球联盟比赛中首次以点球大战决胜的赛事。

en.t: Tripura Tribal Areas Autonomous District Council election, 2010
en.s: Elections to the Tripura Tribal Areas Autonomous District Council (TTAADC) were held on May 3, 2010. On that day elections were held for 27 of the 28 elected seats in the Autonomous District Council. In one seat (Maharani-Chellagong) the election was countermanded, following the death of Bharatiya Janata Party candidate Ranjit Jamatia. 25 of the 28 elected seats in the Autonomous District Council are reserved for Scheduled Tribes. Security arrangements ahead of the election were tight. The Tripura Home Department had identitied 91 polling stations as "hyper-sensitive" and 347 as "sensitive".

zh.t: 2010年特里普拉部落地区自治区议会选举
zh.s: 特里普拉部落地区自治区议会（TTAADC）选举于2010年5月3日举行。当天改选该自治区议会28个民选席位中的27席。由于印度人民党候选人兰吉特·贾马蒂亚去世，马哈拉尼—切拉贡选区的选举被取消。28个民选席位中有25席为表列部落保留。选举前安保措施严密，特里普拉邦内政部将91个投票站列为“极度敏感”，347个列为“敏感”。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2010 FA Women's Cup Final was the 40th final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. It was the 17th final to be held under the direct control of the Football Association (FA). The match was contested by Arsenal and Everton at the City Ground on 3 May 2010. Arsenal entered their fifth consecutive final having won the last four.

zh.s: 2010年英格兰足总女子杯决赛是第40届决赛，也是英格兰女子足球队的主要杯赛决赛。英格兰足球总会（FA）直接管理该赛事后，这是第17届决赛。比赛于2010年5月3日在城市球场举行，由阿森纳队对阵埃弗顿队。阿森纳连续第五次闯入决赛，此前已连续赢得四届冠军。

en.s: The 2011 Lincoln, Nebraska mayoral election took place on May 3, 2011. Incumbent Mayor Chris Beutler ran for re-election to a second term. He defeated businesswoman Tammy Buffington with 65% of the vote.

zh.t: 2011年内布拉斯加州林肯市长选举
zh.s: 2011年内布拉斯加州林肯市长选举于2011年5月3日举行。现任市长克里斯·博伊特勒竞选连任，寻求第二个任期。他以65%的选票击败商人塔米·巴芬顿。

en.s: Elections to Dundee City Council were held on 3 May 2012 on the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election used the eight wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system a form of proportional representation, with 29 Councillors elected. After the 2007 Election a Labour-Lib Dem Coalition was formed. This administration subsequently collapsed and a SNP minority administration was formed. The 2012 election saw the Scottish National Party gain 3 seats and secure an overall majority on the Council.

zh.s: 邓迪市议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。选举沿用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的8个选区，每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可转移投票制，共选出29名议员。2007年选举后，工党与自由民主党组成联合政府，后来该政府垮台，苏格兰民族党组成少数派政府。2012年选举中，苏格兰民族党增加3席，并在议会取得多数。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: (Main article: Scottish local elections, 2012) Elections to Clackmannanshire Council were held on 3 May 2012, the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. The election used the five wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 18 Councillors being elected. Each ward elected either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system. The election saw the Scottish National Party gain a seat and increase their vote share on the Council to have the same number of seats as Labour. The Scottish Conservative and Unionist Party retained their single seat on the Council and there remains a single Independent.

zh.s: 克拉克曼南郡议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰另外31个地方政府同日选举。此次选举沿用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的5个选区，共选出18名议员。各选区选出3或4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制。苏格兰民族党赢得一席，得票率也有所上升，席位数追平工党。苏格兰保守党与统一党保住原有的唯一席位，另有一名独立议员。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2012 Gloucester City Council local elections took place on 3 May 2012 to elect members of Gloucester City Council in Gloucester, England. This was on the same day as other United Kingdom local elections were taking place across the country. At the previous Gloucester local elections in 2011, the first after the 2010 general election, of which the result was a hung parliament and subsequently, a Conservative-Liberal Democrat coalition government was formed, both parties shared similar success, winning 9 out of the total 11 seats available (the Conservatives with 6 seats, the Liberal Democrats with 3).

zh.s: 2012年格洛斯特市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰格洛斯特市议会成员。英国其他地方选举也在同一天举行。上一次格洛斯特地方选举于2011年举行，是2010年大选后的首次选举。当时，保守党和自由民主党成绩相近，在11个席位中分别赢得6席和3席；2010年大选后，英国议会出现悬峙，随后组成保守党与自由民主党联合政府。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections to Aberdeenshire Council were held on 3 May 2012, on the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election used the 19 wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system a form of proportional representation, with 68 Councillors being elected. The 2007 election saw the Scottish Liberal Democrats form a coalition on the Council with the Scottish Conservative and Unionist Party. The 2012 election saw the SNP gain an additional 6 seats and become the largest party on the Council, supplanting the Lib Dems.

zh.s: 阿伯丁郡议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。选举沿用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的19个选区，每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可转移投票制，共选出68名议员。2007年选举后，苏格兰自由民主党与苏格兰保守党和统一党组成联合政府。2012年选举中，苏格兰民族党增加6席，取代自由民主党成为议会第一大党。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: (Main article: Scottish local elections, 2012) Elections to East Dunbartonshire Council were held on 3 May 2012, the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. The election used the eight wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 24 Councillors being elected. Each ward elected either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system. The election saw Labour gain 2 seats to draw level with the Scottish National Party. However, Labour remained the largest party in terms of vote share. The Scottish National Party retained all their existing 8 seats and did not run any additional candidates though did significantly raised their vote share.

zh.s: 东邓巴顿郡议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰另外31个地方政府同日选举。此次选举沿用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的8个选区，共选出24名议员。各选区选出3或4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制。工党增加2席，席位数追平苏格兰民族党，但按得票率仍是第一大党。苏格兰民族党保住原有8席，没有增加候选人，但得票率显著上升。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections to Reading Borough Council took place on 3 May 2012, with 16 council seats up for election. The Labour Party gained Church, Katesgrove, Redlands, Kentwood and Caversham wards, giving them a working majority and control of the council. The Conservative Party lost three seats but gained Peppard ward from an independent. The Liberal Democrats lost two seats but held Tilehurst ward, a seat they had lost the previous year to the Conservative Party. The Green Party gained Park ward from Labour but failed to make gains elsewhere seeing their percentage of the borough-wide vote fall slightly.

zh.s: 雷丁自治市议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，共有16个席位改选。工党赢得丘奇、凯茨格罗夫、雷德兰兹、肯特伍德和卡弗沙姆选区，因此取得执政所需的多数并控制议会。保守党失去3席，但从独立议员手中赢得佩帕德选区。自由民主党失去2席，但保住泰尔赫斯特选区；该席位前一年曾被保守党夺走。绿党从工党手中赢得帕克选区，但未能在其他地方取得席位，得票率略有下降。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2012 Ipswich Council election took place on 3 May 2012 to elect members of Ipswich Council in England. This was on the same day as other United Kingdom local elections, 2012. Ipswich Borough Council has 48 councillors who are elected for a term of four years. The councillors are elected in 'thirds' with one councillor in each of the 16 wards retiring each year for three out of four years.Every fourth year there is a break from the borough council elections and elections for county councillors are held instead.Ipswich Borough Council is also responsible for the administration of UK Parliamentary general elections, European Parliamentary elections and national and local referendums.

zh.t: 2012年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2012年伊普斯威奇议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰伊普斯威奇议会成员。英国其他地方选举也在同一天举行。伊普斯威奇自治市议会共有48名议员，任期四年，采用分批改选制度：16个选区每年各有一名议员卸任，连续举行三年；每隔四年则暂停自治市议会选举，改选郡议会议员。该议会也负责组织英国议会大选、欧洲议会选举以及全国和地方公投。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: (Main article: Scottish local elections, 2012) Elections to Perth and Kinross Council were held on 3 May 2012, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election used the twelve wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system a form of proportional representation, with 41 Councillors being elected. The Council was previously controlled by a Liberal Democrat/Scottish National Party coalition administration from 2007-2012. The 2012 elections saw the SNP remain the main party by a significant margin but they did not make further advances.

zh.t: 2012年珀斯和金罗斯郡议会选举
zh.s: 珀斯和金罗斯郡议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。此次选举沿用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的12个选区，每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可转移投票制，共选出41名议员。议会此前由自由民主党和苏格兰民族党组成的联盟执政，任期为2007年至2012年。2012年选举后，苏格兰民族党仍以明显优势成为第一大党，但没有进一步增加席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections to Ceredigion County Council were held on 3 May 2012 along with elections to 20 of the other 21 local authorities in Wales (all except Anglesey), community council elections in Wales and other elections elsewhere in the United Kingdom All 42 council seats were up for election. The previous council was controlled by Independents in coalition with the Liberal Democrat group and the single Labour member. Since 2008, there had been two by-elections in Aberystwyth, Rheidol and Ciliau Aeron which were both won by Plaid Cymru.

zh.s: 锡尔迪金郡议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与威尔士其余21个地方政府中的20个（安格尔西除外）、威尔士社区议会选举以及英国其他地区的选举同期进行。议会全部42席改选。上届议会由独立议员、自由民主党团和唯一一名工党议员组成的联盟控制。自2008年以来，阿伯里斯特威斯、里德尔和基利艾伦选区举行过两次补选，均由威尔士党获胜。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: (Main article: Scottish local elections, 2012) Elections to the City of Edinburgh Council were held on 3 May 2012, the same day as the Scottish local elections, 2012. The election was the second using 17 new wards created as a results of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, each ward elected three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system a form of proportional representation system of election. The main feature of the Elections was the near obliteration of the Scottish Liberal Democrats as they collapsed from 17 to just 3 seats on the City Council which sees the party occupying the position as the smallest party.

zh.s: 爱丁堡市议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰地方选举同日进行。这是2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立17个新选区后的第二次选举，每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可转移投票制。苏格兰自由民主党席位从17席锐减至3席，几乎全军覆没，成为市议会中席位最少的政党。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: (Main article: Scottish local elections, 2012) The 2012 Highland Council election took place on 3 May 2012 to elect members of Highland Council. The election used the twenty-two wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system (a form of proportional representation) and 80 Councillors being elected. The election saw Independent Councillors remain the largest group, while the Scottish National Party increased their representation, replacing the Scottish Liberal Democrats in second place. The Scottish Labour Party also gained an additional seat.

zh.s: 2012年高地议会选举于5月3日举行，选出高地议会议员。此次选举采用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的22个选区，每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可转移投票制，共选出80名议员。独立议员仍是最大团体，苏格兰民族党增加席位，取代苏格兰自由民主党成为第二大团体。苏格兰工党也增加一席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: (Main article: Scottish local elections, 2012) The 2012 Renfrewshire Council election took place on 3 May 2012 to elect members of Renfrewshire Council. The election used the eleven wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system a form of proportional representation, with 40 Councillors being elected. The election saw the Scottish Labour Party gain 5 seats to regain an overall majority on the Council that they had lost at the time of the 2007 Local Elections, while also significantly increasing their vote.

zh.s: 2012年伦弗鲁郡议会选举于5月3日举行，选出伦弗鲁郡议会议员。此次选举采用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的11个选区，每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可转移投票制，共选出40名议员。苏格兰工党增加5席，重新取得多数，收复了2007年地方选举时失去的多数席位；工党得票也显著增加。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: (Main article: Scottish local elections, 2012) Elections to Comhairle nan Eilean Siar (Western Isles Council) were held on 3 May 2012, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election was the second one using the 9 wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004. Each ward elected three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system: a form of proportional representation. A total of 31 Councillors were elected. Independent Councillors retained the large majority of seats on the Council and retained control of the administration.

zh.s: 西部群岛议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。这是2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的9个选区第二次举行选举。每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可转移投票制，共选出31名议员。独立议员保住了大多数席位和议会行政控制权。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: (Main article: Scottish local elections, 2012) The 2012 Aberdeen City Council election took place on 3 May 2012 to elect members of Aberdeen City Council. The election used the 13 wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system a form of proportional representation, with 43 Councillors elected. Local political activist Renee Slater caused great controversy when she registered a mannequin doll as 'Helena Torry' in the Hazlehead/Ashley/Queens Cross ward. This was withdrawn soon after being spotted and a report has been issued to Grampian Police.

zh.s: 2012年阿伯丁市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出阿伯丁市议会议员。此次选举沿用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的13个选区，每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可转移投票制，共选出43名议员。当地政治活动人士蕾妮·斯莱特在黑兹尔黑德、阿什利和皇后十字选区为一个人体模型登记参选，化名“海伦娜·托里”，引发争议。此举很快被发现并撤销，格兰扁警方也收到报告。

en.s: The 2012 United Kingdom local elections were held across England, Scotland and Wales on 3 May 2012. Elections were held in 128 English local authorities, all 32 Scottish local authorities and 21 of the 22 Welsh unitary authorities, alongside three mayoral elections including the London mayoralty and the London Assembly. Referendums were also held in 11 English cities to determine whether or not to introduce directly elected mayors. All registered electors (British, Irish, Commonwealth and European Union citizens) who were aged 18 or over on Thursday 3 May 2012 were entitled to vote in the local elections.

zh.s: 2012年英国地方选举于5月3日在英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士举行。英格兰128个地方政府、苏格兰全部32个地方政府以及威尔士22个单一制地方政府中的21个举行了选举；当天还举行了三场市长选举，包括伦敦市长选举和伦敦议会选举。英格兰11座城市还举行公投，决定是否引入直选市长。凡年满18岁、在当地登记的英国、爱尔兰、英联邦或欧盟公民，均有权参加此次地方选举。

en.s: (Main article: Scottish local elections, 2012) Elections to Angus Council were held on 3 May 2012 the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election used the eight wards, created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system a form of proportional representation, with 29 Councillors being elected. The 2007 Election saw the Scottish National Party lose majority control on the Council. In their stead the Angus Alliance took over the leadership of the Council made up of all parties and groupings opposed to the SNP.

zh.s: 安格斯议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。此次选举沿用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的8个选区，每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可转移投票制，共选出29名议员。2007年选举后，苏格兰民族党失去议会多数，取而代之的是由所有反对该党的政党和团体组成的安格斯联盟。

en.s: Elections to North Lanarkshire Council were held on 3 May 2012 on the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. The election used the twenty wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 70 Councillors being elected. Each ward elected either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system. The election saw Labour retain their traditional position as the largest party on the Council as they gained 1 seat from 2007 and retained their overall majority. The Scottish National Party also increased their representation and remained in second place on the authority with 3 net gains.

zh.s: 北拉纳克郡议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰另外31个地方政府同日选举。选举沿用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的20个选区，共选出70名议员。每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制。工党增加一席，保住了传统的第一大党地位和议会多数。苏格兰民族党也增加席位，净增3席，仍是第二大党。

en.s: The 2012 Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2012 to elect members of Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council in West Yorkshire, England. This was on the same day as other United Kingdom local elections, 2012. The Warley Councillor Keith Hutson stepped down in 2012 due to health reasons. A by-election was held on 19th July 2012. The seat was held by the Liberal Democrats with James Baker winning the seat. In this year Councillor Nader Fekri for Calder ward defected to Labour from the Liberal Democrats in 2012 saying that he could no longer support the coalition in the national parliament with the Conservatives.

zh.t: 2012年卡尔德代尔都会区议会选举
zh.s: 2012年卡尔德代尔都会区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰西约克郡卡尔德代尔都会区议会成员。英国其他地方选举也在同一天举行。沃利选区议员基思·赫德森因健康原因于2012年辞职，该席位于7月19日补选，由自由民主党候选人詹姆斯·贝克赢得。卡尔德选区议员纳德·费克里当年也从自由民主党转投工党，称自己不再支持该党在英国议会与保守党组成的联合政府。

en.s: (Main article: Scottish local elections, 2012) Elections to Falkirk Council were held on 3 May 2012, the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. The election used the nine wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 32 councillors being elected. Each ward elected either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system. The election saw Labour remain the largest party on the Council despite being outpolled in terms of votes by the Scottish National Party. The Scottish Conservative and Unionist Party saw their vote share fall but held their Council seats and Independents returned 3 seats as they did in the 2007 Local Elections.

zh.s: 福尔柯克议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰另外31个地方政府同日选举。此次选举采用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的9个选区，共选出32名议员。每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制。尽管苏格兰民族党得票多于工党，工党仍是议会第一大党。苏格兰保守党和统一党的得票率下降，但保住了议会席位。独立议员赢得3席，与2007年地方选举相同。

en.s: Elections to Scottish Borders Council were held on 3 May 2012, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election used the 11 wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system, a form of proportional representation, with 34 Councillors elected. The election saw the Scottish Conservative Party remain the largest party on the Council though they lost 1 seat. The Scottish National Party replaced the Scottish Liberal Democrats as the second largest party by gaining 3 seats at the expense of the latter.

zh.s: 苏格兰边区议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。此次选举采用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的11个选区，每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可转移投票制，共选出34名议员。苏格兰保守党仍是议会第一大党，但失去一席。苏格兰民族党增加3席，取代自由民主党成为第二大党。

en.t: Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council election, 2012
en.s: The 2012 Basingstoke and Deane Council election was held on 3 May 2012 to elect members of Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council in Hampshire, England. 21 out of 60 seats were up for reelection; Popley East had two council seats up for reelection. The Conservative Party retained control of the council with 32 out of 60 seats, losing one seat to the Labour Party in Buckskin and losing another seat in Bramley and Sherfield to an Independent. Labour overtook the Liberal Democrats to become the largest opposition party and won two seats from them in Brighton Hill South and Brookvale and Kings Furlong.

zh.t: 2012年贝辛斯托克和迪恩自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2012年贝辛斯托克和迪恩议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰汉普郡贝辛斯托克和迪恩自治市议会议员。60个席位中有21席改选，波普利东选区有两个席位改选。保守党以32席保住议会控制权，但在巴克斯金选区失去一席给工党，在布拉姆利和谢菲尔德选区失去一席给独立候选人。工党超过自由民主党，成为最大的反对党，并从自由民主党手中赢得布莱顿山南区和布鲁克维尔—金斯福隆两个席位。

en.s: The 2012 Orkney Council election took place on 3 May 2012 to elect members of Orkney Council. The election used the six wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system a form of proportional representation, with 21 Councillors being elected. As in 2007 Independents took all of the 21 seats on the Council. The Scottish National Party contested 4 wards in Orkney for the first time in 2012 but only secured 3% of the vote. The Council is again administered solely by Independents.

zh.s: 2012年奥克尼群岛议会选举于5月3日举行，选出奥克尼议会议员。此次选举采用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的6个选区，每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可转移投票制，共选出21名议员。与2007年一样，全部21席都由独立候选人赢得。苏格兰民族党在2012年首次竞选奥克尼4个选区，但只获得3%的选票。议会再次完全由独立议员执政。

en.s: Elections to Fife Council were held on 3 May 2012, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election used the 23 wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system a form of proportional representation, with 78 Councillors elected. The biggest benefactors were the Labour party who regained the 11 seats they had lost in the 2007 Local Elections thus increase its share to remain the largest party.

zh.s: 法夫郡议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。选举沿用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的23个选区，每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可转移投票制，共选出78名议员。工党收复了2007年地方选举中失去的11席，得票率也因此提高，并继续保持第一大党地位。

en.s: Elections to Argyll and Bute Council were held on 3 May 2012 on the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. The election used the eleven wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 36 councillors being elected. Each ward elected either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system. After the 2007 Local Election a coalition was formed between the Alliance for Independents group and the Scottish National Party. This arrangement subsequently broke up and the Independent group formed a minority administration with the support of the Scottish Liberal Democrats.

zh.s: 阿盖尔-比特郡议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰另外31个地方政府同日选举。选举沿用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的11个选区，共选出36名议员。每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制。2007年地方选举后，独立人士联盟与苏格兰民族党组成联合政府。此后联盟解散，独立议员组成少数派政府，并得到苏格兰自由民主党的支持。

en.s: The 2012 Sandwell Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2012 to elect members of Sandwell Metropolitan Borough Council in the West Midlands, England. This was on the same day as other United Kingdom local elections, 2012. In the ward of Great Bridge, the Conservative Party was criticised for fielding a candidate who had the same name as the Labour Party councillor. Due to being elected 'in thirds', councillors elected at the Sandwell Council election, 2008 were defending their seats in 2012. The Labour Party won every seat, increasing their majority.

zh.t: 2012年桑德韦尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2012年桑德韦尔都市自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰西米德兰兹郡桑德韦尔都市自治市议会议员，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。大桥选区的保守党因提名了一名与工党议员同名的候选人而受到批评。由于议员按“三分之一改选”的方式选出，2008年当选的桑德韦尔议员在2012年竞选连任。工党赢得全部席位，扩大了多数优势。

en.s: (Main article: Scottish local elections, 2012) The 2012 Midlothian Council election took place on 3 May 2012 to elect members of Midlothian Council. The election used the six wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system a form of proportional representation, with 18 Councillors being elected. The election saw Labour retain their traditional position as the largest party on the Council though they lost compared to the 2007 Election.

zh.s: 2012年中洛锡安议会选举于5月3日举行，选出中洛锡安议会议员。选举沿用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的6个选区，每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可转移投票制，共选出18名议员。工党仍是议会第一大党，但与2007年相比有所失利。

en.s: Elections to East Lothian Council were held on 3 May 2012, on the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election used the 7 wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system a form of proportional representation, with 23 councillors elected. The election saw Labour regain their previous position as the largest party on the Council as they regained 3 of the seats they had lost in the 2007 Local Elections while also significantly increasing their vote share.

zh.s: 东洛锡安议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。此次选举沿用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的7个选区，每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可转移投票制，共选出23名议员。工党收复了第一大党的地位，夺回了2007年地方选举中失去的3席，得票率也显著上升。

en.s: The 2012 East Renfrewshire Council election took place on 3 May 2012 to elect members of East Renfrewshire Council. The election used the six wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system a form of proportional representation, with 20 Councillors being elected. The election saw Labour gain 1 seat while also increasing their vote share. The Scottish Conservative and Unionist Party lost 1 seat and saw their vote share fall as they now become the second largest party on the Council.

zh.s: 2012年东伦弗鲁郡议会选举于5月3日举行，选出东伦弗鲁郡议会议员。选举沿用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的6个选区，每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可转移投票制，共选出20名议员。工党增加一席，得票率也有所上升。苏格兰保守党和统一党失去一席，得票率下降，成为议会第二大党。

en.s: The 2012 Rushmoor Council elections took place on Thursday 3 May 2012 to elect members of Rushmoor Borough Council in Hampshire, England. It was a very good night for the Labour Party and their Leader Cllr Keith Dibble who achieved the highest percentage vote on the night. Labour gained the three seats in the new Cherrywood ward in Farnborough.The first time Labour has had councillors in Farnborough for ten years. The controlling Tories lost 5 seats, Labour gained 5, UKIP gained 1 and the Lib dems lost all 4 seats.

zh.t: 2012年拉什穆尔自治市议会选举
zh.s: 拉什穆尔自治市议会选举于2012年5月3日（星期四）举行，选出英格兰汉普郡拉什穆尔自治市议会议员。工党表现突出，党魁基思·迪布尔议员在当晚取得最高得票率。工党赢得法恩伯勒新设的樱桃木选区全部3席，这是工党10年来首次在法恩伯勒拥有议员。执政的保守党失去5席，工党增加5席，英国独立党增加1席，自由民主党失去全部4席。

en.s: Elections to Glasgow City Council were held on 3 May 2012, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election was the second using 21 new wards created as a results of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, each ward elected three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system a form of proportional representation. The election in Glasgow attracted the most attention out of the local elections in Scotland as there were many predictions that the Scottish Labour Party would lose control of the council due to losses of seats to the Scottish National Party.

zh.s: 格拉斯哥市议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。这是2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立21个新选区后的第二次选举，每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可转移投票制。苏格兰地方选举中，格拉斯哥受到最多关注，因为许多人预测苏格兰工党可能会因苏格兰民族党抢走席位而失去对市议会的控制。

en.s: (Main article: Scottish local elections, 2012) Elections to Stirling Council were held on 3 May 2012, the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. The election will use the seven wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 22 councillors being elected. Each ward will elect either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system. The election saw the Scottish National Party increase their representation by 2 seats and significantly increase their vote share to become the largest party on the Council.

zh.s: 斯特灵议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰另外31个地方政府同日选举。此次选举采用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的7个选区，共选出22名议员。每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制。苏格兰民族党增加2席，得票率也大幅上升，成为议会第一大党。

en.s: The 2012 Fareham Borough Council elections took take place on 3 May 2012 to elect half the members of Fareham Borough Council in Hampshire, England. The Conservative Party are currently the largest party on the council. The Conservative Party held every seat they defended and gained one from the Lib Dems, in Fareham North West, which saw Dave Whittingham unseat Eric Dunn. The closest to an upset came in Stubbington where 22-year-old Christopher Wood for the UK Independence Party came second with 34.4% of the vote, behind the Conservative's Kay Mandry, who won 38.8%.

zh.s: 2012年费勒姆自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，改选英格兰汉普郡费勒姆自治市议会一半的席位。保守党当时是议会第一大党，保住了所有改选席位，并从自由民主党手中赢得西北费勒姆选区一席，戴夫·惠廷厄姆击败埃里克·邓恩。斯塔宾顿选区最接近出现意外：英国独立党候选人、22岁的克里斯托弗·伍德以34.4%的得票率位居第二，保守党候选人凯·曼德里以38.8%获胜。

en.s: Elections to Inverclyde Council were held on 3 May 2012, the same day as the other 31 local authorities in Scotland. The election used the six wards created as a results of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system a form of proportional representation, with 20 Councillors being elected in total. The election saw Labour Councillors remain the largest party as they gained 1 additional seat to hold half the seats on the Council. The Scottish National Party also increased their representation by 1 seat and remained in second place on the authority.

zh.s: 因弗克莱德议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰另外31个地方政府同日进行。选举沿用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的6个选区，每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用比例代表制的单记可转移投票制，共选出20名议员。工党增加一席，继续保持第一大党地位，席位数达到议会总席位的一半。苏格兰民族党也增加一席，仍是第二大党。

en.s: (Main article: Scottish local elections, 2012) Elections to the Moray Council were held on 3 May 2012, the same day as the other 31 local authorities in Scotland. The election used the eight wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 26 councillors being elected. Each ward elected either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system. The election saw the Scottish National Party increase their representation by 1 seat, equalling the seat numbers of the Independents who lost 2 seats, while becoming the largest party on the Council in terms of vote share.

zh.s: 莫里郡议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府同日选举。此次选举沿用2004年《苏格兰地方治理法》设立的8个选区，共选出26名议员。每个选区选出3或4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制。苏格兰民族党增加一席，席位数追平失去两席的独立议员；按得票率计算，苏格兰民族党成为议会第一大党。

en.s: The 2012 Thurrock Council election took place on 3 May 2012 to elect members of Thurrock Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other United Kingdom local elections, 2012. The result was: * Labour 25 (+1) (39% of vote) * Conservative 21 (-1) (30%) * Independent 2 ( 7%) * UKIP 1 (+1) (18%) * LibDem 0 ( 4%) * other 0 ( 2%) * vacant 0 (-1) The Labour party took overall control (previously NOC with Labour administration).

zh.s: 2012年瑟罗克议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰瑟罗克自治市议会议员，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。工党获25席（增加1席，得票率39%），保守党获21席（减少1席，30%），独立候选人获2席（7%），英国独立党获1席（增加1席，18%），自由民主党未获席位（4%），其他候选人未获席位（2%），另有1席空缺（减少1席）。工党取得议会多数并开始全面执政；此前议会没有任何政党单独占多数，但由工党主持少数派政府。

en.s: The 2012 Southampton Council election took place on Thursday 3 May 2012 to elect members of Southampton Unitary Council in Hampshire, England. One third of the council (16 seats) was scheduled for election, whilst two additional vacancies, caused by the resignation of sitting councillors, were also filled in Bitterne Park and Peartree wards, meaning a total of 18 of the city’s 48 seats were elected. Labour won a majority of the seats being contested, and also gained overall control of the council from the Conservatives. Southampton Council is elected in thirds, which means the all comparisons are to the corresponding Southampton Council election, 2008.

en.s: Elections to West Dunbartonshire Council were held on 3 May 2012 on the same day as the 31 other local authorities in Scotland. The election used the six wards created under the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with 22 Councillors being elected. Each ward elected either 3 or 4 members, using the STV electoral system. The election saw the Scottish Labour Party gain 2 seats to secure an overall majority on the Council while also significantly increasing their vote. The Scottish National Party remained in second place on the Council but West Dunbartonshire proved to be their worst performance in Scotland as they lost 3 seats including that of their former Council leader, Ronnie McColl.

zh.s: 2012年温彻斯特市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰温彻斯特市议会议员。保守党取得议会绝对多数；此前议会无人取得绝对多数。

en.t: 2012 Merthyr Tydfil County Borough Council election
en.s: The 2012 Merthyr Tydfil County Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2012 to elect members of Merthyr Tydfil County Borough Council in Wales. This was on the same day as other 2012 United Kingdom local elections. The Council shifted from Independent to Labour.

zh.t: 2012年梅瑟蒂德菲尔郡自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2012年梅瑟蒂德菲尔郡自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出威尔士梅瑟蒂德菲尔郡自治市议会议员。选举与英国其他地区2012年地方选举同日举行。选后，议会控制权从独立议员转到工党手中。

en.s: The 2012 Cardiff Council election took place on Thursday 3 May 2012 to elect members of Cardiff Council in Wales. This was the same day as the national 2012 Welsh local elections.

zh.s: 2012年加的夫议会选举于2012年5月3日星期四举行，选出威尔士加的夫议会议员，与2012年威尔士地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2012 West Lothian Council election took place on 3 May 2012 to elect members of West Lothian Council. The election used the 9 wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation, with 33 Councillors being elected. The Bathgate Ward gained an additional seat for the 2012 elections.

zh.s: 2012年西洛锡安议会选举于5月3日举行，选出西洛锡安议会议员。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的9个选区，每个选区按单记可转移投票制选出3至4名议员，共选出33名议员。巴斯盖特选区在2012年增加1个席位。

en.s: The London Assembly election of 2012 was an election of members to the London Assembly which took place on Thursday, 3 May 2012, the same day as the 2012 London mayoral election, and the 2012 United Kingdom local elections. Although Conservative candidate Boris Johnson won the Mayoral election, the Assembly election produced the Labour Party's best result since the inception of the London Assembly; this was subsequently surpassed by the party's performance in the 2016 election.

zh.s: 2012年伦敦议会选举于5月3日星期四举行，与2012年伦敦市长选举和2012年英国地方选举同日进行。保守党候选人鲍里斯·约翰逊赢得市长选举，但工党在议会选举中的成绩创下伦敦议会成立以来的最佳纪录；这一纪录后来被工党在2016年选举中的表现打破。

en.s: Elections to Shetland Islands Council were held on 3 May 2012, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election was the second using the seven new wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, each ward elected three or four Councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation, with 22 Councillors elected.

zh.s: 设得兰群岛议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。这是第二次采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的7个新选区。每个选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制，共选出22名议员。

en.s: Elections to Norwich City Council took place on 3 May 2012, the same day as other 2012 United Kingdom local elections. Fifteen out of thirty-nine council seats were up for election and the Labour Party gained control of the council from No Overall Control. The Green Party held firm, while the Liberal Democrats and Conservatives suffered losses.

zh.s: 诺里奇市议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与英国其他地区的2012年地方选举同日进行。议会39个席位中的15席改选。工党从此前无人取得绝对多数的议会中取得控制权。绿党保住原有席位，自由民主党和保守党则失去席位。

en.s: The 2012 Dumfries and Galloway Council election took place on 3 May 2012 to elect members of Dumfries and Galloway Council. The election used the thirteen wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation, with 47 councillors being elected.

zh.t: 2012年邓弗里斯和加洛韦议会选举
zh.s: 2012年邓弗里斯和加洛韦议会选举于5月3日举行，选出该议会议员。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的13个选区，每个选区按单记可转移投票制选出3至4名议员，共选出47名议员。

en.s: The 2012 North Ayrshire Council election took place on 3 May 2012 to elect members of North Ayrshire Council. The election used the eight wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, with each ward electing three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation, with 30 Councillors being elected.

zh.s: 2012年北艾尔郡议会选举于5月3日举行，选出该议会议员。选举采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的8个选区，每个选区按单记可转移投票制选出3至4名议员，共选出30名议员。

en.s: The 2012 London mayoral election was an election held on Thursday 3 May 2012, to elect the Mayor of London. It was held on the same day as the London Assembly election, and used a supplementary vote system. Incumbent Tory mayor and future Prime Minister Boris Johnson won re-election to a second term as Mayor.

zh.s: 2012年伦敦市长选举于2012年5月3日星期四举行，选出伦敦市长。选举与伦敦议会选举同日进行，采用补充投票制。保守党籍现任市长鲍里斯·约翰逊再次当选，开始第二个市长任期；他日后成为英国首相。

en.s: The 2012 Wigan Council elections to the Thirtieth Wigan Council were held on 3 May 2012, the same day as other local elections. One-third of the council was up for election. As Wigan Metropolitan Borough Council is elected in thirds, change in vote share is compared with the corresponding 2008 elections and calculated on that basis.

zh.t: 2012年威根都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2012年威根议会选举于5月3日举行，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位改选。由于威根都市自治市议会按三分之一席位轮流改选，得票率变化是与2008年对应的选举相比后计算的。

en.s: Sheffield City Council elections took place on Thursday 3 May 2012 as part of the 2012 United Kingdom local elections. There were 28 seats up for election, one third of the council. The last election in 2011 gave Labour a majority over the Liberal Democrats with 49 councillors. However, one Independent councillor joined Labour after the election, giving the party 50 seats.

zh.s: 谢菲尔德市议会选举于2012年5月3日星期四举行，是2012年英国地方选举的一部分。议会三分之一席位改选，共28席。2011年上次选举后，工党以49名议员领先自由民主党，并取得多数。随后一名独立议员加入工党，使该党席位增加到50席。

en.s: Elections to East Ayrshire Council were held on 3 May 2012, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election is the second using 9 new wards created as a result of the Local Governance (Scotland) Act 2004, each ward elected three or four councillors using the single transferable vote system form of proportional representation.

zh.s: 东艾尔郡议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。这是第二次采用《2004年苏格兰地方治理法》设立的9个新选区，每个选区选出3至4名议员，采用单记可转移投票制，实行比例代表制。

en.s: The 2012 South Ayrshire Council election took place on 3 May 2012 on the same day as the 31 other Scottish local government elections. As with other Scottish council elections, it was held using single transferable vote (STV) – a form of proportional representation – in which multiple candidates are elected in each ward and voters rank candidates in order of preference.

zh.s: 南艾尔郡议会选举于2012年5月3日举行，与苏格兰其他31个地方政府选举同日进行。和苏格兰其他议会选举一样，本次选举采用单记可转移投票制（一种比例代表制）：每个选区选出多名议员，选民按偏好给候选人排序。

en.s: Elections to Hyndburn Borough Councill were held on Thursday, 3 May 2012. One third of the council was up for election.

zh.s: 亨德本自治市议会选举于2012年5月3日星期四举行，议会三分之一席位改选。

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 3 May 2014. The two seats up for election were the electoral division of Huon and the electoral division of Rosevears. These seats were last contested in 2008.

zh.t: 2014年塔斯马尼亚立法会定期选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法会定期选举于2014年5月3日举行。休恩和罗斯维尔两个选区的席位改选，这些席位上次于2008年改选。

en.s: The 2014 Coppa Italia final decided the winner of the 2013–14 Coppa Italia, Italy's main football cup. It was played on 3 May 2014 at the Stadio Olimpico in Rome, between Fiorentina and Napoli. Napoli won the game 3–1, with two early goals from Lorenzo Insigne and a late third by substitute Dries Mertens, although they had Gökhan Inler sent off in the second half.

zh.s: 2014年意大利杯决赛决出了2013—14赛季冠军，是意大利主要足球杯赛的决赛。比赛于2014年5月3日在罗马奥林匹克体育场举行，由佛罗伦萨队对阵那不勒斯队。那不勒斯以3比1获胜，洛伦佐·因西涅早早连进两球，替补登场的德里斯·默滕斯在最后阶段打入第三球；他们的球员居尔汗·因勒在下半场被罚下。

en.s: The 2014 Coupe de France final decided the winner of the 2013–14 Coupe de France, the 97th season of France's premier football cup. It was played on 3 May at the Stade de France in Saint-Denis, Paris. In the final, Guingamp beat Rennes 2–0 in a Derby Breton to win their second Coupe de France title.

zh.s: 2014年法国杯决赛决出了2013—14赛季法国杯冠军，是该赛事第97个赛季的决赛。比赛于5月3日在巴黎圣但尼法兰西体育场举行。甘冈队在“布列塔尼德比”中以2比0击败雷恩队，第二次夺得法国杯冠军。

en.s: The 2014 Supercopa de Chile was the second edition of this championship organised by the Asociación Nacional de Fútbol Profesional (ANFP). The match was played between the 2013–14 Primera División Best-Champions O'Higgins, and the 2013–14 Copa Chile Winners Deportes Iquique. O'Higgins won its first Supercopa in his history, winning 3–2 on penalties, after a 1–1 draw at the end of 120 minutes with goals of Rodrigo Díaz for Iquique and Luis Pedro Figueroa for O'Higgins.

zh.s: 2014年智利超级杯是该项赛事的第二届，由国家职业足球协会（ANFP）主办。比赛由2013—14赛季智利甲级联赛冠军奥希金斯队对阵2013—14赛季智利杯冠军伊基克体育队。奥希金斯队在120分钟内与伊基克队1比1战平，随后以点球大战3比2获胜，队史首次夺得超级杯。罗德里戈·迪亚斯为伊基克进球，路易斯·佩德罗·菲格罗亚为奥希金斯进球。

en.s: The Curtis Culwell Center attack was carried out by two men who attacked officers with gunfire at the entrance to an exhibit featuring cartoon images of Muhammad at the Curtis Culwell Center in Garland, Texas on May 3, 2015. The attackers shot a Garland Independent School District (ISD) security officer in the ankle. Shortly after the attackers pulled up and opened fire, both were shot and wounded by a police officer (who was wrongly credited with killing the two men in initial news reports), and eventually killed by four members of a SWAT team.

zh.t: 柯蒂斯·库尔韦尔中心袭击事件
zh.s: 2015年5月3日，两名男子在得克萨斯州加兰市柯蒂斯·库尔韦尔中心一场展览入口处向警员开枪。展览展出了描绘穆罕默德的漫画。袭击者朝加兰独立学区的一名保安人员脚踝开枪。两人驾车抵达并开火后，一名警察将他们击伤；初期新闻报道曾错误地称该警察击毙了两人。随后，特警队4名成员将两名袭击者击毙。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 KNVB Cup final was an association football match between PEC Zwolle and FC Groningen on 3 May 2015 at De Kuip, Rotterdam. It was the final match of the 2014–15 KNVB Cup, the 97th edition of the Dutch cup competition, the KNVB Cup. PEC were appearing in their fourth KNVB Cup final and were the defending champions, having won the trophy for the first time the previous year by defeating Ajax 5–1.

zh.s: 2015年荷兰杯决赛于2015年5月3日在鹿特丹德奎普球场举行，由兹沃勒PEC队对阵格罗宁根足球俱乐部。这是2014—15赛季荷兰杯的决赛，也是该赛事第97届。兹沃勒PEC队第四次闯入决赛，并以卫冕冠军身份参赛；该队在前一年以5比1击败阿贾克斯，首次夺冠。

en.s: The 2015 Campeonato Paraense final was the final that decided the 2015 Campeonato Paraense, the 103rd season of the Campeonato Paraense. The final were contested between Independente and Remo. Remo defeated Independente 2–0 to win their 44th Campeonato Paraense title.

zh.s: 2015年帕拉州锦标赛决赛决出了该赛事第103个赛季的冠军。独立队和雷莫队争夺冠军，雷莫队以2比0击败独立队，第四次夺得帕拉州锦标赛冠军。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Al-Karmah offensive, codenamed Fajr al-Karma, was an offensive launched by the Iraqi Army and anti-IS Sunni tribal fighters to recapture the Al-Karmah district taken by the Islamic State in Iraq. The offensive began on 14 April 2015. During the offensive the anti-IS forces captured part of the city of Al-Karmah, and the old road of Al-Karmah.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 卡尔马攻势代号为“卡尔马黎明”，由伊拉克军队和反对“伊斯兰国”的逊尼派部落武装发动，目标是夺回被“伊斯兰国”占领的伊拉克卡尔马区。攻势于2015年4月14日开始。行动期间，反“伊斯兰国”部队夺取了卡尔马市部分地区和卡尔马旧路。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框所列的事件结束日期。
