en.s: The 2016 Indiana Democratic presidential primary took place on May 3 in the U.S. state of Indiana as one of the Democratic Party's primaries ahead of the 2016 presidential election. The Republican Party held their own Indiana primary on the same day. Other primaries were not held that day.

zh.t: 2016年印第安纳州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2016年印第安纳州民主党总统初选于5月3日举行，是美国总统选举前民主党初选的一部分。同日，共和党也在印第安纳州举行初选，其他州当天没有举行初选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2016 Indiana Republican presidential primary was held on May 3 in the U.S. state of Indiana as one of the Republican Party's primaries ahead of the 2016 presidential election. This was a winner-take-all election, so Donald Trump, who came in first in the popular vote, won all the delegates. The Democratic Party held their own Indiana primary on the same day, which was won by Bernie Sanders.

zh.t: 2016年印第安纳州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2016年印第安纳州共和党总统初选于5月3日举行，是美国总统大选前共和党初选的一部分。这是赢家通吃的选举，因此在普选中得票第一的唐纳德·特朗普赢得全部代表席位。同日，民主党也在印第安纳州举行初选，伯尼·桑德斯获胜。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The UAAP Season 80 Men's Football Final took place on 3 May 2017 at the Rizal Memorial Stadium. It was the final match of the UAAP Season 80 and was contested between the UP Fighting Maroons and the UST Growling Tigers. UP won 1-0, with Ian Clarino's 21st minute goal to claim their eighteenth UAAP Football Championship title.

zh.s: UAAP第80赛季男子足球决赛于2017年5月3日在黎刹纪念体育场举行，是UAAP第80赛季的最后一场比赛。菲律宾大学斗士队对阵圣托马斯大学咆哮虎队。菲律宾大学以1比0获胜，伊恩·克拉里诺在第21分钟进球，帮助球队第18次夺得UAAP足球冠军。

en.s: The 2018 Woking Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect one third of members to Woking Borough Council in England coinciding with other local elections held across much of England. Elections in each ward are held in three years out of four. Woking was one of the boroughs subject to a trial of voter ID requiring the production of photographic ID or 2 other forms of ID at the polling station.

zh.s: 2018年沃金自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰沃金自治市议会三分之一的议员，与英格兰大部分地区的地方选举同日举行。各选区每四年中有三年举行选举。沃金是试行选民身份核验的自治市之一，选民投票时须出示带照片的身份证件，或另外两种身份证明。

en.s: The 2018 Brent London Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Brent London Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2018年布伦特伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年布伦特伦敦自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰布伦特伦敦自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Bromley London Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Bromley London Borough Council in England. This was the same day as other local elections. Bromley was one of the boroughs subject to a trial of voter ID restrictions requiring the production of photographic ID or 2 other forms of ID.

zh.t: 2018年布罗姆利伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年布罗姆利伦敦自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰布罗姆利伦敦自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。布罗姆利是试行选民身份核验限制的自治市之一，选民投票时须出示带照片的身份证件，或另外两种身份证明。

en.s: The 2018 Newham London Borough Council election was held on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Newham London Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Elections were held for the Mayor of Newham and for all 60 seats on the council. The Labour Party candidate Rokhsana Fiaz won the mayoral election.

zh.t: 2018年纽汉伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年纽汉伦敦自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰纽汉伦敦自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。纽汉市长也在当天选出，议会60个席位全部改选。工党候选人罗克萨娜·法亚兹赢得市长选举。

en.t: 2018 St Helens Metropolitan Borough Council election
en.s: The 2018 St Helens Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of St Helens Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. It saw the Green Party get the biggest vote growth, However the only seat change was in Rainhill where an Independent beat Labour. Elsewhere UKIP's Vote share collapsed.

zh.t: 2018年圣海伦斯都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年圣海伦斯都市自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰圣海伦斯都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。绿党的得票增长最大，但唯一的席位变动发生在雷恩希尔：一名独立候选人击败工党候选人。英国独立党（UKIP）的得票率则大幅下滑。

en.s: The 2018 Fareham Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Fareham Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Half of the seats were up for re-election, with each councillor elected for a term of 4 years. The last time these seats were contested was in 2014.

zh.s: 2018年费勒姆自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰费勒姆自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会一半席位改选，当选议员任期四年。这些席位上次于2014年改选。

en.s: The 2018 Chorley Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Chorley Borough Council in Chorley, Lancashire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Labour retained its majority on the Council.

zh.s: 2018年乔利自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰兰开夏郡乔利自治市议会议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日举行。工党继续保持议会多数。

en.t: 2018 Kingston upon Thames London Borough Council election
en.s: The 2018 Kingston upon Thames Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Kingston upon Thames Council in London, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2018年泰晤士河畔金斯顿伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年泰晤士河畔金斯顿自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰伦敦泰晤士河畔金斯顿自治市议会议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.t: 2018 Nuneaton and Bedworth Borough Council election
en.s: The 2018 Nuneaton and Bedworth Borough Council election was held on 3 May 2018, as part of 2018 United Kingdom local elections. Half of the council was up for election and the Labour Party lost overall control of the council to no overall control.

zh.t: 2018年纳尼顿和贝德沃思自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年纳尼顿和贝德沃思自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，是2018年英国地方选举的一部分。议会一半席位改选，工党失去对议会的控制权，选后无人取得绝对多数。

en.s: The 2018 Leeds City Council election took place on Thursday 3 May 2018 to elect members of Leeds City Council in England. It was held on the same day as other UK local elections across England. Following a full boundary review of Leeds' 33 electoral wards by the Local Government Boundary Commission, the all-out election saw all of the council's 99 available council seats contested based on the new ward boundaries.

zh.s: 2018年利兹市议会选举于2018年5月3日星期四举行，选出英格兰利兹市议会议员，与英格兰各地其他英国地方选举同日进行。地方政府边界委员会全面审查利兹33个选区后，议会全部99个席位均按新选区边界改选。

en.s: Elections to Welwyn Hatfield Borough Council took place on 3 May 2018. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom. The Conservatives saw a reduction in their number of seats, only just hanging on to majority of the council.

zh.t: 2018年韦林哈特菲尔德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 韦林哈特菲尔德自治市议会选举于2018年5月3日举行，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。保守党席位减少，只以微弱多数继续控制议会。

en.s: The 2018 Exeter City Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect a third (13/39) of the members of Exeter City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The election result left the council with the same political make up as it had before the election, with Labour in control with 29 seats and the Conservatives as the main opposition party, returning with 8.

zh.s: 2018年埃克塞特市议会选举于5月3日举行，改选英格兰埃克塞特市议会39个席位中的三分之一（13席），与其他地方选举同日进行。选后议会的党派构成没有变化：工党仍以29席执政，保守党有8席，是主要反对党。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of West Tyrone was held on 3 May 2018, following the resignation of incumbent Sinn Féin MP Barry McElduff who became embroiled in a controversy over a video he posted on Twitter making a joke about the Kingsmill massacre on its anniversary. The by-election was won by Sinn Féin candidate Órfhlaith Begley, who held the seat with a slightly reduced majority.

zh.s: 英国西蒂龙选区议会补选于2018年5月3日举行。现任新芬党议员巴里·麦克埃尔达夫因在推特发布视频、在金斯米尔屠杀纪念日拿此事开玩笑而陷入争议，随后辞职。新芬党候选人奥弗莱思·贝格利赢得补选并保住席位，胜选多数略有下降。

en.s: The 2018 Islington Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Islington London Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The council had previously had elections in 2014. The Labour Party retained control of the council, winning 47 of the 48 seats. The sole non-Labour councillor elected was Caroline Russell of the Green Party.

zh.t: 2018年伊斯灵顿伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年伊斯灵顿伦敦自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰伊斯灵顿伦敦自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。上一次议会选举于2014年举行。工党继续控制议会，赢得48席中的47席。唯一当选的非工党议员是绿党的卡罗琳·罗素。

en.s: The 2018 Lambeth London Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 alongside other local elections in London, to elect members of Lambeth London Borough Council in England. The election saw Labour remain in control of Lambeth Council with a slightly reduced majority, winning over 90% of the seats. The Green Party achieved its best-ever result in the borough, winning five seats and becoming the official opposition and the largest Green group in London.

zh.t: 2018年兰贝斯伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年兰贝斯伦敦自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，与伦敦其他地方选举同日进行。工党继续控制兰贝斯议会，席位多数略有减少，但仍赢得超过90%的席位。绿党在该自治市取得历来最佳成绩，赢得5席，成为正式反对党，也是伦敦规模最大的绿党议员团。

en.s: The 2018 Hillingdon Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Hillingdon London Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Conservative Party retained control with an increased majority.

zh.t: 2018年希灵登伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年希灵登自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰希灵登伦敦自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。保守党继续控制议会，且多数席位有所增加。

en.s: The 2018 Cambridge City Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Cambridge City Council in England. This was on the same day as other nationwide local elections.

zh.s: 2018年剑桥市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰剑桥市议会议员，与英国各地其他地方选举同日举行。

en.t: 2018 Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council election
en.s: The 2018 Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council in England. This was the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2018年布莱克本与达尔文自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年布莱克本与达尔文自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰布莱克本与达尔文自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Knowsley Metropolitan Borough Council Election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Knowsley Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2018年诺斯利都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年诺斯利都市自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰诺斯利都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: Elections to Peterborough City Council took place on 3 May 2018. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 彼得伯勒市议会选举于2018年5月3日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2018 Havant Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Havant Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2018年哈文特自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰哈文特自治市议会议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Trafford Metropolitan Borough Council election to elect members of Trafford Metropolitan Borough Council in England took place on 3 May 2018. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council stood for election, with each successful candidate serving a four-year term of office, expiring in 2022.

zh.t: 2018年特拉福德都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 特拉福德都市自治市议会选举于2018年5月3日举行，选出英格兰特拉福德都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位改选，当选者任期四年，于2022年届满。

en.s: The 2018 Redditch Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Redditch Borough Council in England. The Conservatives won control of the council from Labour with 17 seats, compared to 12 for Labour and 0 for the UKIP.

zh.s: 2018年雷迪奇自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰雷迪奇自治市议会议员。保守党以17席从工党手中夺得议会控制权；工党有12席，英国独立党（UKIP）没有席位。

en.s: The 2018 Walsall Council election took place on 3 May 2018, to elect members of Walsall Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2018年沃尔索尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年沃尔索尔议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰沃尔索尔议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.t: 2018 Kensington and Chelsea London Borough Council election
en.s: The 2018 Kensington and Chelsea London Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Kensington and Chelsea London Borough Council in England. The election was held on the same day as other local elections in England. While Kensington and Chelsea is usually regarded as a Conservative stronghold, there was media speculation that Labour could win control of the council in the wake of the Grenfell Tower fire.

zh.t: 2018年肯辛顿-切尔西伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年肯辛顿-切尔西伦敦自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰肯辛顿-切尔西伦敦自治市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。肯辛顿-切尔西通常被视为保守党的稳固票仓，但格伦费尔大厦火灾后，媒体猜测工党可能赢得议会控制权。

en.s: The 2018 Barnet Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Barnet Borough Council in London, England. It took place on the same day as other local elections in 2018. In the last election, the Conservatives won control of the council with 32 seats, compared to 30 for Labour and 1 for the Liberal Democrats.

zh.t: 2018年巴尼特伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年巴尼特自治市议会选举于5月3日在伦敦举行，与2018年其他地方选举同日进行。上一次选举中，保守党赢得32席并控制议会；工党和自由民主党分别赢得30席和1席。

en.s: The 2018 Colchester Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members to Colchester Borough Council in Essex, England. Seventeen members of the council - one-third of the whole — were elected, one from each of the seventeen wards. It was the first standard election to take place following comprehensive boundary changes in 2016.

zh.t: 2018年科尔切斯特自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年科尔切斯特自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡科尔切斯特自治市议会的17名议员，每个选区各选出1人，相当于议会全部席位的三分之一。这是2016年全面调整选区边界后首次举行常规选举。

en.s: The 2018 Plymouth City Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Plymouth City Council in England. The election was won by the Labour Party, who gained enough seats to achieve an overall majority and took control of the council. A coalition of Conservative and UK Independence Party (UKIP) councillors had taken control of the council after the 2016 election, with thirty members in total and a working majority.

zh.s: 2018年普利茅斯市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰普利茅斯市议会议员。工党赢得足够席位，取得议会绝对多数并控制议会。2016年选举后，保守党和英国独立党（UKIP）议员组成的联盟曾控制议会，共有30名成员，并拥有微弱多数。

en.t: 2018 Richmond upon Thames London Borough Council election
en.s: The 2018 Richmond upon Thames London Borough Council Election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Richmond upon Thames London Borough Council in England, on the same day as other local elections. The previous time the seats were up for election was 22 May 2014. The Liberal Democrats regained control of the council, winning 39 out of the 54 seats, with the Conservative Party forming the principal opposition with eleven of the remaining fifteen seats.

zh.t: 2018年泰晤士河畔里士满伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年泰晤士河畔里士满伦敦自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰泰晤士河畔里士满伦敦自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。上次改选这些席位是在2014年5月22日。自由民主党重新取得议会控制权，赢得54席中的39席。保守党赢得其余15席中的11席，成为主要反对党。

en.s: The 2018 Birmingham City Council election is one of many local elections that took place in England on 3 May 2018. This was the first 'all-out' election for Birmingham City Council following a boundary review, which reduced the number of councillors from 120 to 101, serving 69 wards (previously 40 wards). Since the election, the city council has been composed of 37 single-member wards and 32 two-member wards.

zh.s: 2018年伯明翰市议会选举是2018年5月3日在英格兰举行的多场地方选举之一。这是伯明翰市议会边界审查后首次所有席位同时改选，议员人数从120人减至101人，分别代表69个选区（此前有40个选区）。选举后，市议会由37个单席位选区和32个双席位选区组成。

en.s: The 2018 Oxford City Council election took place on 3 May 2018, to elect 24 of the 48 members of Oxford City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. Each of Oxford's 24 wards elected one councillor, with the other seat in each ward next due for election in May 2020.

zh.s: 2018年牛津市议会选举于5月3日举行，改选英格兰牛津市议会48个席位中的24席，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。牛津24个选区各选出1名议员；每个选区的另一个席位下次将于2020年5月改选。

en.s: The 2018 City of Lincoln Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of City of Lincoln Council in England. This was held on the same day as other local elections. One third of 33 seats were up for election, with one councillor in each of the 11 wards being elected.

zh.s: 2018年林肯市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰林肯市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。林肯市议会33个席位中的三分之一改选，11个选区各选出1名议员。

en.s: The 2018 Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One councillor was elected in each ward for a four-year term so the councillors elected in 2018 last stood for election in 2014.

zh.t: 2018年考尔德谷都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年考尔德谷都市自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰考尔德谷都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。每个选区选出1名议员，任期四年，因此2018年当选的议员上次参选是在2014年。

en.s: The 2018 Solihull Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Solihull Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2018年索利赫尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年索利赫尔都市自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰索利赫尔都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Derby City Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Derby City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour group on the council suffered losses of both the Council Leader Ranjit Banwait and the mayor John Whitby, as well as then cabinet member Sara Bolton, who lost by over 1,000 votes to Conservative Rob Cooper.

zh.s: 2018年德比市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰德比市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党在议会中的多名成员落选，包括议会领袖兰吉特·班韦特、市长约翰·惠特比，以及时任内阁成员萨拉·博尔顿；保守党候选人罗布·库珀以超过1,000票的优势击败博尔顿。

en.s: The 2018 Haringey Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Haringey Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2018年哈林盖伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年哈林盖议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰哈林盖议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2018 Daventry District Council election was held on Thursday 3 May 2018 to elect members of Daventry District Council in England.This was on the same day as other local elections. This was to be the final elections for Daventry District Council due to the poor running of Northamptonshire County Council by the local Conservative Party administration, leading to new unitary authorities for the county being proposed.

zh.s: 2018年达文特里区议会选举于2018年5月3日星期四举行，选出英格兰达文特里区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。这是达文特里区议会最后一次举行选举。此前当地保守党政府管理北安普敦郡议会不力，因此有人提议在该郡设立新的单一层级地方政府。

en.s: The 2018 Gosport Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Gosport Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The election saw the Liberal Democrats gain four seats: two from Labour, and one each from the Conservatives and UKIP. This reduced the Conservative Majority to one, remaining in control of the council, whilst UKIP lost their sole seat, in the Rowner and Holbrook ward.

zh.t: 2018年戈斯波特自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年戈斯波特自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰戈斯波特自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。自由民主党赢得4席：从工党手中赢得2席，另从保守党和英国独立党（UKIP）手中各赢得1席。保守党多数缩小到1席，但仍控制议会。英国独立党则失去了在罗纳和霍尔布鲁克选区的唯一席位。

en.s: The 2018 Norwich City Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Norwich City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. 13 of 39 seats (one-third) were up for election. The Labour Party retained overall control of the council, winning 12 out of 13 seats up for election and 49% of the vote, their best result in over 20 years.

zh.s: 2018年诺里奇市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰诺里奇市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。39个席位中的13席（三分之一）改选。工党继续全面控制议会，在改选席位中赢得12席，得票率为49%，这是该党20多年来的最佳成绩。

en.s: The 2018 Southend-on-Sea Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members to Southend-on-Sea Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom.

zh.t: 2018年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡滨海绍森德自治市议会议员，与英国各地其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Harrow London Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Harrow London Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. The Conservatives had hoped to win control of the council from Labour, but Labour emerged with an increased number of seats and kept their majority.

zh.t: 2018年哈罗伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年哈罗伦敦自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰哈罗伦敦自治市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。保守党曾希望从工党手中夺得议会控制权，但工党最终增加席位并保住多数。

en.s: The 2018 Hart District Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Hart District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2018年哈特区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰哈特区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2018 South Lakeland District Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of South Lakeland District Council in Cumbria, England. The whole council was up for election with boundary changes since the last election in 2016, these major changes to boundaries were recommended by the Local Government Boundary Commission for England (LGBCE) .

zh.s: 2018年南湖区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰坎布里亚郡南湖区议会议员。由于2016年上次选举后选区边界发生重大调整，议会全部席位改选。这些边界变化由英格兰地方政府边界委员会（LGBCE）建议。

en.s: The 2018 Worthing Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Worthing Borough Council. This was on the same day as other local elections. A third of the council was up for election, meaning a total of 13 councillors were elected from all of the council's wards. Despite suffering a net loss of two seats, the Conservative Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.s: 2018年沃辛自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出沃辛自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。议会三分之一席位改选，共选出13名议员，涵盖议会所有选区。尽管净减2席，保守党仍全面控制议会。

en.t: 2018 Waltham Forest London Borough Council election
en.s: The 2018 Waltham Forest Council election was held on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Waltham Forest London Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2018年沃尔瑟姆森林伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年沃尔瑟姆森林议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰沃尔瑟姆森林伦敦自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2018 Reading Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Reading Borough Council. There were three casual vacancies in Kentwood, Katesgrove and Church wards due to the early retirement of Councillors. The Labour Party held on to control of Reading Borough Council seeing their vote increase in seats across the Reading East constituency but suffering setbacks in the marginal seat of Kentwood where The Conservative Party gained a seat.

zh.s: 2018年雷丁自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出雷丁自治市议会议员。坎特伍德、凯特斯格罗夫和教堂三个选区的议员提前退休，造成3个席位空缺。工党继续控制雷丁自治市议会，在雷丁东部选区所辖区域的议席和得票均有所增加，但在竞争激烈的坎特伍德选区失利，保守党赢得1席。

en.s: The 2018 Crawley Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Crawley Borough Council in West Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party retained control of the council, with no seats changing hands.

zh.s: 2018年克劳利自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰西萨塞克斯郡克劳利自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党继续控制议会，没有席位易手。

en.s: The 2018 Enfield Council election took place on Thursday 3 May 2018 to elect members of Enfield London Borough Council in London, England. The whole council was up for election and the Labour party retained overall control of the council.

zh.t: 2018年恩菲尔德伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年恩菲尔德伦敦自治市议会选举于2018年5月3日星期四举行，选出伦敦恩菲尔德伦敦自治市议会议员。议会全部席位改选，工党继续全面控制议会。

en.s: Elections for the London Borough of Merton were held on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Merton London Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England.

zh.t: 2018年默顿伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 默顿伦敦自治市议会选举于2018年5月3日举行，选出英格兰默顿伦敦自治市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2018 United Kingdom local elections were held on Thursday 3 May 2018, with local council elections taking place in all 32 London boroughs, 34 metropolitan boroughs, 67 district and borough councils and 17 unitary authorities. There were also direct elections for the mayoralties of Hackney, Lewisham, Newham, Tower Hamlets and Watford. With the exception of those areas that have had boundary changes, the seats up for election were last contested in the 2014 local elections.

zh.s: 2018年英国地方选举于2018年5月3日星期四举行。伦敦32个自治市、34个都市自治市、67个区或自治市议会以及17个单一层级地方政府举行地方议会选举。哈克尼、刘易舍姆、纽汉、陶尔哈姆莱茨和沃特福德还举行市长直选。除选区边界调整的地区外，这次改选的席位上次都在2014年地方选举中改选。

en.s: The 2018 Bexley Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Bexley London Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. There were boundary changes which reduced the number of wards from 21 to 17 and the number of councillors from 63 to 45.

zh.t: 2018年贝克斯利伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年贝克斯利伦敦自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰贝克斯利伦敦自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。选区边界调整后，选区从21个减至17个，议员人数从63人减至45人。

en.s: The 2018 Thurrock Council elections took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Thurrock Council in England. Councillors in 16 out of the 20 electoral wards were to be up for election. The council remained under no overall control, with a minority Conservative administration running the council. On 26 January 2018, all sitting UKIP councillors resigned from the party and formed a new opposition group called Thurrock Independents.

zh.s: 2018年瑟罗克议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰瑟罗克议会议员。20个选区中的16个将举行选举。选后议会仍无人取得绝对多数，由保守党少数派政府执政。2018年1月26日，所有在任英国独立党议员退党，组成新的反对派团体“瑟罗克独立党”。

en.s: Elections to Manchester City Council were held on 3 May 2018, as part of the 2018 United Kingdom local elections. Although the council is normally elected in thirds, all 96 council seats were up for election due to boundary changes. Labour retained its near-complete dominance of the council. The sole change was that the Liberal Democrats gained a second seat in Didsbury West.

zh.s: 曼彻斯特市议会选举于2018年5月3日举行，是2018年英国地方选举的一部分。曼彻斯特市议会通常每次改选三分之一席位，但由于选区边界调整，96个席位全部改选。工党继续几乎全面控制议会。唯一的席位变化发生在迪兹伯里西区：自由民主党赢得第二席。

en.s: Elections to Ipswich Borough Council took place on 3 May 2018. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2018年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举于2018年5月3日举行，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2018 Cheltenham Borough Council election was held on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Cheltenham Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The result was a victory for the incumbent Liberal Democrat administration, which increased its overall majority.

zh.t: 2018年切尔滕纳姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年切尔滕纳姆自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰切尔滕纳姆自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。现任自由民主党政府获胜，并扩大了议会多数。

en.s: The 2018 Newcastle-under-Lyme Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Newcastle-under-Lyme Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. Newcastle-under-Lyme Borough Council decided in November 2015 to move to whole council elections, starting from this election.

zh.t: 2018年纽卡斯尔安德莱姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年纽卡斯尔安德莱姆自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰纽卡斯尔安德莱姆自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。该自治市议会于2015年11月决定从本次选举开始改为所有席位同时改选。

en.t: 2018 City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council election
en.s: The 2018 City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Bradford District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One councillor was elected in each ward for a four-year term so the councillors elected in 2018 last stood for election in 2014.

zh.t: 2018年布拉德福德都市区议会选举
zh.s: 2018年布拉德福德市都市区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰布拉德福德区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。每个选区选出1名议员，任期四年；因此，2018年当选的议员上次参选是在2014年。

en.s: The 2018 Halton Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Halton Borough Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2018年霍尔顿自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰霍尔顿自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Greenwich London Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Greenwich London Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2018年格林威治伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年格林威治伦敦自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰格林威治伦敦自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2018 London local elections took place in London on 3 May 2018 as part of wider local elections in England. All London borough councillor seats were up for election. Elections to the Corporation of London were held in 2017. Mayoral contests were also held in Hackney, Lewisham, Newham and Tower Hamlets. The previous London borough elections were in 2014.

zh.s: 2018年伦敦地方选举于5月3日举行，是英格兰更大范围地方选举的一部分。伦敦各自治市议会的全部席位都进行改选。伦敦金融城法团选举已于2017年举行。哈克尼、刘易舍姆、纽汉和陶尔哈姆莱茨举行市长选举。上一次伦敦自治市议会选举于2014年举行。

en.t: 2018 Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council election
en.s: The 2018 Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect 20 members to Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council, as part of the wider local elections. The seats were last up for election in 2014. The councillor for Basing up for election this year, Onnalee Cubitt, had rejoined the Conservative Party prior to the election and held her seat as a Conservative.

zh.t: 2018年贝辛斯托克-迪恩自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年贝辛斯托克-迪恩自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出该议会20名议员，是更大范围地方选举的一部分。这些席位上次于2014年改选。本次改选的巴辛选区议员翁娜莉·丘比特此前已重新加入保守党，并以保守党议员身份保住席位。

en.s: The 2018 Milton Keynes Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Milton Keynes Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2018年米尔顿凯恩斯议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰米尔顿凯恩斯议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Wigan Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Wigan Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2018年威根都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年威根都市自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰威根都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2018年威勒尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年威勒尔都市自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰威勒尔都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Sunderland City Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Sunderland City Council in England. The election took place on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2018年桑德兰市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰桑德兰市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: Elections to Winchester City Council took place on 3 May 2018. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 温彻斯特市议会选举于2018年5月3日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2018 Swindon Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018, to elect members of Swindon Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Conservatives held on to their majority on the council but it was lowered to one after losing a councillor to the Liberal Democrats in Wroughton & Wichelstowe.

zh.s: 2018年斯温登自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰斯温登自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。保守党继续控制议会，但在沃顿和威切尔斯托区失去一名议员给自由民主党后，多数席位缩小到1席。

en.s: The 2018 Epping Forest District Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Epping Forest District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. This is the last election in which the UK Independence Party had elected representation on the council after the defection of David Dorrell to the Conservatives, and the defeat of Rod Butler.

zh.s: 2018年埃平森林区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰埃平森林区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。由于戴维·多雷尔转投保守党、罗德·巴特勒落选，这是英国独立党最后一次在该议会中拥有当选议员。

en.s: The 2018 Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Stockport Council is elected in thirds, which means that in each three member local ward, one councillor is elected every year, except every four years which is classed as a fallow year.

zh.t: 2018年斯托克波特都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年斯托克波特都市自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰斯托克波特都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。斯托克波特议会按三分之一席位轮流改选：每个三席地方选区每年选出1名议员，但每四年有一年不举行选举。

en.t: 2018 St Albans City and District Council election
en.s: The 2018 St Albans City and District Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of St Albans City and District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2018年圣奥尔本斯市及区议会选举
zh.s: 2018年圣奥尔本斯市及区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰圣奥尔本斯市及区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Havering London Borough Council election was held on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Havering London Borough Council in Greater London. Elections were held for all 54 seats on the council. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2018年哈弗灵伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年哈弗灵伦敦自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，改选大伦敦哈弗灵伦敦自治市议会全部54个席位，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Croydon Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Croydon Council in England. This was on the same day as other London local elections. This election was the first fought on new ward boundaries in Croydon. The total number of seats remains the same, however the number of wards has increased by four, from 24 to 28.

zh.t: 2018年克罗伊登伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年克罗伊登议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰克罗伊登议会议员，与伦敦其他地方选举同日进行。这是克罗伊登首次按新的选区边界举行选举。席位总数不变，但选区增加4个，从24个增至28个。

en.s: The 2018 Wandsworth Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Wandsworth Council in London, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Conservative Party retained control of the council with a reduced majority, although the Labour Party made 7 gains and won the popular vote across the borough by a narrow margin.

zh.t: 2018年旺兹沃思伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年旺兹沃思议会选举于5月3日在伦敦举行，与其他地方选举同日进行。保守党继续控制议会，但多数席位减少。工党增加7席，且以微弱优势赢得全区最多选票。

en.s: The 2018 Liverpool City Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Liverpool City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2018年利物浦市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰利物浦市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: Elections to Stevenage Borough Council took place on 3 May 2018. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom. One third of the council was up for election; the seats which were last contested in 2014. The Labour Party retained control of the council, which it had held continuously since 1973.

zh.t: 2018年史蒂夫尼奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 史蒂夫尼奇自治市议会选举于2018年5月3日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位改选，这些席位上次于2014年改选。工党继续控制议会，自1973年以来一直如此。

en.s: The 2018 Rushmoor Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Rushmoor Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Two seats were up for election in the West Heath ward due to the resignation of an incumbent.

zh.t: 2018年拉什穆尔自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年拉什穆尔自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰拉什穆尔自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。由于一名现任议员辞职，西希思选区有两个席位改选。

en.s: The 2018 Hounslow Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Hounslow Borough Council in London, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party increased their majority on the council by gaining two seats from the Conservatives.

zh.t: 2018年豪恩斯洛伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年豪恩斯洛议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰伦敦豪恩斯洛自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党从保守党手中赢得2席，扩大了在议会中的多数。

en.s: The 2018 Sefton Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Sefton Metropolitan Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. Labour retained control of the council with an increased majority, winning an additional three seats and winning their first seats in Southport.

zh.t: 2018年塞夫顿都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年塞夫顿都市自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰塞夫顿都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党继续控制议会，多数席位有所增加，新增3席，并首次在绍斯波特赢得席位。

en.s: The 2018 Harlow District Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Harlow District Council in Essex. This was on the same day as other local elections. Labour increased their majority on the council by gaining one seat.

zh.s: 2018年哈洛区议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡哈洛区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。工党增加1席，扩大了在议会中的多数。

en.t: 2018 Barking and Dagenham London Borough Council election
en.s: The 2018 Barking and Dagenham Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Barking and Dagenham Council in London. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party won every available council seat for the third election in a row, winning 74% of the popular vote. The Conservatives saw their vote share rise by 13 percentage points, but failed to win any seats.

zh.t: 2018年巴金和达格纳姆伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年巴金和达格纳姆议会选举于5月3日举行，选出伦敦巴金和达格纳姆议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党连续第三次赢得议会所有可竞选席位，得票率为74%。保守党得票率上升13个百分点，但仍未能赢得任何席位。

en.s: The 2018 Ealing Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Ealing Council in London. The Labour Party increased their majority on the council by gaining four seats from the Conservatives.

zh.t: 2018年伊灵伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年伊灵议会选举于5月3日举行，选出伦敦伊灵议会议员。工党从保守党手中赢得4席，扩大了在议会中的多数。

en.t: 2018 Hammersmith and Fulham London Borough Council election
en.s: The 2018 Hammersmith and Fulham Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Hammersmith and Fulham Council in London.

zh.t: 2018年哈默史密斯-富勒姆伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年哈默史密斯-富勒姆议会选举于5月3日在伦敦举行，选出哈默史密斯-富勒姆议会议员。

en.t: 2018 Tower Hamlets London Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Tower Hamlets London Borough Council were held on 3 May 2018, the same day as other borough council elections in London. The directly elected mayor of Tower Hamlets was also up for election.

zh.t: 2018年陶尔哈姆莱茨伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 陶尔哈姆莱茨伦敦自治市议会选举于2018年5月3日举行，与伦敦其他自治市议会选举同日进行。陶尔哈姆莱茨直选市长也在当天选举。

en.s: The 2018 Basildon Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Basildon Borough Council in Essex. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Conservative Party gained overall control of the council. which had previously been under no overall control and run by a coalition between UKIP, Labour and Independents.

zh.t: 2018年巴西尔登自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年巴西尔登自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出埃塞克斯郡巴西尔登自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。保守党取得议会绝对多数；此前议会无人取得绝对多数，由英国独立党、工党和独立议员组成的联盟执政。

en.s: The 2018 Camden election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Camden Council in London. The Labour Party increased their majority on the council by gaining three seats from the Conservatives, who also lost two seats to the Liberal Democrats.

zh.t: 2018年卡姆登伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年卡姆登选举于5月3日在伦敦举行，选出卡姆登议会议员。工党从保守党手中赢得3席，扩大了在议会中的多数。保守党还失去2席给自由民主党。

en.s: The 2018 Sutton Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect members of Sutton Council in London. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2018年萨顿伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年萨顿议会选举于5月3日在伦敦举行，选出萨顿议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: Intimidation Games is a professional wrestling supercard event produced by Major League Wrestling (MLW) that was first held on May 3, 2018. The first three events served as television tapings for MLW Fusion, with the second event airing as a special live episode.

zh.s: Intimidation Games是美国职业摔角联盟（MLW）主办的职业摔角特别赛事，于2018年5月3日首次举行。前三届赛事均为《MLW Fusion》录制节目，其中第二届以特别直播节目的形式播出。

en.s: The 2018 Portsmouth City Council election took place on Thursday 3 May 2018 to elect members of Portsmouth City Council. 14 of 42 seats were contested during this elections within the unitary authority. After this year's local elections, the composition of the council is now (compared to the situation immediately prior to the election): The Statement of Persons Nominated was made on 6 April 2018 by Returning Officer David Williams.

zh.s: 2018年朴茨茅斯市议会选举于2018年5月3日星期四举行，在单一层级地方政府区域的42个席位中改选14席。选举结束后，议会组成情况如下，与选前相比有所变化。候选人提名名单由选举官戴维·威廉姆斯于2018年4月6日公布。

en.s: The 2018 Westminster City Council election was held on 3 May 2018, the same day as other London Boroughs. All 60 seats were up for election along with the 12 seats of Queen's Park Community Council, the parish council in the north west of the city. Despite initial expectations of Labour gains across the borough, the Conservative party were able to hold the council and only lost three seats.

zh.s: 2018年威斯敏斯特市议会选举于5月3日举行，与伦敦其他自治市选举同日进行。市议会全部60个席位和女王公园社区议会的12个席位均改选。尽管选前预计工党会在全市取得进展，保守党仍保住市议会控制权，只失去3席。

en.s: Elections to Southampton City Council took place on Thursday 3 May 2018, alongside nationwide local elections, alongside other local elections across the country. The elections saw no changes in the overall composition of the Council, however saw seats being exchanged. The Labour Party lost Bitterne, Millbrook and Peartree to the Conservative Party while the Conservatives lost Freemantle, Portswood and Swaythling to Labour.

zh.s: 南安普敦市议会选举于2018年5月3日星期四举行，与全国各地其他地方选举同日进行。议会整体党派构成没有变化，但席位有所交换：工党在比特恩、米尔布鲁克和皮尔特里选区失去席位，保守党在弗里曼特尔、波茨伍德和斯韦思林选区失去席位给工党。

en.s: Elections for Lewisham London Borough Council were held on 3 May 2018, the same day as for other London Boroughs. All 54 seats were up for election. The Labour Party won all 54 seats in a landslide victory, winning 60% of the popular vote. The Green Party lost their sole council seat, leaving the party without representation on Lewisham Borough Council for the first time in 16 years.

zh.t: 2018年刘易舍姆伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 刘易舍姆伦敦自治市议会选举于2018年5月3日举行，与伦敦其他自治市选举同日进行。议会全部54个席位改选。工党以压倒性优势赢得全部席位，得票率为60%。绿党失去唯一席位，16年来首次在刘易舍姆自治市议会中没有代表。

en.s: The 2018 North Hertfordshire Council election was held on 3 May 2018, at the same time as other local elections across England. Of the 49 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council, 19 were up for election, being the usual third of the council plus a by-election in Letchworth Grange ward.

zh.t: 2018年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 2018年北赫特福德郡议会选举于5月3日举行，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。49个席位中有19席改选，包括通常改选的三分之一席位，以及莱奇沃思格兰奇选区的一次补选。

en.s: The 2018 Eastleigh Borough Council election took place on 3 May 2018 to elect all members of Eastleigh Borough Council. The election was on new boundaries, with the overall size of the council being reduced by five seats, from 44 to 39. The outcome was a decisive victory for the incumbent Liberal Democrats.

zh.t: 2018年伊斯特利自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2018年伊斯特利自治市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出伊斯特利自治市议会全部成员。此次选举采用新的选区边界，议会席位从44席减少到39席。现任自由民主党取得压倒性胜利。

en.s: The 2018 election for Redbridge London Borough Council took place on 3 May 2018, the same day as for other London Boroughs. All 63 seats were up for election, with new ward boundaries in place. The Labour Party retained control of the council with an increased majority, taking 81% of the seats.

zh.t: 2018年雷德布里奇伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 雷德布里奇伦敦自治市议会选举于2018年5月3日举行，与伦敦其他自治市选举同日进行。采用新的选区边界，全部63个席位改选。工党继续控制议会，且多数席位增加，赢得81%的席位。

en.s: The inaugural Sheffield City Region mayoral election was held on 3 May 2018 to elect the mayor of the Sheffield City Region. The mayor will lead the Sheffield City Region Combined Authority. Voting is restricted to the four councils which are constituent members of the combined authority: Barnsley, Doncaster, Rotherham and Sheffield. Together these councils make up South Yorkshire.

zh.t: 2018年谢菲尔德城市区域市长选举
zh.s: 谢菲尔德城市区域首次市长选举于2018年5月3日举行，选出谢菲尔德城市区域市长。市长将领导谢菲尔德城市区域联合管理局。只有联合管理局的4个成员议会所在地区可以投票：巴恩斯利、唐卡斯特、罗瑟勒姆和谢菲尔德；这4地合称南约克郡。

en.s: Elections to Hackney London Borough Council took place on 3 May 2018. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party retained overall control of the council, winning 52 out of 57 seats. The party gained three seats from the Liberal Democrats and lost one to the Conservative Party, for a net gain of two seats.

zh.t: 2018年哈克尼伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 哈克尼伦敦自治市议会选举于2018年5月3日举行。工党继续全面控制议会，赢得57席中的52席。工党从自由民主党手中赢得3席，但也失去1席给保守党，净增2席。

en.s: The 2018 election for Southwark London Borough Council took place on 3 May 2018, the same day as for other London Boroughs. All 63 seats were up for election. New boundaries were used, using 23 two- and three-member wards (there were previously 21 three-member wards), following a Local Government Boundary Commission for England review that concluded in 2016.

zh.t: 2018年萨瑟克伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 萨瑟克伦敦自治市议会选举于2018年5月3日举行，全部63个席位改选。选举采用新的选区边界，根据英格兰地方政府边界委员会2016年完成的审查，选出23个双席位或三席位选区；此前有21个三席位选区。

en.s: The 2018 Newcastle City Council elections took place on 3 May 2018, on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom. For the first time since 2004, boundary changes occurred across Newcastle upon Tyne and the entire council was up for re-election. In June 2016, the Boundary Commission published draft proposals of potential new ward boundaries, with significant changes throughout the entirety of the city, though with some wards remaining the same.

zh.s: 纽卡斯尔市议会选举于2018年5月3日举行，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。自2004年以来，纽卡斯尔泰恩河畔地区首次调整选区边界，市议会全部席位改选。2016年6月，边界委员会公布了新选区边界的提案草案，对全市作出重大调整，但部分选区保持不变。

en.s: Elections for Runnymede Borough Council took place on 3 May 2018 alongside nationwide local elections. A third of the council was up for election, and the Conservatives retained control. Labour won their first seat on the council for over 20 years.

zh.t: 2018年伦尼米德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伦尼米德自治市议会选举于2018年5月3日举行，与全国各地地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位改选，保守党继续控制议会。工党时隔20多年首次在该议会赢得席位。

en.s: The Conservatives gained seats to strengthen their position controlling the council.

zh.s: 保守党赢得议席，巩固了对议会的控制。

en.s: Elections to Sheffield City Council took place on Thursday 3 May; one of a number of local council elections taking place across England on the same day. These were the first elections since 2016; the normal practice of electing one-third of councillors every year resumed this year, after the previous staging had seen all seats up for election as a result of boundary changes.

zh.s: 谢菲尔德市议会选举于2018年5月3日星期四举行，是英格兰同日举行的多场地方议会选举之一。这是自2016年以来首次举行选举。此前由于选区边界调整，所有席位同时改选；今年恢复了每年改选三分之一议员的惯例。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: A by-thirds Hyndburn Borough Council local election, was held on Thursday 3 May 2018. Approximately one third of the local council's 35 seats fell up for election on that day.

zh.s: 2018年亨德本自治市议会选举于2018年5月3日星期四举行。该地议会共有35个席位，当天约三分之一席位改选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2019 City of Lincoln Council election took place on 3 May 2019 to elect members of City of Lincoln Council in Lincolnshire, England. This was held on the same day as other local elections. One third of 33 seats were up for election, with one councillor in each of the 11 wards being elected.

zh.s: 2019年林肯市议会选举于5月3日举行，选出英格兰林肯郡林肯市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。林肯市议会33个席位中的三分之一改选，11个选区各选出1名议员。

en.s: The 2021 Magyar Kupa final was the final match of the 2020–21 Magyar Kupa, played between Fehérvár and Újpest on 3 May 2021 at the Puskás Aréna in Budapest, Hungary.

zh.s: 2021年匈牙利杯决赛是2020—21赛季匈牙利杯的最后一场比赛，由费赫尔瓦尔队对阵乌伊佩斯特队，于2021年5月3日在匈牙利布达佩斯的普斯卡什竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2020 FA Vase final was the 46th final of the Football Association's cup competition for teams at levels 9–11 of the English football league system. The match was contested between Consett and Hebburn Town. The final was finally played behind closed doors on 3 May 2021, after the date of 27 September 2020 was abandoned with the hope of allowing fans into the stadium.

zh.t: 2020 年英格兰足总花瓶赛决赛
zh.s: 2020 年英格兰足总花瓶赛决赛是英格兰足总面向英格兰足球联赛体系第 9 至第 11 级球队举办的杯赛第 46 届决赛。对阵双方为康塞特和赫本镇。决赛最终于 2021 年 5 月 3 日闭门举行；原定 2020 年 9 月 27 日的日期被取消，当时希望之后能够允许球迷入场。

en.s: The 2020 FA Trophy Final was a football match between Concord Rangers and Harrogate Town on 3 May 2021 which Harrogate won 1–0 with a goal from Josh Falkingham. It was the final match of the 2019–20 FA Trophy, the 51st season of the FA Trophy. The final was rescheduled for 27 September 2020 however this was postponed as the FA hoped to have spectators in the final.

zh.s: 2020年英格兰足总锦标赛决赛于2021年5月3日举行，由康科德流浪者队对阵哈罗盖特镇队。哈罗盖特镇队凭乔什·福尔金厄姆的进球以1比0获胜。这是2019—20赛季该赛事第51届决赛。决赛原定于2020年9月27日举行，后来因英格兰足球总会希望比赛能允许观众入场而推迟。

en.s: On 3 May 2021, at 22:22 CDT (UTC−5), a girder overpass in the borough of Tláhuac carrying Line 12 of the Mexico City Metro collapsed beneath a passing train. The overpass, along with the last two railcars of the train, fell onto Avenida Tláhuac near Olivos station, resulting in 26 fatalities and 98 injuries. It was the deadliest accident in the Metro's history in nearly 50 years.

zh.t: 墨西哥城地铁高架桥坍塌事故
zh.s: 2021年5月3日22时22分（中部夏令时间，UTC−5），一列地铁驶过时，墨西哥城特拉瓦克区承载12号线的高架桥梁坍塌。桥梁和列车最后两节车厢坠落到奥利沃斯站附近的特拉瓦克大道，造成26人死亡、98人受伤。这是近50年来墨西哥城地铁最严重的事故。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2022 Spring Breakin' was the inaugural Spring Breakin' professional wrestling event produced by WWE. It was held primarily for wrestlers from the NXT brand division. Spring Breakin' aired as a special episode of NXT. The television special took place on May 3, 2022, at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida and aired on the USA Network. Five matches were contested at the event.

zh.s: 2022年春季狂欢是世界摔角娱乐（WWE）首次举办的职业摔角赛事，主要由NXT品牌的摔角手参加。赛事以《NXT》特别节目形式播出。电视特别节目于2022年5月3日在美国佛罗里达州奥兰多的WWE训练中心举行，并通过USA Network播出。赛事共进行了5场比赛。

en.s: On the morning of 3 May 2023, a school shooting occurred at Vladislav Ribnikar Model Elementary School in the Vračar municipality of Belgrade, Serbia. The shooter, identified as 13-year-old Kosta Kecmanović, opened fire on students and staff, resulting in the deaths of ten individuals, including nine students and a security guard. Six others, five students and a teacher, also sustained injuries.

zh.t: 贝尔格莱德校园枪击案
zh.s: 2023年5月3日上午，塞尔维亚贝尔格莱德弗拉查尔市镇的弗拉迪斯拉夫·里布尼卡尔示范小学发生校园枪击案。枪手是13岁的科斯塔·克茨马诺维奇，他向学生和教职员工开枪，造成10人死亡，其中包括9名学生和一名保安。另有6人受伤，包括5名学生和一名教师。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: Wrestling Dontaku was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW). The event took place on May 3, 2023, in Fukuoka, at the Fukuoka Kokusai Center. It was the 18th event under the Wrestling Dontaku name.

zh.s: 摔角Dontaku是由新日本职业摔角（NJPW）主办的一场职业摔角赛事，于2023年5月3日在福冈的福冈国际中心举行。这是第18届摔角Dontaku大赛。

en.s: The 2023 Magyar Kupa final decided the winners of the 2022–23 Magyar Kupa, the 83rd season of Hungarian premier football cup, the Magyar Kupa. The match was played on 3 May 2023 at the Puskás Aréna in Budapest between Budafok and Zalaegerszeg. Zalegerszeg won the match 2–0 securing their first Magyar Kupa title with scoring the goals in the last minutes of the extra time.

zh.s: 2023年匈牙利杯决赛决出了2022—23赛季匈牙利杯冠军，这是匈牙利顶级足球杯赛第83个赛季。布达福克队和佐洛埃格塞格队于2023年5月3日在布达佩斯普斯卡什竞技场交锋。佐洛埃格塞格队以2比0获胜，在加时赛最后几分钟进球，首次夺得匈牙利杯冠军。

en.s: On 3 May 2023, ethnic violence erupted in India's north-eastern state of Manipur between the Meitei people, a majority that lives in the Imphal Valley, and the Kuki-Zo tribal community from the surrounding hills. According to government figures, as of 22 November 2024, 258 people have been killed in the violence and 60,000 people have been displaced.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2023年5月3日，印度东北部曼尼普尔邦的梅泰族（主要居住在英帕尔河谷）与周边山区的库基—佐族部落社区爆发族群暴力。根据政府数据，截至2024年11月22日，暴力事件已造成258人死亡、6万人流离失所。
zh.n: 此条记录采用源信息框所列的事件开始日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2024 AFC U-23 Asian Cup final was a football match that took place on 3 May 2024 at the Jassim bin Hamad Stadium in Al Rayyan, Qatar, to determine the winners of the 2024 AFC U-23 Asian Cup. The match was contested by Japan and Uzbekistan, the winners of the semi-finals. Japan won the final 1–0 to triumph for the second time in their participation history.

zh.s: 2024年亚足联U-23亚洲杯决赛于2024年5月3日在卡塔尔赖扬的贾西姆·本·哈马德体育场举行，决出该届赛事冠军。半决赛获胜者日本队和乌兹别克斯坦队在决赛中相遇。日本队以1比0获胜，这是该队第二次夺得该项赛事冠军。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Togo on 3 May 2025 to choose a president for a four-year term. It was the first presidential election since the 2024 constitutional reforms, which abolished direct presidential elections and instead made the President of Togo indirectly elected by the National Assembly to serve a double four-year term. Incumbent President Faure Gnassingbé, who had been in office since May 2005, was ineligible for re-election.

zh.s: 多哥于2025年5月3日举行总统选举，为总统选出四年任期。这是2024年宪法改革后的首次总统选举。改革取消总统直选，改由国民议会间接选出总统，任期为两个四年任期。自2005年5月起任职的现任总统福雷·纳辛贝没有资格再次参选。

en.s: The 2025 Plano municipal elections were held on May 3, 2025. In addition to the mayoral election (Place 6), seats were contested for Places 2, 4, and 8, as well as a special election for Place 5. If no candidate receives a majority of total vote, the top two candidates will advance to a run-off election held on June 7, 2025.

zh.s: 2025年普莱诺市选举于2025年5月3日举行。除市长选举（第6席位）外，第2、第4和第8席位也进行选举，第5席位另举行特别选举。如果没有候选人获得总票数的多数，得票最高的两名候选人将于2025年6月7日进入第二轮选举。

en.s: The 2025 Australian Senate election was held on Saturday, 3 May 2025 to elect 40 of the 76 senators in the Australian Senate as part of the 2025 federal election. Elected senators took office on 1 July 2025, with the exception of the senators elected from the two territories whose terms commenced from election day. The elected senators sat alongside continuing senators elected in 2022 as part of the 48th Parliament of Australia.

zh.s: 2025年澳大利亚参议院选举于5月3日星期六举行，是2025年联邦大选的一部分，选出参议院76名参议员中的40人。除两个领地选出的参议员任期从选举日开始外，其余当选参议员均于2025年7月1日就任。他们与2022年选出的续任参议员共同组成澳大利亚第48届议会。

en.s: A federal election was held on 3 May 2025 to elect members of the 48th Parliament of Australia. All 150 seats in the House of Representatives were up for election, along with 40 of the 76 seats in the Senate. The Labor government of Anthony Albanese was elected for a second term in a landslide victory over the opposition Liberal–National Coalition, led by Peter Dutton.

zh.s: 澳大利亚于2025年5月3日举行联邦大选，选出第48届议会成员。众议院全部150个席位和参议院76席中的40席改选。安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯领导的工党政府以压倒性优势击败彼得·达顿领导的自由党—国家党联盟，连任执政。

en.t: UFC on ESPN: Sandhagen vs. Figueiredo
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Sandhagen vs. Figueiredo (also known as UFC on ESPN 67) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on May 3, 2025 at the Wells Fargo Arena in Des Moines, Iowa, United States.

zh.t: UFC ESPN赛事：桑德哈根对阵菲格雷多
zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：桑德哈根对阵菲格雷多，也称UFC ESPN 67，是一场由终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）主办的综合格斗赛事，于2025年5月3日在美国爱荷华州得梅因的富国银行体育馆举行。

en.s: General elections were held in Singapore on 3 May 2025 to elect members of Parliament. They were the sixteenth general elections since the introduction of self-government in 1959, the fourteenth since independence in 1965, and the first under Lawrence Wong, who succeeded Lee Hsien Loong as prime minister in May 2024 and as secretary-general of the governing People's Action Party (PAP) that December.

zh.s: 新加坡于2025年5月3日举行大选，选出国会议员。这是1959年实行自治以来的第16次大选，也是1965年独立以来的第14次大选。此次是劳伦斯·黄出任总理后的首次大选；他于2024年5月接替李显龙出任总理，并于同年12月接替李显龙担任执政党人民行动党（PAP）秘书长。

en.s: The 2025 Garland mayoral election was held on May 3, 2025 to elect the next mayor of Garland, Texas. Incumbent mayor Scott LeMay was term-limited and ineligible to run for re-election to a fourth consecutive term. Because no candidate received more than 50% of the vote in the first round, the two highest-placing candidates advanced to a runoff election on June 7th.

zh.s: 2025年加兰市长选举于2025年5月3日举行，选出得克萨斯州加兰市下一任市长。现任市长斯科特·勒梅已达任期限制，不能竞选第四个连续任期。首轮投票中没有候选人得票超过50%，因此得票最高的两名候选人进入6月7日的第二轮选举。

en.s: The 2025 Super Cup final was the final match of the 2025 Super Cup, the fifth edition of the Indian Super Cup. It was played at Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar on 3 May 2025 between Goa and Jamshedpur. FC Goa defeated the Jamshedpur FC 3–0 in the final to win their second national cup title. As the winners, Goa have qualified for the 2025–26 AFC Champions League Two preliminary stage.

zh.s: 2025年超级杯决赛是第5届印度超级杯的决赛，于2025年5月3日在布巴内斯瓦尔的卡林加体育场举行，由果阿队对阵詹谢普尔队。果阿足球俱乐部以3比0获胜，第二次夺得国内杯赛冠军。作为冠军，果阿队获得2025—26赛季亚足联冠军联赛二级联赛资格赛的参赛资格。

en.s: The 2025 AFC Champions League Elite final was the final match of the 2024–25 AFC Champions League Elite, the 43rd season of Asia's premier club football tournament organised by the Asian Football Confederation (AFC), and the first since it was rebranded as the AFC Champions League Elite. It was played at King Abdullah Sports City Stadium in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, on 3 May 2025.

zh.t: 2025年亚足联精英冠军联赛决赛
zh.s: 2025年亚足联精英冠军联赛决赛是2024—25赛季赛事的最后一场比赛，也是亚足联主办的亚洲顶级俱乐部足球赛事第43个赛季中的决赛。这是赛事更名为亚足联精英冠军联赛后的首届决赛。比赛于2025年5月3日在沙特阿拉伯吉达的阿卜杜拉国王体育城体育场举行。

en.s: The 2025 San Antonio mayoral election was held on May 3, 2025, to elect the next mayor of San Antonio, Texas. Because no candidate received more than 50% of the vote, the two highest-placing candidates advanced to a runoff election on June 7. Municipal elections in Texas are officially nonpartisan. Due to the passage of Proposition F in 2024, the winner will receive a four-year term, as term limits were changed from four two-year terms to two four-year terms.

zh.s: 2025年圣安东尼奥市长选举于2025年5月3日举行，选出得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥市下一任市长。由于没有候选人得票超过50%，得票最高的两名候选人于6月7日进入第二轮选举。得克萨斯州市政选举依法不设党派。2024年通过的F提案将市长任期限制从四个两年任期改为两个四年任期，因此胜选者将任职四年。

en.s: The 2025 San Antonio City Council election was held on May 3, 2025, to elect the all 10 seats of the City Council of San Antonio, Texas. If no candidate receives at least 50.00% of the vote in each district, the two highest-placing candidates will advance to a runoff election on June 7.

zh.s: 2025年圣安东尼奥市议会选举于2025年5月3日举行，选出该市议会全部10个席位。如果某选区没有候选人获得至少50.00%的选票，该选区得票最高的两名候选人将于6月7日进入第二轮选举。

en.s: The 2025 Fort Worth mayoral election took place on May 3, 2025. Incumbent mayor Mattie Parker was re-elected to a third two-year term in office.

zh.s: 2025年沃思堡市长选举于2025年5月3日举行。现任市长马蒂·帕克再次当选，开始第三个两年任期。

en.s: The 2025 Coupe de France Féminine final was the final match of the 2024–25 Coupe de France Féminine, the 24th season of France's women's football club knockout cup competition organised by the French Football Federation. The match was played at Le Stade de l'Épopée in Calais, Hauts-de-France, on 3 May 2025, between Première Ligue sides Paris FC and Paris Saint-Germain.

zh.s: 2025年法国女子杯决赛是2024—25赛季法国女子杯的决赛，也是法国足球总会主办的法国女子足球俱乐部淘汰赛第24个赛季的决赛。巴黎足球俱乐部和巴黎圣日耳曼两支法国女足甲级联赛球队于2025年5月3日在上法兰西大区加莱的史诗体育场交锋。

en.t: Results of the 2025 Australian federal election in Western Australia
en.s: This is a list of electoral division results for the 2025 Australian federal election in the state of Western Australia. Labor polled 55.8% of the two-party preferred vote in Western Australia, the party's best ever result in the state since 1949, and the worst ever performance for the Liberal Party since its formation in 1944.

en.t: Results of the 2025 Australian federal election in South Australia
en.s: This is a list of electoral division results for the 2025 Australian federal election in the state of South Australia. This election was held using instant-runoff voting. All seats saw swings towards Labor, with the seat of Sturt being the only one to change hands. Previously a marginal Liberal seat, Claire Clutterham was elected to the seat with a 7.1 per cent swing.

zh.t: 2025年澳大利亚联邦大选南澳大利亚州结果
zh.s: 这是2025年澳大利亚联邦大选在南澳大利亚州各选区的结果列表。此次选举采用即时决选投票制。所有选区都出现了对工党有利的摆动，只有斯图尔特选区易手。原本是自由党的边缘席位，克莱尔·克拉特勒姆以7.1个百分点的有利摆动赢得该席位。

en.t: Results of the 2025 Australian federal election in Tasmania
en.s: This is a list of electoral division results for the 2025 Australian federal election in the state of Tasmania. Labor’s two-party preferred vote in Tasmania achieved a modern high-point at this election, reaching 63.3% after a swing of 9% from the Liberal Party. The seat of Braddon saw a record swing of 15%, the highest swing to Labor nationwide for the 2025 election.

zh.t: 2025年澳大利亚联邦大选塔斯马尼亚州结果
zh.s: 这是2025年澳大利亚联邦大选在塔斯马尼亚州各选区的结果列表。此次选举中，工党在塔斯马尼亚州的两党优先投票率创下现代最高纪录，达到63.3%，较自由党上升9个百分点。布拉登选区的摆动幅度达到创纪录的15个百分点，是工党在2025年大选中全国最高的摆动幅度。
